title: At Your Service Center Associate, Columbia Center - Part Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an At Your Service Center Colleague, you are at the heart of delivering a seamless and personalized shopping experience. You’ll support all At Your Service activities, including Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS), merchandise returns, order pickups, and other assigned tasks - all while upholding Macy’s service standards.

This role requires strong multitasking abilities, problem-solving, attention to detail, and a customer-first mindset. You’ll thrive in a fast-paced environment where flexibility is key, including working a variety of shifts such as nights, weekends, and holidays.

This role goes far beyond just being a cashier. Here, the customer is at the heart of everything we do - every day, all day. If you're passionate about selling, reaching goals, working as a team, and creating amazing experiences through genuine hospitality, this could be the perfect fit for you! You’ll also help keep the shopping space clean, organized, and inviting so every customer feels welcome the moment they walk in.

How Our At Your Service Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Every day starts with a positive example. As an At Your Service Colleagues (AYS), you come in energized and ready to make an impact - wearing your name badge with pride, greeting teammates with warmth, and helping ensure the At Your Service areas is clean, organized, and ready for customers. You help set the pace by reviewing sales goals, learning about new arrivals and top-selling items, and staying up to date on trends and promotions - so you’re prepared to support the team and engage customers confidently.
  • In the At Your Service area, you lead through action - welcoming customers with genuine hospitality, making eye contact, and starting friendly, personal conversations that build lasting relationships. Assist customers in all aspects of total store fulfillment, including By Online and Pick Up in Store, be proficient in all systems needed to complete transactions, and ensure the collection area is organized so the customer pick-up experience is friction-free
  • You help maintain a shoppable space by recovering merchandise and keeping the pickup and return areas clean while ensuring timely completion and curbside delivery of Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS) orders.
  • They always Finish Strong - sharing our Loyalty program benefits, making sure customers have all they need, and ending with a sincere thank-you, often walking the package around and using the customer’s name.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Makes prompt, sound decisions in real time to effectively address customer needs and resolve issues
  • Be comfortable communicating and collaborating with customers and colleagues
  • Meeting daily sales goal challenges
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Enjoy meeting people, learning about them, and sharing information
  • Resourceful and eager to start a new venture and can adapt to changing priorities; you can work on your own but are great with team dynamics
  • You can handle electronic devices with no problem

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands.
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs. stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level.
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment.
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

This job description is not all-inclusive and may not apply to colleagues covered by a collective bargaining agreement. Macy's Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to an inclusive work environment.

title: APJ Partner Category Lead - DevOps and Observability, APJ Partner Category
description:
Description

As the APJ DevOps and Observability Partner Category Lead, you will own and drive the end-to-end DevOps and Observability technology partner strategy across the Asia-Pacific and Japan region. You will be responsible for understanding customer and market signals, accelerating customer adoption of DevOps and Observability solutions, growing top-line Marketplace revenue across all market segments and across all countries in APJ.

As the APJ DevOps and Observability Partner Category Lead, you will own and drive the end-to-end DevOps and Observability technology partner strategy across the Asia-Pacific and Japan region. You will be responsible for understanding customer and market signals, accelerating customer adoption of DevOps and Observability solutions, growing top-line Marketplace revenue across all market segments and across all countries in APJ.

This is a high-visibility, high-impact role that sits at the intersection of AWS's most strategic DevOps and Observability partnerships and the rapidly converging Observability-Security-Data landscape. You will serve as the single-threaded owner (STO) for the DevOps and Observability partnership category in APJ, orchestrating executive governance, field enablement, and go-to-market execution.

The ideal candidate will have direct sales and/or ISV/Technology Partner experience, as well as deep familiarity with the Observability and DevOps technology landscape (infrastructure monitoring, log analytics, AIOps, cloud-native observability), cloud platform economics, and enterprise partner development. The candidate will have strong business acumen and problem-solving skills, as well as the ability to manage multiple customer personas and successfully align executive stakeholders with differing goals. A strong executive presence and the ability to successfully manage ambiguous, fast-moving situations autonomously and deliver results is required.

Key job responsibilities

  • Define and execute the APJ DevOps & Observability category partnership strategy, goals, and metrics. Break down the overall goals and metrics into country/area outcomes
  • Set up partner governance and executive engagement. Establish and run the partnership operating model for DevOps & Observability partners, serving as AWS's primary relationship holder with partners' APJ leadership
  • Work with cross-functional stakeholders (Area Partner Leaders, Security Category Lead, Data/AI Category Lead, SI Partners, and Sales Leaders) to deliver integrated programs and customer engagements
  • Enable Area/Country Partner teams to serve as local representatives for DevOps & Observability partnerships
  • Work back from market signals to identify customer needs and mitigate partnership risks with proactive remediation plans
  • Track and communicate key metrics. Maintain pipeline visibility and identify and share insights.

A day in the life

Your day might start with a pipeline review call with Japan's Area Partner team to unblock a strategic enterprise deal, followed by a bi-weekly sync with APJ partner leadership to align on upcoming product launches. Mid-morning you're reviewing market signals and customer feedback. After lunch you're enabling a group of sellers on a new co-sell play, and in the afternoon you're leading an executive monthly business review presenting APJ progress to world wide leadership.

About The Team

The APJ Partner Category Team is responsible for AWS's most strategic technology partnerships across Asia-Pacific and Japan. We operate as category leaders - each owning an end-to-end partnership strategy that spans revenue, GTM, enablement, and executive governance. We work at the intersection of AWS's fastest-growing services and our partners' go-to-market ambitions to drive customer outcomes at scale.

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of business development, partnership management, or sourcing new business experience
  • Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
  • 5+ years of communicating with and presenting to executive and senior audiences experience
  • Experience working with Observability, DevOps, Monitoring, or Cloud Operations related technologies, including but not limited to log analytics, infrastructure monitoring, and AIOps
  • Track record of building operating models, governance mechanisms, and field enablement at scale across multiple geographies

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in technology partner development, ISV alliances, or strategic business development in the cloud/DevOps ecosystem
  • Direct experience managing Observability or DevOps technology partnerships (APM, cloud monitoring, log management, or infrastructure observability platforms)
  • Understanding of Observability technology economics (consumption-based pricing, platform convergence across observability-security-data, and cloud-native architectures)

title: Software Engineer I
description:
Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.

Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.

We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.

About the team

At Careem, the mission for the NextGen program is to help grow our new joint Engineering by learning how to write Clean Code, use SOLID principle techniques, and design reliable systems. The ultimate goal is to train the new Engineers to build Engineering excellence foundations with high standards. Our program covers all the areas of Careem tech be it Cyber Security, Data, Infrastructure, and all the Software Engineering tracks like Backend, Frontend as well as Mobile.

We are looking for software engineers to join our team of talented engineers that share a common interest in distributed backend systems, their scalability, and continued development. You will work alongside a top talent for an accelerated learning path. You will have access to some of the most exciting projects and advanced tech for accelerated learning and exposure.

You will be responsible for maintaining some of our services that power the Careem Engine, scaling highly distributed systems, and continuously documenting and improving our engineering practices. These large-scale, distributed systems handle everything from user requests to payment processing.

What you'll do:

Our tech stack is Java 8 and Spring Boot, Micro-Service Architecture, SQL and no-SQL DBs, and AWS infrastructure. Key responsibilities include:

  • Development of our distributed backend system to meet the challenging functional, scalability, and reliability requirements for our fast-growing business.
  • Maintain features and systems, with an emphasis on code quality, maintainability, readability, and testing.
  • Facilitate collaboration with other engineers, product owners, and designers to solve interesting and challenging problems across our platform.
  • Be a valued member of an autonomous, cross-functional agile team.
  • You care about quality and you know what it means to ship high-quality code.

What you'll need:

  • Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply!
  • The ideal candidate will have a passionate commitment to improving the lives of people, an insane focus on excellence and customer service, and a strong alignment with our core values: being bold, focused, agile and collaborative.

Must have:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or other related technical fields.
  • Understanding of Object-oriented design, data structures, and algorithms.
  • Ability to solve complex problems.
  • Must be able to write clean and maintainable code (must love coding!).
  • Ability to effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions; deal with loosely defined problems and fast-changing requirements & think abstractly.
  • Passionate about learning new technologies and working on a product of massive scale and impact.
  • Able to communicate effectively.

Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of AWS
  • Knowledge of clean code principles
  • Deep understanding of design patterns
  • Demonstrated ability of test-driven development

As outlined in Careem's Equal Employment Opportunity policy, we do not discriminate based on any protected group status under any applicable law.

The Director oversees architecture, engineering standards, team performance, and delivery execution- while providing senior technical guidance and mentoring engineering mangers and senior developers. The Director partners closely with Product, Executive Leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders in the US and Canada to translate business strategy into technical roadmaps. A strong emphasis is placed on secure development practices, AI-assisted development, and continuous improvement of engineering processes.


Reasonable accommodations statement: to perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Strategic & Technical Leadership

  • Establish and enforce architectural standards, engineering best practices, and secure coding guidelines
  • Serve as a senior technical authority for complex design and vendor integration decisions
  • Ensure alignment between business priorities and engineering execution
  • Implement AI tools and engineering processes that improve development workflow efficiency, software quality, and delivery outcomes

Team Leadership & Delivery

  • Build a high-performance engineering culture focused on ownership, quality, and continuous improvement
  • Partner with Product Management to refine requirements and balance scope, quality, and timelines

  • Collaborate with AI teams across the Exa (Holdco) ecosystem to share and adopt best practices

Architecture, Quality & Security

  • Ensure comprehensive unit testing, code review practices, and automated quality controls
  • Champion security-first development and compliance with healthcare relevant frameworks (HIPPA, HITRUST, SOC 2 Type @) and applicable PHI handling standards.
  • Reduce technical debt, improve system reliability, and minimize production incidents

AI-Assisted Development & Innovation

  • Define standards for effective and responsible use of AI-assisted development tools
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate modernization, testing, documentation, and developer productivity
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend adoption where they align with company goals
  • Ensure AI-generated code is reviewed, tested, hardened, and production-ready

  • Collaborate with AI teams across the Exa ecosystem to align on tooling, patterns, and best practices
  • Actively participate in and contribute to the Exa ecosystem to share learnings and influence future capabilities

title: Information Technology Lead
description:
Hybrid onsite (2-4 Days/week in office): Charlestown, MA


Step into a pivotal IT Leadership role at a fast-growing grid intelligence company. You will own the security, reliability, and overall employee experience that keeps LineVision moving forward. You'll ensure seamless internal productivity while maintaining the operational rigor expected by our customers in the critical energy infrastructure sector.


Reporting to the VP of Security, IT, and Quality, you will be granted broad autonomy to lead IT service delivery, systems administration, and IT compliance execution. You and your IT Analyst will deliver an exceptional technology experience, powering employee productivity across core SaaS applications, such as Google Workspace, Claude Enterprise, Slack, and Atlassian. You will also take charge of identity and endpoint management, including Okta, 1Password, and Workspace One, while executing the IT controls essential to our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II audits. Our entire organization will look to you to provide a seamless, secure foundation that enables everyone to do their best work.


If you get satisfaction from running a tight, well-instrumented IT operation and building the team underneath it, join us at LineVision, Built In Boston Best Places to Work!


What will you do?

Core Responsibilities and Key Performance Objectives

  • IT Service Delivery & Support: Oversee the helpdesk and IT support services with Jira Service Management. Manage the IT Analyst to ensure employee requests, onboarding, offboarding, and role transfers are handled seamlessly and within SLA.
  • Identity & Workflow Automation: Build and maintain workflow automation for the employee account lifecycle.
  • Hardware & Procurement: Own Dell and Apple hardware procurement, provisioning, and asset tracking across in-office and remote environments.
  • Administer and maintain core applications: MDM, identity, Google Workspace, password management, collaboration and work management tools, and enterprise AI.
  • Security Operations & IT Compliance: Perform Access Rights Reviews and security awareness training administration.
  • Incident Management: Serve on the on-call rotation for security event escalations from our MSSP, and ensure agent deployment/health across the fleet.
  • Vendor Management: Manage vendor relationships for IT-owned tools and services, including contract renewals and procurement recommendations.

Within the first 3 months:

  • Establish operational rhythm with LineVision's IT Analyst, including regular 1-1s, goal-setting, and workload prioritization.
  • Take ownership of core IT tools, including identity, MDM, and security.
  • Inventory and gain operational control over existing accounts and IT applications.
  • Establish vendor relationships with key service providers, such as our MSP, professional services partners, and Mac/Windows workstation suppliers.
  • Audit current account provisioning/deprovisioning practices.
  • Implement practices to ensure compliance with ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II.

Within the first 6 months:

  • Implement confidential data handling controls that conform to LineVision’s Data Management policy.
  • Implement tooling in support of 24x7 Customer Support team commitments: customer email automation, PagerDuty administration, and customer support portal.
  • Take ownership of enterprise AI: evolve Claude security configuration, monitor spend and implement controls.
  • Assess and recommend improvements to the Boston office infrastructure: internet connectivity, firewall, and conference room A/V.
  • Propose LineVision’s annual IT budget, monitor spend, and provide periodic forecast updates.
  • Run a full audit cycle as the IT-side evidence owner, with no SLA-related findings.

Within the first year:

  • Propose an updated 2–3 year IT systems roadmap, including resourcing needs as the company grows.
  • Mature controls and workflows to streamline confidential data handling.
  • Implement workflow automations to account lifecycle management (onboarding, offboarding, access reviews) that reduces manual effort or audit risk.

How to succeed in this role

Key Competencies

  • Ownership: feel comfortable taking the full scope of responsibility for IT systems, vendor management, service delivery, and team development.
  • Attention to Detail: catch an access misconfiguration or missed deprovisioning before an auditor or a customer does.
  • Communication: explain technical issues clearly to employees, executives, and vendors; know when something needs to go up the chain.
  • People Leadership: coach and develop a direct report, and hold them accountable to service standards.
  • Follow Through: manage a high volume of parallel, interrupt-driven work without dropping the ball on longer-term projects.

Essential Skills

  • 4+ years in IT operations/systems administration, with at least 1+ years in a lead or people-management capacity.
  • Hands-on administration experience with Okta (or equivalent IdP), MDM platforms (Workspace One or equivalent), and Google Workspace admin.
  • Experience with managing and supporting Windows, MacOS, and Linux end-user devices.
  • Familiarity with endpoint security tooling (e.g., CrowdStrike) from an IT operations perspective (deployment/health, not engineering configuration).
  • Experience supporting ISO 27001 and/or SOC 2 Type II audits (evidence gathering, control execution).
  • Track record of managing account lifecycle processes (onboarding, offboarding, access reviews) against defined SLAs.
  • Vendor management experience: contract renewals, tool evaluation, and cost management.

What Sets The Best Candidates Apart

  • A service mindset: a commitment to user enablement and internal support.
  • Direct experience managing or mentoring a small IT team.
  • Experience implementing data handling controls for sensitive or regulated data.
  • Comfort administering AI tools (seat/spend management, security configuration).
  • Experience standing up customer-facing support tooling (e.g., PagerDuty, Jira Service Management, support portals).

Reporting & Team Structure

  • Reports to the VP of Security, IT & Quality.
  • Manages the IT Analyst.
  • Partners closely with Security Engineering and Compliance on audit evidence and CEII/confidential data controls, and with HR on onboarding/offboarding.
  • Partners with Finance on AI tool spend and vendor contract management.

What does joining LineVision mean for you?

  • Impact. Your talent, time, and energy will critically impact our success in accelerating our mission of providing utilities with grid intelligence to enable affordable, reliable power.
  • Ownership. You will hold broad responsibilities with high autonomy and trust in a communicative, collaborative, and fast-paced environment.
  • Flexibility. You will be empowered to maintain work-life balance with trust-based PTO and a flexible work schedule.
  • Real World Innovation. You will join a motivated and high-performing team working with cutting edge, patented technology to help solve key obstacles to meet the demands of an AI-powered future.

Who we are…

LineVision is a grid-enhancing technology company enabling electric utilities to deliver affordable, reliable power and accelerate the electrification of the global economy. Our grid intelligence platform delivers the most accurate, network-wide dynamic line ratings and enables safer, more reliable grid operations with a combination of optical sensors and advanced environmental modeling. LineVision's global customer base includes eight of the ten largest US utilities, including National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon.

We are LineVisionaries:

  • We are Innovators: We light the way with tenacious creativity and do good work.
  • We are Empowered: With high trust and high autonomy, the floor is yours, and the opportunity is ours.
  • We are Welcoming: Come as you are, our doors are open. We are better together.
  • We are Trusted Partners: We elevate our customer champions through shared thought leadership. We deliver on commitments.
  • We are All In: We are building a community of passionate individuals who want to dent the universe.

At LineVision there's no such thing as a “perfect” candidate. We are looking for exceptional people who want to make a positive impact through their work and facilitate an organization where everyone can thrive. So whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this role would make you excited to come to work every day.

title: Software Engineer, Desktop

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. ROLE

IDEAL EXPERIENCES

  • Proven software engineering experience.

  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript.
  • Experience with React or similar UI frameworks.
  • Solid understanding of the desktop application lifecycle.
  • Experience with IPC communication.
  • Experience working with local storage (SQLite, IndexedDB, filesystem).
  • Experience with WebSockets or other real-time transport mechanisms.
  • Strong debugging and performance profiling skills.
  • Familiarity with native OS behaviors on macOS or Windows.

TECH STACK

  • Electron
  • Node.js
  • Typescript
  • SQL & noSQL

HOW WE WORK

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

INTERVIEW PROCESS

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

title: Senior Backend Developer
description:
The Role

We are rebuilding the MyHome.ie backend as a .NET 8 microservices platform on Azure Kubernetes, and migrating a large legacy .NET Framework / ServiceStack estate onto it service by service — with no downtime on a live, revenue-generating platform. Several new services are already in production; more are queued to follow.

The successful candidate will join a small team working exclusively on the new platform, own services end-to-end, and be trusted to ship without close supervision. This is a hands‑on delivery role: we need code in production, not a discovery phase.

Key Responsibilities

  • Designing, building and shipping .NET 8 microservices behind our API gateway — from data model to deployed pods.
  • Migrating capabilities off the legacy estate onto the new platform (strangler‑fig style), including the integration layer that keeps old and new consistent while both run in parallel.
  • Building event‑driven flows with MassTransit and Azure Service Bus, with the idempotency and eventual‑consistency handling that actually survives production.
  • Working across Azure SQL, Elasticsearch and Redis — schema design, query performance, index and cache strategy.
  • Writing the unit and integration tests that prove your change works, and diagnosing issues in production via App Insights.
  • Owning your slice of the delivery pipeline: Dockerfiles, Kubernetes manifests, Azure Pipelines.
  • Reviewing peers' code, and reviewing and steering output from our AI‑assisted development pipeline.

How we work

  • Small team, short feedback loops, sprint‑based delivery tracked in Jira.
  • Every change goes through pull‑request review — by humans and by our AI reviewer, which runs automatically on open PRs. Some tickets arrive with an AI‑generated first draft; reviewing and correcting that is part of the job, and we treat it as a skill.
  • Feature branches off development, PR back into development; release branches are cut from there.
  • Documentation lives with the code and is expected to be kept current.

Requirements & Experience for the role

  • 6+ years commercial backend development, at least 2 at senior level, delivering production systems.
  • C# and .NET 8 (or 6/7 with recent 8 work) — modern ASP.NET Core, DI, async/await, structured concurrency.
  • Production microservices at real scale — API gateway patterns, service‑to‑service auth, resilience/retry (Polly or equivalent), timeouts, idempotent handlers.
  • Docker and Kubernetes day‑to‑day — reading and writing manifests, debugging a failing pod without help.
  • Relational data — solid SQL Server / Azure SQL modelling and query tuning; EF Core and/or a micro‑ORM.
  • Asynchronous messaging — MassTransit, Azure Service Bus, or a close equivalent.
  • Automated testing you wrote yourself — unit and integration, against real dependencies where it matters.
  • Brownfield migration experience — extracting capabilities from a legacy monolith or older service estate while both generations run live.
  • CI/CD ownership (Azure DevOps Pipelines ideally), disciplined Git branching, Jira.
  • Genuine autonomy: able to pick up a ticket with gaps in it, ask the right three questions, and deliver.
  • Redis caching and invalidation at scale.
  • Microsoft Entra ID — OIDC/OAuth2, machine‑to‑machine client credentials, consumer identity (CIAM/B2C‑style).
  • Ocelot, YARP, or another .NET gateway.
  • ServiceStack or .NET Framework maintenance — you will occasionally need to read and touch legacy services.
  • High‑traffic public web concerns: CDN, Azure Front Door, SSR and SEO‑sensitive rendering.
  • Enough Angular / TypeScript to trace a bug from the API into the frontend.
  • Working with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot) as part of normal delivery.

MyHome.ie / The Irish Times Group operate a Hybrid working policy.

Our benefits include Health Insurance contribution, Pension Contribution, Sick Leave Cover, Maternity and Paternity Leave, Irish Times Premium Digital Subscription, Income Protection Policy, Corporate Gym Membership discounts, Free Digital GP and Life Assurance Policy.

Hos A&Til leder vi efter dig, der er nysgerrig på mennesker, teknologi og nye måder at skabe digitale oplevelser på. Dig, der har lyst til at eksperimentere, udfordre vanetænkning og omsætte idéer til løsninger, som gør en reel forskel for mere end 150.000 medlemmer.

Vi kalder stillingen innovationskonsulent og din baggrund er mindre vigtig – det afgørende er din indstilling og de erfaringer, du har skabt.

Du skal være med til at forme vores digitale løsninger

Vi er i gang med at udvikle næste generation af digitale medlemsoplevelser. Derfor søger vi en kollega, som kan være med helt fra problemidentifikation, over brugerindsigt og prototyper, til løsninger der ender hos vores medlemmer og løbende vedligeholdes.

Du bliver en del af et lille tværfagligt team med digitale projektledere, UX/UI-specialister og en proceskonsulent. Vi arbejder tæt sammen med resten af organisationen om at udvikle digitale løsninger, der både giver værdi for medlemmerne og understøtter vores forretning.

Vi tror på at gode løsninger bliver skabt gennem nysgerrighed, afprøvning og tæt samarbejde. Vi går langt for at skabe en mærkbar forskel for medlemmerne og for hinanden. Vi tror på, at innovative løsninger kræver, at vi har mod til at eksperimentere med nye ideer, og at fejl er en mulighed for at lære og for at blive dygtigere.

Hos os kommer du blandt andet til at

  • udforske brugerbehov og omsætte dem til nye digitale muligheder
  • udvikle koncepter med AI-understøttede prototyper
  • afprøve idéer tidligt, lære af feedback og kvalificere løsningerne
  • bygge bro mellem forretning, udvikling og design
  • være med til at udvikle, hvordan vi bruger AI og nye digitale værktøjer i vores arbejde.

Hvem er du?

Vi tror ikke på den perfekte kandidat. Måske arbejder du i dag med UX, service design, product design, digital innovation eller konceptudvikling. Måske kommer du fra et bureau, en produktorganisation eller en medlemsorganisation.

Det vigtigste er, at du:

  • er stærk til at omsætte indsigter til konkrete designs
  • er nysgerrig på AI og kan lide at dykke ned i AI værktøjer som fx Figma Make, Claude Design mv
  • trives med at arbejde eksperimenterende og iterativt
  • har blik for både mennesker, teknologi og forretning
  • bidrager aktivt til samarbejde og deler din viden med andre.

Hvis du samtidig har erfaring med brugerresearch, prototyper eller digitale udviklingsprojekter, er det en klar fordel.

Derfor skal du vælge os

Hos A&Til får du ikke bare en rolle i et projekt, du får mulighed for at være med til at præge, hvordan vi udvikler digitale løsninger i fremtiden.

Vi arbejder med stor frihed, høj faglighed og et stærkt fællesskab. Vi tror på, at de bedste idéer opstår, når forskellige perspektiver mødes, og vi giver plads til at eksperimentere, lære og udvikle os sammen. Du vil opleve, at vi hver især tager ansvar for at give fremragende service og derfor er empati og nysgerrighed en selvfølge, både når vi er i dialog med vores medlemmer, og når vi samarbejder som kollegaer.

Du bliver en del af et team, hvor humor, sparring og tillid er lige så vigtigt som høj kvalitet i det, vi leverer.

Lyder det som dig? Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Stillingen er fuldtid med opstart d. 1. november 2026 og primært arbejdssted er Snorresgade 15 på Islands Brygge i København.

Du søger stillingen ved at sende dit CV via linket senest d. 7. september. I stedet for en traditionel ansøgning beder vi dig besvare nogle få spørgsmål om din erfaring og motivation. Vi forventer at holde 1. samtaler d. 17. september og 2. samtaler d. 22. september. Hvis du går videre fra 1. samtale, vil du mellem første og anden samtale blive bedt om at udfylde en personlighedstest og besvare en case.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Innovationschef Cirkeline Martinussen på telefon 25223067.

Vi opfordrer til, at du ikke oplyser alder eller sætter billede på dit ansøgningsmateriale.
Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Collections Representative I
description:
Employment Type: Full-Time, Hybrid #LI-HYBRID


Entry Salary Range: $20.48-$24.57 per hour with an annual award opportunity based on individual and credit union performance.


Advia offers a bilingual premium for this role. This premium acknowledges and compensates bilingual employees who regularly use their language skills to assist our members. Proficiency testing is required, with a specific need for Spanish language proficiency.


What you should know about the role

Accountable to performing a variety of activities regarding delinquent accounts. This position requires knowledge of collections laws and practices and of consumer loan documents. Success in this role is accomplished by providing outstanding service to both internal and external members as defined by living and demonstrating the core values of the credit union; Act with Integrity, Drive Progress, Build & Strengthen Relationships and Keep People at the Core.


What you should know about Advia

Advia is a fast-growing Credit Union that is positioned in the top 3% of credit unions across the United States. We serve almost 200,000 members with assets over $3 Billion. We offer very similar product and services as the big banks with a focus on saving our members money while providing financial advantages. We are rooted in our communities and believe we have a responsibility to give back outside of our four branch walls through volunteering and charitable donations. The work environment at Advia is fast-paced, performance based and fun infused. We certainly live by the saying "work hard, play hard." As an employee of Advia, you can expect regular and constructive feedback, development opportunities, great benefits, excellent co-workers and engaged managers.


Major Duties and Responsibilities

Collections of delinquent consumer loans, credit cards or negative share accounts as assigned, this includes but is not limited to credit disputes, deceased member accounts and specialized administrative tasks associated with real estate, repossessions and workouts:

  • Strategically evaluate accounts and build relationships with members to identify a positive outcome in potentially negative situations.
  • Utilize effective human relation skills and forms of persuasion to identify solutions for financial obligations.
  • Documents all collection efforts taken, including telephone conversations, alternative financial arrangements and correspondence on computer.
  • Review accounts and interview members in an effort to comprehend reason for delinquency.
  • Make arrangements with member to resolve delinquency and continue follow-up contact as needed (could include but not limited to loan modification and workouts)
  • Counsel and educate members regarding their financial obligations, advises of possible options, and solicit payments arrangements.
  • Direct the posting of payments received to delinquent accounts.
  • Process consumer credit counseling requests and maintain monitoring of said accounts to ensure timely payments, including the posting of payments.
  • Recommend delinquent accounts for legal action or charge-off.
  • Demonstrates judgment and discretion within the framework of all applicable regulations and policies.
  • Utilize skip tracing to locate members whose contact information is no longer valid or whom have been avoiding contact with us.

Use knowledge of Collection operations to provide assistance and guidance to internal and branch team:

  • Provide background information to lenders upon request.
  • Assist with restrictions and overrides.
  • Available to answer member queries regarding disputes on loans (could include but not limited to liens releases, collateral, liability issues).

Related Duties:

  • Maintain accurate and timely documentation on member accounts.
  • Provide collection assistance to other departments.


Must comply with applicable laws and regulations, including but not limited to, the Bank Secrecy Act, the Patriot Act, and the Office of Foreign Assets Control. Additionally, all employees must follow policies and procedures to minimize risk by exercising judgment, raising questions to management, and adhering to policy guidelines.

title: Education Consultant & Admissions Executive
description:
DR Pacific is looking for an Education Consultant & Admissions Executive to follow up with prospective clients, develop suitable education pathways, convert enquiries into signed clients, and manage the entire school application, visa application and enrolment process after signing.

The Company provides prospective client leads. This position does not primarily involve cold calling or sourcing new clients. However, the successful candidate must possess strong client follow-up, sales conversion, application management and customer service skills.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Client Follow-up and Conversion
  • Take over prospective clients after an education consultant has completed the follow-up consultation;
  • Assess each student’s educational background, academic goals and individual needs, and develop a suitable education pathway;
  • Maintain regular communication with students and parents and respond promptly to questions concerning schools, programmes, application procedures, service scope and fees;
  • Understand clients’ concerns and requirements, address their enquiries professionally, and guide them towards making informed decisions and signing up for the Company’s services;
  • Follow up on the signing of service agreements, payment arrangements and the relevant internal handover process;
  • Introduce suitable study-abroad, tuition, visa and other education-related service packages according to each client’s needs.

2. School Applications and Case Management

  • Complete the application handover process with students and parents after they sign the service agreement;
  • Prepare application timelines and document checklists;
  • Collect, review, organise and maintain students’ application documents;
  • Complete online application forms, submit supporting documents, respond to requests for additional documents, and monitor application progress;
  • Communicate with school admissions departments and follow up promptly on application outcomes and related notices;
  • Assist students with accepting offers, paying school fees and confirming their enrolment;
  • Ensure that all application documents are accurate, complete and submitted by the required deadlines.

3. Visa and Enrolment Services

  • Prepare, submit and follow up on Student’s Pass applications and relevant accompanying-parent or dependant pass applications;
  • Assist clients with preparing visa documents, responding to requests for additional information and completing subsequent formalities;
  • Follow up on medical examinations, insurance, registration and other pre-enrolment arrangements;
  • Provide students and parents with regular updates on school applications and visa progress;
  • Manage assigned student cases from signing through to successful enrolment and completion of service delivery.

4. Partner Agent Support

  • Receive and process student applications submitted by the Company’s partner agents;
  • Review application documents and promptly inform agents of any missing or additional documents required;
  • Respond to agents’ enquiries regarding school applications, visa applications and service procedures;
  • Provide agents with timely updates on application progress and admission outcomes;
  • Support the Company in maintaining positive and professional relationships with partner agents.

5. Customer Service and Internal Coordination

  • Maintain a high level of responsiveness during working hours. As a general service standard, acknowledge messages from clients or partner agents within five minutes;
  • Where an enquiry cannot be resolved immediately, acknowledge receipt and provide an estimated response time;
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date client follow-up records, application records and student files;
  • Proactively report important developments, potential issues and urgent matters;
  • Communicate and collaborate effectively with the consulting, marketing, finance and management teams;
  • Perform other related duties reasonably assigned by the Company.

Requirements

  • Diploma or higher qualification;
  • Prior experience in education consulting, client follow-up, education sales, school applications, visa processing or student services is preferred;
  • Candidates without relevant experience are welcome to apply, provided they are responsible, eager to learn and interested in developing a long-term career in the international education industry;
  • Strong written and verbal Chinese communication skills, as the position requires regular communication with Chinese-speaking students, parents and partner agents;
  • Good English reading, writing and communication skills, with the ability to understand documents issued by schools and government authorities and to write professional emails independently;
  • Strong customer service orientation, patience and a responsible attitude, with the ability to understand clients’ perspectives and resolve problems professionally;
  • Strong client follow-up and sales conversion skills;
  • Proactive, hardworking and willing to continuously learn about different schools, programmes and visa requirements;
  • Detail-oriented and well-organised, with the ability to manage multiple student cases and application deadlines concurrently;
  • Good time management, execution, multitasking and teamwork skills;
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace and commonly used online communication tools;
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment during peak application periods.

Salary and Benefits

  • Candidates without relevant experience: S$2,300–S$2,500 per month;
  • Candidates with relevant experience: S$2,800–S$3,000 per month;

title: Energy Efficiency & Demand Response Program Manager (Commercial or Residential)
description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Energy Efficiency / Demand Response Program Manager is responsible for leading one or more energy solution(s), program(s), or initiative(s) by collaborating with internal and external teams to meet annual regulatory kWh savings targets within budget while ensuring compliance with approved program implementation plans, regulatory requirements, internal controls, evaluation standards, and customer experience objectives. The position requires detailed knowledge of regulated customer programs, collaboration, contract management, budgeting, leadership of external vendors, the ability to plan strategically within a regulated framework, and the ability to effectively prioritize and execute on multiple simultaneous priorities.

MAJOR JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Management of at least one energy solution program or initiative to with accountability for participation, energy savings performance, customer satisfaction, program compliance, and achievement of regulatory targets within approved budgets.
  • Maintain the highest level of customer satisfaction through problem-solving, ethical decision making, and continuous improvement.
  • Assist with vendor contract development, onboard vendors when needed, establish infrastructure to support the program, monitor vendor performance, enforce contractual requirements, and implement a strategic business plan to achieve objectives and goals.
  • Effectively manage an external team and establish an engaging work environment by creatively motivating others to achieve desired goals and collaborate internally (including Marketing, Evaluation, Regulatory, Data Analytics, Customer Care, Legal, Supply Chain) and externally among a multi-disciplinary team for effective data tracking, reporting, and marketing.
  • Assess and mitigate risk by establishing and managing quality assurance and verification strategies, ensuring implementer vendors are held accountable to perform in accordance with contracts and in compliance with filed energy efficiency program implementation plans and other regulatory, internal and process requirements.
  • Develop, track, and communicate key performance indicators, forecasts, participation trends, budget impacts, and operational risks to management and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Assist with program design and evaluation efforts by engaging with the Southern Company Design and Evaluation team to provide valuable feedback and drive success.
  • Leverage relationships with external organizations (trade associations, community agencies, non-profits, local stakeholders, etc.) to educate about energy efficiency opportunities, empower the external organization to become a program ambassador, and drive program participation.
  • Manage program performance by proactively monitoring participation, savings, budget, customer experience, vendor delivery, and risk indicators; identify gaps early and implement corrective action plans to keep the program on track to meet annual goals.
  • Lead regular performance reviews with implementation vendor partners, using data, contract requirements, and program goals to drive accountability, resolve barriers, and improve outcomes.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve program design, delivery workflows, customer participation, contractor/vendor performance, reporting accuracy, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Lead issue resolution for escalated customer, contractor, vendor, or stakeholder concerns while balancing customer satisfaction, regulatory compliance, and prudent program administration.
  • Support regulatory filings, data requests, audits, EM&V activities, and stakeholder inquiries by providing accurate program information, performance narratives, supporting documentation and operational context.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Education & Experience

Minimum:

  • 4-year accredited degree preferred with additional consideration given for advanced degrees and/or relevant industry certifications, such as CDSM, BPI BA-T or BA-P, HERS Rater, REA, CEA, or CEM, etc.
  • Strong project and/or program management skills including strategic planning, budgeting, forecasting, the ability to develop and implement effective workflow and quality assurance / quality control processes.
  • Demonstrated experience leading or influencing across multiple organizations to achieve effective outcomes, regardless of the reporting relationship.

  • Knowledge of or experience with regulated energy efficiency or demand response programs and direct customer or contractor interaction.

Preferred:

  • Experience supporting regulatory filings, evaluations (EM&V), or Public Service Commission-related activities.
  • Experience reviewing and editing scopes of work and maintaining service level agreements through a working relationship with a third-party, preferred.
  • Working knowledge of quality assurance, compliance monitoring, audit readiness practices, and continuous improvement methodologies

Knowledge & Skills

Minimum:

  • Ability to work in a rapidly changing environment across multiple teams, with experience prioritizing time-sensitive projects and producing quality results while maintaining focus on performance, compliance, and customer experience.
  • Excellent communication skills (written, verbal, and visual/graphical) with the ability to prepare concise leadership updates, regulatory-facing narratives, vendor communications, and issue-resolution documentation and can effectively present to internal peers, leadership, and external partners.
  • Ability to be strategic and creative to improve processes and a proven track record of demonstrating critical thinking and problem-solving around complex issues.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze program data, identify trends or risks, assess root causes, and translate insights into practical action plans.
  • Working knowledge of energy efficiency and/or demand response program operations, including customer participation, contractor networks, incentive processing, quality assurance, reporting, and evaluation considerations.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft 365 Suite of applications including Outlook, Excel, Teams, PowerPoint, and Copilot.

Preferred:

  • Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, invoice review, accruals, cost-effectiveness awareness, and ability to manage program spend within approved budgets.
  • Strong vendor management skills, including the ability to set expectations, review performance, enforce contract requirements, document concerns, and drive accountability.
  • Ability to lead difficult conversations with implementation partners, contractors, internal stakeholders, or leadership in a professional, fact-based, and solution-oriented manner.

Behavioral Attributes

  • Role model of Our Values and Safety Excellence
  • Seen as a trusted individual due to depth of expertise and knowledge, confidence, decision making ability, consistency, honesty, and integrity.
  • Self-directed and resilient, with the ability to take initiative, work effectively both independently and in a team environment, remain focused in a fast-paced and regulated environment, and proactively identify opportunities to improve program effectiveness, operational efficiency, customer experience, and vendor performance.
  • Results-oriented and goal-driven, with a strong commitment to meeting or exceeding program targets while maintaining compliance, customer satisfaction, and fiscal responsibility.
  • Demonstrates sound judgment, professionalism, and emotional intelligence when managing conflict, performance concerns, customer issues, or vendor accountability discussions.

  • Ability to build effective partnerships inside Customer Experience, across functional boundaries, and externally able to motivate and influence others without positional leadership.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Business Development bij Engineero | MBA | Defense en Aerospace | Strategisch | Analytisch

Geïnteresseerd in deze functie? U vindt alle relevante informatie in de omschrijving hieronder.

Wij zijn Engineero, hét ingenieursbureau met een team van hoogopgeleide technische specialisten. Soms onzichtbaar, maar altijd een onmisbare schakel in de oplossingen van onze partners en de samenleving. Wij brengen ideeën tot leven!


Onze engineers zijn experts op de gebieden van mechanische engineering, elektrotechniek, industriële automatisering en/of applicatiesoftware. Binnen deze disciplines ligt onze toegevoegde waarde op engineering en projectmanagement.


Engineering vormt de vertaalslag tussen vraagstukken en hoe we innovatieve oplossingen kunnen realiseren. Het belangrijkste doel is dat de oplossing het leven van mensen makkelijker maakt.


Als Software Engineer werk je aan innovatieve en hoogwaardige softwareoplossingen die bijdragen aan digitale transformaties binnen uiteenlopende sectoren. Je ontwikkelt softwarecomponenten voor complexe applicaties en systemen waarin betrouwbaarheid, performance en veiligheid centraal staan. Je bent betrokken bij het volledige ontwikkelproces, van functionele analyse en ontwerp tot implementatie, testen en oplevering. Samen met je team denk je actief mee over architectuurkeuzes, systeemintegratie en optimalisatie. Je werkt binnen multidisciplinaire Agile/Scrum-teams, waarin samenwerking, kwaliteit en innovatie vanzelfsprekend zijn. Dankzij jouw analytisch vermogen en technische inzicht pak je vraagstukken over efficiëntie, schaalbaarheid en doorlooptijd met vertrouwen aan. Je streeft naar robuuste en onderhoudbare oplossingen die in de praktijk écht het verschil maken.


Als echte Engineero ben je een proactieve teamplayer die de behoefte van de klant centraal stelt en altijd gaat voor kwaliteit. Samen met je collega’s werk je aan innovatieve softwareoplossingen binnen uitdagende hightech projecten. Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt softwarecomponenten in Java en/of C++, denkt actief mee over softwarearchitecturen en draagt bij aan een efficiënte systeemintegratie. Daarbij maak je gebruik van moderne ontwikkelmethodieken zoals Agile en CI/CD. Je test, analyseert en verbetert continu de kwaliteit en performance van de software, en werkt nauw samen met andere specialisten om tot de beste technologische oplossingen te komen.


Wat breng je mee?



  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in Software Engineering, Informatica of een vergelijkbare richting;
  • Ervaring met softwareontwikkeling in Java en/of C++;
  • Bekend met moderne ontwikkeltools zoals Git, Jenkins, Maven of CMake;
  • Kennis van softwarearchitectuur, design patterns en objectgeoriënteerde principes;
  • Ervaring met Agile/Scrum en CI/CD-omgevingen;
  • Analytisch, leergierig en gericht op kwaliteit;
  • Je vindt samenwerken vanzelfsprekend, maar neemt ook zelfstandig initiatief.

Wat bieden wij jou


Bij Engineero kom je te werken in een professionele en groeiende organisatie waar het draait om mens en technologie. Met passie zetten onze specialisten zich in voor technologische vooruitgang. Wij bieden een breed scala aan innovatieve projecten voor uiteenlopende markten. De projecten waaraan je werkt verschillen qua doorlooptijd. De afwisseling tussen de projecten is groot. Het kan zelfs zo zijn dat je tegelijkertijd aan meerdere projecten werkt voor verschillende opdrachtgevers. Je moet flexibel en avontuurlijk ingesteld zijn.


Als onderdeel van een (multidisciplinair) team word jij uitgedaagd om jouw talenten, technische kennis- en kunde in te zetten en lever je een waardevolle bijdrage. Wij bieden je daarin de ondersteuning die jij nodig hebt. Dit geeft jou de kans het maximale uit jezelf te halen en te ontwikkelen of door te groeien.


Engineero is een professionele organisatie met korte lijnen en een open & collegiale sfeer. Goed werkgeverschap en persoonlijke ontwikkeling zijn een van onze speerpunten. Wij bieden je een dynamische werkomgeving waar vooruitgang, innovatie en (persoonlijke) ontwikkeling centraal staan en waarbij we open staan voor jouw frisse input & ervaringen. Als onderdeel van het Engineero team word je ondersteund en steeds opnieuw uitgedaagd. Engineering draait bij ons om mensen: het is een gevolg van menselijk inspanning. Gemaakt voor mensen, door mensen.


Kortom, wat mag je van ons verwachten:



  • Een prettige werkomgeving in een ambitieus team waarbij jouw frisse input en ervaring erg gewaardeerd wordt;
  • Gevarieerde werkzaamheden als gevolg van afwisseling in technologieën, markten en projecten;
  • Aandacht voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling en (groei) ambities. Denk hierbij aan interne opleidingen, coaching en een eigen ontwikkelbudget, wij investeren écht in mensen;
  • Jaarlijks worden er binnen je team brainstormsessies en kennisevents georganiseerd, we vinden het namelijk belangrijk dat onze Enginero’s op de hoogte zijn van de laatste ontwikkelingen binnen het vakgebied;
  • Een open cultuur gericht op samenwerken, leren en plezier maken;
  • Wij werken onder het motto "iedere dag maken we er een feest van". Successen - groot of klein - vieren we samen;
  • De mogelijkheid om hybride te werken, in een gezonde combinatie van thuis en op kantoor;
  • Goede pensioenregeling;
  • Een leaseauto of reiskostenvergoeding, conform voorwaarden van Engineero;
  • 29 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime (40 uur) dienstverband;
  • Deelname aan het a.s.r. Vitality programma;
  • Een actieve personeelsvereniging;
  • Het hoofdkantoor van Engineero in Enschede (gevestigd op het kennispark) en het kantoor in Groningen zijn goed bereikbaar met het OV en de auto.

Ben jij na het lezen enthousiast geworden? Dan zien wij graag jouw sollicitatie tegemoet.


1. Stuur een up-to-date CV en motivatie naar ons.


2. Binnen 2 werkdagen nemen wij contact met je op.


3. Er volgt een kennismakingsgesprek. xgiwjmb


4. Een assessment kan onderdeel uitmaken van de sollicitatieprocedure.

description:

title: QA Test Engineer
description:
QA Test Engineer – Full-time, Permanent

Location: Poole, Dorset (4 days per week onsite)

Salary: £35-40,000 per annum, negotiable depending on experience, plus benefits


The Opportunity:


If you work in QA, you may know how frustrating it is to be brought in at the end of a project, handed a release, and expected to find everything that could go wrong without having had the opportunity to influence it earlier.


This role offers something more involving.


You’ll join an established software company that is investing in modern development tools and testing approaches. Working closely with developers, product specialists and DevOps throughout the Agile delivery cycle, you’ll help shape test coverage, identify risks, and improve how quality is built into complex software. Not simply check it at the end.


The work spans web, mobile and API-based applications, combining thoughtful manual and exploratory testing with automation. With varied projects, technically interesting problems, and software used at scale, this is an opportunity to keep learning while making a visible contribution to the reliability, security and performance of the product.


Why This Role Stands Out:


  • Salary is competitive and negotiable, up to around £40,000 per annum depending on experience
  • Annual salary reviews with regular market benchmarking
  • Hybrid working – 1 day per week remote from home
  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
  • Pension scheme with employer contribution and matched enhancements
  • Health Cash Plan including 24/7 GP access, dental and optical cover
  • Death in Service cover (4x salary)
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Paid volunteering days
  • Discretionary bonus
  • Comfortable, modern open-plan office
  • Team and company social events
  • Autonomy, trust and long-term career progression
  • Structured training and development opportunities to help you grow
  • Supportive, team-focused culture that values your ideas and achievements


Why This QA Test Engineer Role May Appeal


  • Quality is treated as a shared responsibility, with close collaboration across QA, development, product and DevOps.
  • You’ll work across manual, exploratory and automated testing rather than being confined to repetitive regression testing.
  • The company has ambitious plans to modernise its development tools and testing approaches, giving you scope to contribute ideas and improve how things are done.
  • Projects vary, so you’ll gain exposure to different technical challenges across web, mobile, APIs, databases and cloud-based environments.
  • You’ll be trusted to investigate problems properly, communicate risk clearly, and follow defects through to resolution.
  • Structured training, development and long-term career progression will support you in expanding your technical capability.
  • You’ll join a stable, growing business with a supportive culture that recognises ideas, initiative and achievement.


What You Need:


  • A strong understanding of QA methodologies and the software testing lifecycle.
  • Hands-on experience of both manual and automated testing across web, mobile and/or API environments.
  • The ability to create structured test cases and communicate defects and test outcomes clearly.
  • Experience managing test plans and defects within a modern software development workflow.
  • SQL knowledge for database validation and testing.
  • Experience working within an Agile or Scrum environment.
  • Familiarity with tools or technologies such as Jira, Postman, Selenium and AWS would be useful.


You don’t need to match every preferred technology listed above. If you have strong testing fundamentals, an investigative mindset and the appetite to broaden your skills, the company would still be interested in hearing from you.


Why You Should Apply:


If you enjoy investigating the unexpected, asking the questions others may miss, and helping teams release software with greater confidence, this could be an interesting next move for you.


Apply now or contact me for a confidential, no-pressure conversation to find out more.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Hybrid onsite (2-4 Days/week in office): Charlestown, MA


Build the engine behind grid intelligence, from raw sensor data to the ratings that utilities act on.


We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our Applications (LineRate) team and build full-stack systems that turn massive time-series sensor data into the ratings our utility customers rely on. You will work across the ratings generation library, our customer-deployable product, weather modeling tools, and the front end visualizations that surface it all. If you want to own hard technical problems end-to-end and help shape how utilities get affordable, reliable power onto the grid, join us at LineVision, Built In Boston Best Places to Work!


What will you do?

Core Responsibilities and Key Performance Objectives

  • Collaborate with data scientists to productionalize core computational functionality, turning research code into reliable, scalable services.
  • Work with UI/UX teams to design and build APIs that surface the right data at the right time.
  • Design efficient storage and retrieval strategies for massive time-series data sets.
  • Contribute across our core codebases: the ratings generation library and its microservice, the slimmed-down customer-deployable product, weather modeling tools, and front end visualizations.
  • Advise product on roadmap priorities, balancing customer benefit against time to implement.

Within the first 3 months:

  • Ship meaningful contributions to at least one core codebase (ratings library, customer product, weather modeling, or front end) with minimal guidance.
  • Build working relationships with data science and UI/UX counterparts and understand how the codebases connect.
  • Demonstrate command of our Python/TypeScript stack and time-series data patterns.

Within the first 6 months:

  • Own an end-to-end feature that spans backend logic and the APIs or UI that expose it.
  • Contribute a concrete improvement to how we store or retrieve time-series data at scale.
  • Participate in roadmap discussions, bringing a technical point of view on feasibility and tradeoffs.

Within the first year:

  • Become a go-to resource for at least one core codebase, trusted with architectural decisions.
  • Lead a cross-functional initiative with data science or UI/UX from scoping through delivery.
  • Mentor at least one other engineer through code review, pairing, and consistent feedback.


How to succeed in this role

Key Competencies

  • Critical Thinking: Analyze complex problems in ratings generation, weather modeling, or time-series storage independently and propose sound solutions. Demonstrate a curious mindset in exploring new approaches.
  • Delivering Innovative Solutions: Devise and iterate on technical solutions with a growth mindset. Bring creative, well-reasoned approaches to novel problems across the stack.
  • Taking Ownership: Lead projects with minimal supervision, taking full ownership of outcomes. Communicate proactively when scope or technical constraints shift.
  • Follow Through – Execution: Deliver quality work on time. Resolve open questions proactively with stakeholders and hold yourself accountable to team commitments.
  • Empowering Others: Mentor junior engineers and share knowledge freely. Foster a supportive team environment where outcomes matter more than individual output.

Essential Skills

  • Proficiency in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript, with working experience in React.
  • Experience with at least one relational database and one NoSQL database.
  • Experience deploying and operating on a major cloud platform.
  • Comfort working across the stack, from data storage through APIs to UI.

What Sets the Best Candidates Apart

  • Experience with Kubernetes.
  • Experience with Rust.
  • Experience working with large-scale time-series data sets.
  • Background collaborating closely with data science or applied science teams to productionize research code.

Reporting & Team Structure

  • Reports to the Senior Software Engineering Manager
  • Collaborates closely with Data Science, UI/UX, and Product teams.

Interview Process

  • Apply Online.
  • Round 1: Phone screen (Recruiter)
  • Round 2: Hiring Manager Interview
  • Round 3: Panel Interviews
    • Panel 1: Technical competency & experience
    • Panel 2: Teamwork, collaboration and communication
  • Final Round: Leadership Team & Hiring Manager Sign-Off (onsite)


What does joining LineVision mean for you?

  • Impact. Your talent, time, and energy will critically impact our success in accelerating our mission of providing utilities with grid intelligence to enable affordable, reliable power.
  • Ownership. You will hold broad responsibilities with high autonomy and trust in a communicative, collaborative, and fast-paced environment.
  • Flexibility. You will be empowered to maintain work-life balance with trust-based PTO and a flexible hybrid work schedule.
  • Real World Innovation. You will join a motivated and high-performing team working with cutting edge, patented technology to help solve key obstacles to meet the demands of an AI-powered future.


Who we are...

LineVision is a grid-enhancing technology company enabling electric utilities to deliver affordable, reliable power and accelerate the electrification of the global economy. Our grid intelligence platform delivers the most accurate, network-wide dynamic line ratings and enables safer, more reliable grid operations with a combination of optical sensors and advanced environmental modeling. LineVision's global customer base includes eight of the ten largest US utilities, including National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon.

We are LineVisionaries:

  • We are Innovators: we light the way with tenacious creativity and do good work.
  • We are Empowered: With high trust and high autonomy, the floor is yours, and the opportunity is ours.
  • We are Welcoming: Come as you are, our doors are open. We are better together.
  • We are Trusted Partners: We elevate our customer champions through shared thought leadership. We deliver on commitments.
  • We are All In: We are building a community of passionate individuals who want to dent the universe.


At LineVision there's no such thing as a "perfect" candidate. We are looking for exceptional people who want to make a positive impact through their work and facilitate an organization where everyone can thrive. So whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this role would make you excited to come to work every day.


LineVision embraces AI, and we understand leveraging AI in your job search. As an actual member of LineVision's hiring team reviews every application, we kindly ask that any final materials you submit reflect your own voice and authentic human experience.


Meet our team, and understand our mission:
