title: Asset Protection Detective, Rockaway Town Square - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an Asset Protection Detective, you will help protect company assets, reduce shortage, and support a safe, customer-focused shopping environment. Using surveillance, investigative tools, and strong partnerships with store teams and law enforcement, you will identify and respond to theft, recover merchandise, and help protect our customers, colleagues, and business.

Why This Role Matters

Asset Protection Detectives play an important role in reducing loss while maintaining a safe and welcoming store environment. Through training, observation, investigation, and de-escalation, this role helps protect company assets, support colleagues, and ensure customers can shop with confidence.

How Our Asset Protection Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Our colleagues begin each day energized and ready to make an impact. They greet teammates with a warm hello. Before they get started, they review updates and department information so they're fully informed and ready to engage with confidence.

  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.

  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

What To Expect

  • Use surveillance techniques, investigative tools, and reporting systems to help identify theft, dishonest activity, and shortage trends.

  • Partner with Asset Protection leaders, store teams, and law enforcement to support investigations and protect company assets.

  • Apply de-escalation tools and sound judgment to help maintain a safe environment for customers and colleagues.

  • Prepare clear documentation, statements, and evidence to support investigations, audits, and legal proceedings.

  • Support team readiness by training colleagues on protocols that help protect company assets.

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Help protect customers, colleagues, and company assets by identifying, investigating, and responding to theft and dishonest activity.

  • Use surveillance techniques to support the apprehension of shoplifters and dishonest employees, while following company policies and legal requirements.

  • Recover stolen merchandise and provide statements, evidence, and documentation to support investigations.

  • Prepare timely and accurate reports related to theft incidents, investigations, audits, and assigned activities.

  • Build strong partnerships with store colleagues, Asset Protection leaders, and law enforcement to support investigations and shortage reduction.

  • Maintain compliance with company policies and legal standards related to apprehensions, searches, and evidence preservation.

  • Testify in court for criminal and civil cases, as needed.

  • Respond to alarm calls, support special assignments, and facilitate first aid for customers and colleagues when needed.

  • Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships with colleagues, customers, and communities.

Skills That Matter

Must Have

  • Ability to observe, identify, and respond to suspicious activity in a retail environment.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to partner effectively with customers, colleagues, leaders, and law enforcement.

  • Ability to use sound judgment, de-escalation tools, and company procedures to support a safe environment.

  • Ability to handle proprietary, sensitive, and confidential information with discretion and integrity.

  • For jobs in New York, a current New York State Security Guard License is required.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in retail, customer service, asset protection, security, investigations, or law enforcement.

  • Ability to prepare accurate reports, statements, and documentation related to incidents and investigations.

  • Experience using surveillance systems, reporting tools, or investigative technology.

  • Ability to train or coach colleagues on asset protection protocols, shortage reduction, or safety practices.

Physical Activities You Will Perform

  • This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities.

  • Position requires prolonged periods of standing/walking around store or department.

  • May occasionally involve reaching above eye level, stooping, kneeling, or crouching.

  • Must be able to apprehend shoplifters.

  • Ability to sustain long periods of time enclosed in surveillance areas.

  • Frequently lift/move up to 30lbs.

  • Requires close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

This job description is not all-inclusive and may not apply to colleagues covered by a collective bargaining agreement. Macy's Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.

Our client is developing infrastructure that makes moving and using value across blockchain networks simpler, faster and more intuitive. Its technology connects multiple sources of funds and payment methods, removing much of the complexity traditionally associated with onchain transactions.

This is an opportunity to join a highly technical engineering team building transaction infrastructure where performance, reliability and user experience are critical.

The Role

As a Backend Engineer, you will design and build the systems powering payments, settlement, transaction routing and asset conversion across multiple networks and providers.

You’ll work on high-performance APIs and distributed backend services, contribute to core architectural decisions, and build new systems from the ground up in a fast-moving engineering environment.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build and maintain high-performance APIs and backend services.
  • Build systems supporting payments, settlement, transaction routing, asset conversion and identity/security flows.
  • Develop infrastructure capable of operating reliably across multiple networks and providers.
  • Build new backend capabilities that improve product performance, conversion and reliability.
  • Participate in system design, architecture reviews and technical decision-making.
  • Improve the scalability, reliability and fault tolerance of production systems.
  • Contribute to incident response, code reviews, testing and engineering standards.
  • Take ownership of projects from initial design through production deployment.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience building production backend systems using a modern programming language.
  • Proficiency in TypeScript, or strong experience with Go or Rust and a clear willingness to work primarily in TypeScript.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, API design and database architecture.
  • Hands‑on experience with cloud infrastructure, Docker, Kubernetes or comparable containerized environments.
  • Strong computer science fundamentals across algorithms, data structures and systems design.
  • Ability to take ownership and build effectively with limited scaffolding in a fast‑moving environment.
  • Comfortable working through ambiguity and solving complex engineering problems independently.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building payment, settlement, transaction routing or other high-volume transactional systems.
  • Experience with blockchain, Web3 or other distributed financial infrastructure.
  • Experience building products or systems from zero rather than primarily maintaining established platforms.
  • Previous experience in a startup or highly autonomous engineering environment.

About Swiss Nexus

Swiss Nexus is a Switzerland-based specialist talent partner working across blockchain, Web3 and fintech. We connect ambitious companies with hard-to-find engineering, product, commercial, compliance and leadership talent across Switzerland and globally.

title: Health & Wellness Coordinator
description:
Health & Wellness Coordinator - Full Time

Location: Parma, OH


Make a Difference Where Students Need It Most


Are you passionate about helping children and adolescents thrive both emotionally and academically? Join our team as a Health & Wellness Coordinator and make a lasting impact by supporting students' mental health, emotional well-being, and success in the classroom.

In this school-based role, you'll work alongside educators, administrators, families, and behavioral health professionals to provide prevention, intervention, and case management services that help students overcome barriers to learning and reach their full potential.

If you're looking for meaningful work in a collaborative environment where every day brings the opportunity to change lives, we'd love to hear from you.


Role Responsibility:

As a Health & Wellness Coordinator, you will:

  • Provide individual and group prevention and intervention services that promote students' social, emotional, and behavioral well-being.
  • Assess students' emotional functioning, behavioral concerns, support systems, safety needs, and barriers to academic success.
  • Develop and implement behavior support and intervention plans that encourage positive outcomes and self-determination.
  • Facilitate skill-building and psychoeducational groups for at-risk students.
  • Partner with teachers, school staff, and families to address concerns such as truancy, social withdrawal, disruptive behaviors, and the impact of family or environmental stressors.
  • Respond to crises, provide verbal de-escalation, and assess student safety when needed.
  • Advocate for students and connect families with appropriate school and community resources.
  • Provide case management services, including referrals, care coordination, and collaboration with outside providers.
  • Conduct home visits and community outreach as appropriate.
  • Participate as an active member of a multidisciplinary team supporting student success.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum Bachelor's degree in Psychology, Social Work, Human Services, or a related field.
  • Master's Degree and Professional License preferred.
  • Two or more years of experience working in behavioral health, social services, education, or a related field.
  • Current Ohio prevention credential (OCPSA, OCPS, or OCPC), or willingness to obtain the credential within the first year of employment.
  • Ability to obtain Registered Applicant status within 90 days if not currently credentialed.
  • Valid Ohio driver's license and reliable transportation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in a school-based setting.
  • Experience facilitating groups for children or adolescents.
  • Knowledge of child development, trauma-informed care, and behavioral interventions.

Knowledge and Skills

We're looking for someone who is:

  • Passionate about supporting youth and families.
  • Organized, dependable, and able to manage multiple priorities.
  • Skilled at building positive relationships with students, families, educators, and community partners.
  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating with a multidisciplinary team.
  • Calm and confident in crisis situations.
  • Committed to maintaining confidentiality and practicing with professionalism and integrity.
  • Proficient with electronic documentation and Microsoft Office applications.


Physical Requirements

This position regularly requires sitting, standing, walking, speaking, hearing, and working on a computer. Occasional lifting of up to 10 pounds may be required. Reasonable accommodations may be made for qualified individuals with disabilities.


Why Join Our Team?

At Red Oak Behavioral Health, we believe that supporting our employees allows them to better support the children and families we serve. We offer:

  • Meaningful work that makes a difference every day
  • Collaborative and supportive team environment
  • Opportunities for professional development and credentialing
  • Ongoing training and supervision
  • Competitive compensation
  • Comprehensive benefits package for eligible employees, including health, dental, vision, retirement, paid time off, and more

Apply Today!

If you're passionate about helping students build resilience, improve emotional well-being, and succeed both inside and outside the classroom, we'd love to meet you. Apply today and become part of a team dedicated to strengthening children, families, and our community.

title: Special Procedures Technologist, Cath Lab (Full-time regular, Day Shift)
description:
Central to all that California has to offer, Adventist Health Bakersfield has been providing an extraordinary team of world-class physicians, top-notch medical technology, caring professionals and award-winning quality since 1910. We are comprised of a 254-bed acute care hospital and 20 primary and specialty care medical offices. As one of America's fastest growing cities, Bakersfield offers affordable housing on the West Coast, beautiful weather, high-quality education and it is just a few hours away from Yosemite and Sequoia National Parks, the Central California Coast and Southern California's great sports, theaters, concerts and amusement parks.

Job Summary:

Performs, assists, and completes Cardiac and Vascular Radiographic examinations. Performs active radiographic interventional procedures in the cardiovascular lab using a variety of complicated and sophisticated equipment. Operates equipment to produce digital images of designated body portions, as ordered by physicians. Positions and instructs patients for examinations and performs specialized studies.

Job Requirements:

Education and Work Experience:

  • Associate’s Degree or equivalent combination of education/related experience: Preferred
  • Bachelor’s Degree in radiologic technology or equivalent (some certifications will require Bachelor’s): Preferred
  • Experience in Cath Lab or Special Procedures: Preferred

Licenses/Certifications:

  • American Registry of Radiologic Technologists (ARRT) certification: Preferred
  • Radiologic Tech (RT) in the state of practice: Required
  • Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) certification or Basic Life Support (BLS) certification from approved vendor per AH policy: Required

Facility Specific License/Certifications:

  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification from approved vendor per AH policy: Required

Essential Functions:

  • Operates diagnostic imaging equipment to produce contrast enhanced radiographs of heart and cardiovascular system (Angio cardiograms), during cardiac catheterization, to aid physician in diagnostic evaluation and treatment: positions and immobilizes patient on examining table, using head and shoulder braces and following specified protocols.
  • Assists physicians with specialized procedures, including special exams. Enters technical factors determined by protocol such as amount and quality of radiation beam, and specified filming sequence, into computer. Raises and lowers examining table and manipulates and positions x-ray tube in response to instructions from physician. Starts automatic injection of contrast medium into blood vessels of patient. Activates fluoroscope and motion picture camera (cinefluorography) to produce images that assist physician in guiding catheter through cardiovascular system of patient.
  • Provides patients with procedure explanations in preparation for exams and provides clear discharge instructions. Observes gauges, recorder, and video screens of multichannel data analysis system that indicates blood pressure, cardiac output, and respiration, during imaging of cardiovascular system. Alerts physician to changes in patient responses.
  • Monitors and controls environmental factors, like temperature, humidity and electrical safety. Assists physician in interventional procedures, such as instilling enzymes or inserting balloon in blood vessels to remove plaque or other blockage.
  • Maintains accurate and updated documentation, adhering with program standards.
  • Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

Organizational Requirements:

Adventist Health is committed to the safety and wellbeing of our associates and patients. Therefore, we require that all associates receive all required vaccinations as a condition of employment and annually thereafter, where applicable. Medical and religious exemptions may apply.

Adventist Health participates in E-Verify. Visit https://adventisthealth.org/careers/everify/ for more information about E-Verify. By choosing to apply, you acknowledge that you have accessed and read the E-Verify Participation and Right to Work notices and understand the contents therein.

title: Udviklingsingeniør
description:
Combilent er en mindre, entreprenant virksomhed, der specialiserer sig i design og produktion af højtydende løsninger inden for Land Mobile Radio. Combilent er den foretrukne leverandør af komponenter til kritisk kommunikation for alle de største OEM’er i USA og Europa og leverer premium og højt avancerede komponenter til kommunikationsudstyr, der anvendes af beredskabsaktører som politi og alarmcentraler. Som en del af Indutrade-koncernen – et svensk investeringsselskab med et stort netværk af tekniske virksomheder – nyder Combilent også godt af koncernens solide markedsposition og langsigtede tilgang til forretning, hvor der satses på vækst og stærk støtte til koncernens virksomheder. Vi har til huse i Farum, nord for København, og søger nu en:

Udviklingsingeniør

Analog og digitalt kredsløbsdesign

Produktudvikling fra idé til produktion

Som vores nye udviklingsingeniør bliver du en del af udviklingsafdelingen, hvor vi udvikler produkter, som indholder analog/digital elektronik, software, højfrekvensdesign (HF) og mekanik. Du indgår i et tæt team på 6-7 kolleger med mange års erfaring, og du får ansvar for dit eget kredsløbsdesign fra første streg på papiret til det færdige produkt ude hos kunden. Der er tale om et specialiseret team, og du arbejder selvstændigt med afgrænsede opgaver, men altid i tæt dialog og samarbejde med kollegerne inden for HF, mekanik og software. Dine kommende kolleger er meget erfarne indenfor andre specialområder, så der er gode udviklingsmuligheder for den rigtige person.

Dine ansvarsområder

Der vil være gode muligheder for at forme rollen, men du vil blandt andet få ansvar for:

  • Design, diagram og printudlæg af analog/digital kredsløb som del af et større system, der skal sameksistere med højfrekvenselektronik og andre designs – vi anvender Altium
  • Beregning og design af komplekse systemer
  • Udvikling af nye produkter, typisk 3-5 nye designs om året, i tæt samarbejde med kolleger inden for software, mekanik og HF
  • Sikre at dit design kan testes og produceres, herunder udvikle testfixtures/test-jigs til dine egne kredsløb
  • Deltage i hele processen fra specifikation og udvikling til test, frem til den endelige produktion
  • Vedligeholdelse af eksisterende produkter, f.eks. udskiftning af udgåede komponenter og efterfølgende re-test eller redesign
  • Tæt samarbejde med mekanikdesigneren om 3D-tegninger og den fysiske integration af elektronikken
  • Dokumentere alt designarbejde og deltage i en fast review-proces, hvor du forklarer og argumenterer for dine tekniske valg
  • Sikre at dine designs overholder interne og eksterne designregler, herunder krav til elektrisk støj (EMC) og deklarering af stoffer i komponenterne
  • Anvende og betjene måleudstyr
  • Deltage i ugentlige prioriteringsmøder samt projektmøder for de større projekter
  • Navigere den iterative dialog med kollegaer (“ping-pong”-processen) for at afstemme krav og nå frem til en endelig løsning
  • Bidrage til virksomhedens arbejde med at standardisere testplatforme

Vi forestiller os, at du har følgende kvalifikationer, kompetencer og erfaring.

Det er ikke uddannelsen, men interessen for og erfaring med elektronik, der er afgørende – du har dog nok en uddannelsesmæssig baggrund som ingeniør eller anden teknisk baggrund. Du kan designe komplekse kredsløb, og du har en interesse for analoge og digitale kredsløb. Personligt er du ærlig omkring din egen viden, god til at give og modtage konstruktiv feedback, og du trives med at arbejde selvstændigt på afgrænsede opgaver – samtidig med at du har lyst til at nørde med tekniske detaljer på tværs af afdelinger. Hvis du har erfaring med grundlæggende projektledelse er det et ekstra plus.

Hvad vi tilbyder

Vi tilbyder en lønpakke, der matcher dine kvalifikationer, herunder pension. Mindst lige så vigtigt tilbyder vi spændende faglige udfordringer og et team, der værdsætter åbenhed og godt samarbejde, samt en kultur, hvor vi behandler hinanden godt. Du får en central rolle i en mindre, innovativ virksomhed med 3-5 nye designprojekter om året, kort vej fra idé til handling, og gode muligheder for din egen faglige udvikling.

Ansøgning og kontakt

Ansættelsesprocessen varetages i samarbejde med Brinch & Partners. Hvis du ønsker at vide mere om denne mulighed og virksomheden, er du velkommen til at kontakte Partner Martin Bo Sørensen på telefon +45 27847406.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning hurtigst muligt via “Ansøg”-knappen nedenfor.

description:

title: DevOps Engineer (Cloud Platform & Infrastructure)
description:
We are seeking a pioneering DevOps Engineer to build our software delivery ecosystem. While our business has decades of financial expertise, our internal software engineering function is a brand-new, founding-team initiative. You will help architect our greenfield Azure cloud platform , collaborate with the vendor on deployment infrastructure, and help set the operational and security foundations for the agentic AI capability Providend is building over time. This is a genuine zero-to-one opportunity: broader ownership and faster growth than a typical DevOps role at a larger organization.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Container & Cluster Orchestration: Architect, secure, and manage containerized workloads using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) or Azure Container Apps (ACA) to host software services and agentic infrastructure.
  • Edge Security & Routing: Manage global networking, secure application perimeters, and DNS management using Cloudflare , in coordination with Providend Technology's existing Entra ID / Conditional Access controls - designed as a complementary layer, not a duplicate identity plane.
  • Zero Trust Access Control: Manage Cloudflare Access (Zero Trust) to enforce strict, identity-aware access controls for internal tools, APIs, and sandboxed environments without relying on traditional VPNs.
  • Vendor Collaboration & Knowledge Transfer: Work closely with the external CRM development vendor to architect deployment infrastructure and plan the eventual phase-out of their services.
  • CI/CD Pipeline Automation: Build and maintain deployment pipelines, incorporating agentic automation for routine, non-critical operations (code review support, release branching, environment promotions for non-financial-critical services).
  • Infrastructure Guardrails for Financial Systems: Apply rigorous change management and rollback discipline to any infrastructure supporting business-critical proprietary system. Autonomous agent-applied fixes are permitted for non-critical infrastructure any remediation touching the business-critical system's deployment or infrastructure path requires human approval before execution.
  • Growth Area - AI Infrastructure: As Providend's agentic AI capability matures, this role will grow to include operating LLMOps tooling and hosting MCP servers on our Azure platform. No prior experience required - training and mentorship will be provided as this expands.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Experience Level: 4-6 years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability, or Cloud Infrastructure roles.
  • Azure Cloud Expertise: Solid proficiency provisioning and operating AKS or ACA , and Infrastructure as Code( Terraform / OpenTofu ).
  • Production Infrastructure for Financial Platforms: Experience operating and securing production cloud infrastructure that hosts financial or transactional systems - deployment pipelines, monitoring, and incident response for environments where downtime or a bad deploy can affect live client-money systems. Comfortable working within strict change-control and rollback discipline, even without owning the underlying data architecture.
  • Zero Trust & Edge Networking: Hands-on experience with Cloudflare (or equivalent) for DNS, edge security, and Zero Trust access control.
  • Programming & Scripting Proficiency: Solid coding skills in Python, Go, or JavaScript proficiency in Linux Shell scripting (Bash) and YAML for CI/CD workflow orchestration.
  • Founding Team Mindset: High adaptability for a 'zero-to-one' small team environment, with the communication skills needed to manage vendor handovers.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with MAS Technology Risk Management (TRM) guidelines, change management, or data residency requirements in a financial services / MAS-regulated environment.
  • Exposure to, or willingness to learn, LLMOps platforms (e.g. Langfuse, LangSmith, Braintrust, Humanloop, Arize Phoenix) covering observability, LLM evaluation, and prompt management.
  • Interest in developing fluency with modern AI-assisted engineering tools, such as Cursor or Claude's feature set (Claude Code, Projects, Artifacts).
  • Exposure to LLM-based code review tooling in CI/CD(e.g. Claude Code Review, CodeRabbit, or equivalent).
  • Experience managing vendor transitions or insourcing software capabilities.
  • Background working in financial services or fintech environments.

title: Health & Safety Engineer Construction, AWS Data Centers
description:
Description

THIS ROLE CAN BE BASED IN DUBLIN OR LONDON CORPORATE OFFICE LOCATIONS OF AMAZON.

Join the world-class safety culture at Amazon Web Services (AWS) and be part of building the foundation of a new safety framework across EMEA. As the Construction Safety Manager – New Sites & Regions (EMEA), you will play a pivotal role in establishing and scaling the Health and Safety function for new data center sites and regions across EMEA, working at the forefront of AWS's most ambitious infrastructure expansion efforts.

This is a ground-floor opportunity to architect a safety framework from scratch. You will be the critical link between Pre-Construction and Construction teams, ensuring that Health & Safety is embedded into every phase of site and regional expansion — from site selection through to handover. As AWS expands into new sites and regions, new General Contractors (GCs) are being onboarded with limited safety infrastructure in place. You will be the driving force behind building the pipelines, programs, and resources needed to bring these GCs up to AWS's world-class safety standards, regardless of where in EMEA that site sits.

You will work closely with experts in construction management, senior leadership, operations, corporate counsel, and human resources to build and deliver a robust, scalable safety program that works for both established and entirely new markets. You must be an effective communicator — sending clear, concise, and consistent messages verbally, in written form, and in public speaking forums. The right candidate must be equally comfortable in the field and in the boardroom — influencing without authority, building from scratch, and communicating clearly at all organisational levels. You will report to the Regional H&S Manager (EMEA DCPD) and will be responsible for creating lasting safety infrastructure that protects our people and enables rapid, safe growth across new sites and regions. Some domestic and international travel is required.

Key Job Responsibilities

  • Build and own the EMEA Construction Safety Framework for new sites and regions, designing scalable safety systems, standards, and processes for both Pre-Construction and Construction phases where none currently exist.
  • Establish and deploy a GC Safety Onboarding Pipeline — create the structure, tools, and compliance processes needed to bring new General Contractors operating across new EMEA sites and regions up to AWS safety standards, including CSMP reviews, safety kickoffs, Avetta onboarding, and ongoing performance reviews.
  • Create and deliver site‑specific safety plans, programs, and resources tailored to new GCs and new market environments, including emergency response plans, risk assessment frameworks, and training programs adapted to local regulatory requirements.
  • Bridge the gap between Pre‑Construction and Construction teams, establishing a consistent and systematic approach to Health & Safety that gives both teams the system and support they currently lack when engaging new GCs in new EMEA sites and regions.
  • Conduct Construction Risk Area (CRA) inspections and H&S audits across all active DCPD projects at new and emerging EMEA sites, ensuring compliance with AWS H&S requirements, life safety requirements, and applicable local regulations.
  • Own incident management and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) quality across new EMEA sites, ensuring incidents are investigated thoroughly, corrective actions are closed on time, and learnings are fed back into program development.
  • Deliver consistent WBR and MBR reporting with actionable trend analysis, translating leading and lagging safety indicators into clear narratives for cluster and regional leadership.
  • Develop program documentation, SOPs, and playbooks for newly established safety programs, ensuring they are repeatable, scalable, and transferable to future new EMEA sites and regions.
  • Consult and partner with the AWS H&S Program Team and legal teams for regulatory interpretations and guidance, ensuring all new site frameworks align with global standards while meeting or exceeding local EMEA regulatory requirements.
  • Drive H&S culture across DCPD teams through consistent field presence, stakeholder engagement, and data‑led safety initiatives — fostering a safety culture that travels with AWS into every new market it enters.

About the Team

title: Backend Engineer
description:
About the Role:

We are looking for experienced professionals with a passion for excellence to design and implement new systems and features, as well as modify and maintain existing systems with adaptation to technological changes. You will drive the software change and release management processes, assisting with the overall maturity of the software development lifecycle. You will ensure that software deliverables comply with quality standards and are completed on time.

What will be your responsibilities?

  • Developing server-side logic: As a Node.js developer, your primary responsibility is to develop the server-side logic for web applications. This involves writing code in JavaScript that can handle incoming requests, process data, and generate responses.
  • Building scalable applications: Node.js is known for its ability to handle high traffic and large amounts of data. As a Node.js developer, you will need to design and build applications that can scale to meet the demands of a growing user base.
  • Creating APIs: APIs (Application Programming Interfaces) are the backbone of modern web applications. As a Node.js developer, you will be responsible for designing and building APIs that other applications can use to communicate with your web application.
  • Collaborating with other developers: Developing web applications often involves working in a team environment. As a Node.js developer, you will need to collaborate with other developers, designers, and stakeholders to ensure that the web application meets the requirements of all stakeholders.
  • Writing and testing code: As with any software development role, writing and testing code is a core responsibility of a Node.js developer. You will need to write clean, efficient, and maintainable code and test it thoroughly to ensure that it meets the requirements of the web application.
  • Managing databases: Many web applications require a database to store and retrieve data. As a Node.js developer, you may be responsible for managing the database, writing queries, and ensuring that data is stored securely.
  • Staying up to date with the latest trends and technologies: The world of web development is constantly evolving, and Node.js developers need to stay up to date with the latest trends and technologies to remain competitive in the job market. You will need to constantly learn new skills and technologies to stay relevant in your field.

What are we looking for and what does it require to be the right fit for this role?

  • B.S. or higher degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or another technical field
  • 3 to 5 years hands-on Backend Development using JavaScript framework (NodeJS, ExpressJS, NestJS)
  • Knowledge of REST Web Services/APIs
  • Strong Database Knowledge, SQL, Query Optimization
  • Good experience with TypeScript/JavaScript
  • Experience with source control (GIT) and CI/CD, for example, Jenkins
  • Experience with unit testing - Mocha or Jest framework
  • Good expertise in writing scalable and optimized codeExperience with other JavaScript frameworks - ReactJS, Angular
  • Interest in front-end UX development
  • Demonstrable understanding of good architectural design principles
  • Interest in tooling and automation with exposure to Scrum/Agile environment
  • A team player and have experience in working in international teams (incl. cultural awareness, virtual/remote working). Is outspoken and builds fast interpersonal relationships.
  • A self-starter with minimal supervision required
  • Quality awareness, self-motivated and problem-solving skills
  • Good English skills

Why Join AIO?

Our mission is to revolutionize the US restaurant industry by providing a comprehensive and fully integrated solution that empowers restaurant owners to efficiently manage all aspects of their business. Our platform combines our patented AI technology with unparalleled customer support to help owners increase revenue, reduce costs, and improve their overall profit margins.

We believe that restaurants should be able to focus on delivering exceptional dining experiences to their customers, without the added stress of managing complex and disparate systems. That's why we offer an All-In-One super app platform for all their needs, from front-of-the-house operations like ordering, payment, marketing and rewards, to back-of-the-house management like inventory, staff, and financials.

We are laser focused on becoming a significant player in the $55 billion restaurant tech SaaS market. You will be a part of a world class, up-and-coming Silicon Valley funded startup.

title: Data Engineer (Content Processing)
description:
What the role is:


CSIT develops cutting-edge products to safeguard Singapore's national security interests. We are seeking Data Engineers to join a specialized team operating at the heart of our mission, transforming hundreds of thousands of documents daily through large-scale pipelines. In this role, you will go beyond traditional data engineering; you will architect intelligent systems that ingest unstructured data, generate vector embeddings, and unlock semantic search capabilities to uncover critical insights from massive datasets. Your work will directly power the next generation of analytical products, enabling our analysts to detect threats across critical domains, including but not limited to Cybersecurity.



What you will be working on:




  • Data Pipeline Engineering: Architect, design, and maintain reliable, high-throughput pipelines that ingest, route, and process vast volumes of unstructured data. You will integrate AI models for automated data classification and information extraction, while ensuring latency and throughput meet mission-critical standards.

  • Data Transformation & Enrichment: Develop and optimize transformation logic that parses complex content, implements chunking strategies, and generates high-quality vector embeddings for downstream retrieval. You will ensure data is enriched and structured for maximum analytical value.

  • Hybrid Retrieval Systems: Build and support robust hybrid indexing systems that seamlessly combine high-speed keyword search with vector-based semantic search. You will engineer solutions that allow analysts to retrieve precise insights from enriched content instantly.

  • Multimedia Processing: Engineer scalable solutions for video analysis and image recognition, integrating computer vision models to extract actionable metadata from diverse media formats within our data streams.

  • Engineering Excellence: Uphold rigorous data quality and pipeline reliability standards while actively contributing innovative ideas to leverage AI for scaling operations. You will champion best practices in code quality, testing, and system observability.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with frontend engineers, data scientists, and product managers to deliver seamless, high-performance data services that meet the rigorous needs of national security operations.



What we are looking for:



  • Background in Computer Science or a related field, with proven hands-on experience in data engineering or software development.

  • Experience in building scalable ETL/ELT pipelines to process, transform, and validate large datasets.

  • Good grasp of data quality principles, pipeline reliability patterns, and the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly.

  • Nice-to-haves:

  • Exposure to vector databases, text embedding techniques, LLM integration, or semantic search frameworks (curiosity and a willingness to master AI concepts are highly valued).

  • Familiarity with container-based environments (Docker/Kubernetes) and modern CI/CD practices.

  • Experience with multimedia processing tools or computer vision libraries.

  • Background in handling high-volume, unstructured data in cloud-native environments.

  • As CSIT is an agency under Ministry of Defence (Singapore), only Singapore Citizens will be considered.



About Centre for Strategic Infocomm Technologies



The Centre for Strategic Infocomm Technologies is the lead digital technology agency in the Ministry of Defence, and a member of the Defence Technology Community. Our technical focus areas include Cybersecurity, Data Analytics, Software Engineering, and Cloud Infrastructure and Services. We conduct applied research and develop customised digital solutions to support national missions such as cyber defence and counter-terrorism. Please visit our website (https://www.csit.gov.sg/) for more info on what we do, for scholarship/internship/career opportunities and more!

title: Front Office Market Risk FCM and Futures Clearing, Vice President
description:
This role could potentially be based in Boston, MA or Jersey City, NJ

State Street is developing Futures Commission Merchant (FCM) and capabilities to support futures and options clearing and execution to integrate it to its existing cleared repo franchise. Front Office Risk Management is a critical component of the target operating model and will work closely with Trading, Product Development, Middle Office, Back Office, Collateral Management, Enterprise Risk Management, Technology, Legal, Compliance, Treasury and Finance.

Job Description:

We are looking for a Vice President of Front Office Market Risk to help design, implement and operate the risk framework for State Street's FCM and repo clearing business. This is a build-phase and BAU risk role requiring deep knowledge of listed derivatives, clearing, margin, liquidity and counterparty risk. The successful candidate will establish real-time controls for cleared and financing products, manage risk across overlapping futures and sponsored repo client activity.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Drive implementation of the Front Office Risk operating model for the FCM business
  • Define and implement real-time and intraday risk monitoring capabilities, including monitoring of client positions, market movements, initial margin, variation margin, collateral requirements, cross-margining, limit utilization and liquidity requirements.
  • Design pre-trade and pre-deal controls
  • Aggregate risks across FCM and cleared repo activity
  • Perform daily risk management for a diverse book of top-tier alternative manager portfolios, including analysis of margins, stress scenario results, and exposure changes.
  • Work closely with Enterprise Risk Management (internal risk oversight) and external regulators.
  • Work closely with front office traders and at times, clients, to derive and analyze trading strategies, considering margin risk and potential efficiencies
  • Perform other tasks as assigned to support the Boston-based Front Office Market and Credit Risk team.

The Vice President will operate in a dynamic, fast-paced environment during the design, regulatory approval, implementation and launch phases of the FCM initiative. The role requires a high degree of autonomy, sound judgment under pressure, and the ability to translate complex market, margin, liquidity and counterparty risks into practical controls and senior-management decisions.

Education/Qualifications:

  • BS in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering or related field.
  • 10+ years of relevant experience in FCM, futures clearing, listed derivatives, prime brokerage, sponsored/cleared repo, securities financing or front office market risk management..
  • Strong understanding of futures and options market risk, clearing-house margin methodologies, client margining, collateral, liquidation risk and intraday liquidity.
  • Demonstrated experience designing or operating real-time risk monitoring, pre-trade controls, stress testing, limit frameworks and escalation processes
  • Experience assessing hedge fund and institutional trading strategies, including U.S. Treasury cash-futures basis and other leveraged relative-value strategies
  • Working knowledge of FCM regulatory and segregation requirements, clearing-member risk controls, net capital considerations and clearing-house default management.
  • Professional designations (CFA, FRM) preferred but not required.

Salary Range:

$120,000 - $202,500 Annual

The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ.

Employees are eligible to participate in State Street’s comprehensive benefits program, which includes: our retirement savings plan (401K) with company match; insurance coverage including basic life, medical, dental, vision, long-term disability, and other optional additional coverages; paid-time off including vacation, sick leave, short term disability, and family care responsibilities; access to our Employee Assistance Program; incentive compensation including eligibility for annual performance-based awards (excluding certain sales roles subject to sales incentive plans); and, eligibility for certain tax advantaged savings plans.

title: Retail Customer Experience Associate, SouthPark Mall - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As a Customer Experience Colleague, you will create exceptional, personalized shopping experiences for our customers. You’ll prioritize customer satisfaction by actively engaging with shoppers across all touchpoints - both in-store and online - and drive cross-category sales to support overall business goals. With a deep understanding of fashion, fit, and function, you will make tailored product recommendations and leverage digital tools to enhance the customer journey. You also will work across different departments daily, often transitioning between multiple areas throughout the day.

In this role, you’ll also play a key part in client relationship building through outreach tools like My Client and social media. Your collaborative approach with peers, store leaders, and brand partners will help identify opportunities, resolve challenges, and elevate the overall customer experience. In addition to service and selling, you’ll support operational excellence through floor readiness, event execution, merchandise setup, and opening/closing procedures.

A positive, can-do attitude, strong communication skills, and a passion for delivering high-caliber service will be key to your success in this role.

How Our Selling Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Our colleagues begin each day energized and ready to make an impact. They wear their name badge with pride, greet teammates with a warm hello, and help ensure the sales floor is clean, organized, and prepared for customers. Before getting started, they review their sales goals, learn about new arrivals and top-selling items, and stay up to date on current trends and promotions - so they’re fully informed and ready to engage, educate, and sell with confidence.
  • On the floor, they focus on the customer - offering a warm welcome, making eye contact, and creating friendly, personal conversations to create customer relationships to bring the customers back.
  • Throughout the day, they maintain a shoppable space by recovering the floor and fitting rooms, updating signs and pricing, and supporting any needed merchandise moves.
  • They always Finish Strong - sharing our Loyalty program benefits, making sure customers have all they need, and ending with a sincere thank-you, often walking the package around and using the customer’s name.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Be comfortable communicating and collaborating with customers and colleagues
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Meeting daily sales goal challenges
  • Enjoy meeting people, learning about them, and sharing information
  • Resourceful and eager to start a new venture and can adapt to changing priorities; you can work on your own but are great with team dynamics
  • You can handle electronic devices with no problem
  • At least 2 years of selling or customer experience preferred

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs., stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As a Customer Experience Colleague, you will create exceptional, personalized shopping experiences for our customers. You’ll prioritize customer satisfaction by actively engaging with shoppers across all touchpoints - both in-store and online - and drive cross-category sales to support overall business goals. With a deep understanding of fashion, fit, and function, you will make tailored product recommendations and leverage digital tools to enhance the customer journey. You also will work across different departments daily, often transitioning between multiple areas throughout the day.

In this role, you’ll also play a key part in client relationship building through outreach tools like My Client and social media. Your collaborative approach with peers, store leaders, and brand partners will help identify opportunities, resolve challenges, and elevate the overall customer experience. In addition to service and selling, you’ll support operational excellence through floor readiness, event execution, merchandise setup, and opening/closing procedures.

A positive, can-do attitude, strong communication skills, and a passion for delivering high-caliber service will be key to your success in this role.

How Our Selling Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Our colleagues begin each day energized and ready to make an impact. They wear their name badge with pride, greet teammates with a warm hello, and help ensure the sales floor is clean, organized, and prepared for customers. Before getting started, they review their sales goals, learn about new arrivals and top-selling items, and stay up to date on current trends and promotions - so they’re fully informed and ready to engage, educate, and sell with confidence.
  • On the floor, they focus on the customer - offering a warm welcome, making eye contact, and creating friendly, personal conversations to create customer relationships to bring the customers back.
  • Throughout the day, they maintain a shoppable space by recovering the floor and fitting rooms, updating signs and pricing, and supporting any needed merchandise moves.
  • They always Finish Strong - sharing our Loyalty program benefits, making sure customers have all they need, and ending with a sincere thank-you, often walking the package around and using the customer’s name.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Be comfortable communicating and collaborating with customers and colleagues
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Meeting daily sales goal challenges
  • Enjoy meeting people, learning about them, and sharing information
  • Resourceful and eager to start a new venture and can adapt to changing priorities; you can work on your own but are great with team dynamics
  • You can handle electronic devices with no problem
  • At least 2 years of selling or customer experience preferred

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs., stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

title: Web Engineer
description:
About the Role

As a Software Engineer, you will implement full-stack solutions, review code, and solve complex engineering problems across multiple client projects and our internal suite of tools. We use AI coding tools heavily in our daily development workflow. You should expect to spend less time typing boilerplate and more time on solutioning decisions, implementation quality, code reviews, debugging, and solving the hard 20% that AI cannot reliably reason about. This includes edge cases, legacy system quirks, unclear requirements, business logic, API integrations, security concerns, and production issues.

You will still write code directly, especially where engineering judgment, context, and precision matter most. You will work closely with project teams, and with clients when needed, to understand problems firsthand, clarify trade-offs, and turn messy real-world requirements into reliable software.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build solutions for new projects, ongoing builds, maintenance work, and internal tools.
  • Implement full-stack features across frontend, backend, APIs, CMS platforms, integrations, and cloud-hosted applications.
  • Use AI coding tools as your default workflow for scaffolding, implementation support, refactoring, debugging, documentation, and test generation.
  • Take AI-accelerated work to production-grade quality. AI may get you most of the way there fast, but you own the part that handles edge cases, and business rules.
  • Review and audit code produced by both human developers and AI assistants.
  • Catch issues in AI-generated code, including logic, APIs, weak error handling, security gaps, missing edge cases, and over-engineered solutions.
  • Proactively identify and resolve issues related to business logic, API integrations, performance, accessibility, maintainability, and security.
  • Work directly with project teams, and with clients when needed, to diagnose problems firsthand instead of only executing a written spec.
  • Support and review the work of other developers, including junior and mid-level team members.
  • Build and maintain AI coding workflows for the team, including prompt patterns, tool configurations, reusable instructions, automations, and review checklists.
  • Troubleshoot staging and production issues across code, hosting, databases, APIs, logs, and configuration.
  • Communicate progress, blockers, risks, and changes clearly on the platforms the team already uses.

Experience Needed

  • 4+ years of professional full-stack development experience.
  • Strong experience with modern web frameworks such as React, Node.js, and Next.js. Python experience is a plus.
  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience working with CMS or eCommerce platforms such as WordPress, Drupal, Magento, or similar.
  • Experience integrating systems using REST APIs, GraphQL APIs, and web hooks.
  • Comfortable with cloud hosting platforms such as AWS, Kinsta, DigitalOcean or similar.
  • Experience with team-based version control and standard development workflows: scope, build, review, deploy, support.
  • Real, daily production experience with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or similar.
  • Strong debugging ability across frontend, backend, database, infrastructure, and third-party integrations.
  • Solid understanding of technical fundamentals, including DNS, SSL, caching, databases, authentication, authorization, API design, error handling, logging, testing, deployment, and basic security.
  • Experience with CI/CD, Linux, environment variables, secrets, staging environments, production environments, logs, backups, and rollbacks is preferred.
  • Experience with workflow automation tools such as n8n, Zapier, Make, or similar is a plus.

What Will Help You Succeed

  • Good written and spoken communication. You will work with people across countries and time zones.
  • Discipline to manage your own time and output without close supervision.
  • A strong enough grasp of fundamentals to tell when AI is right, when it is confidently wrong, and when it is just guessing.
  • Good habits managing multiple projects and people at once.
  • Ability to ask good questions before building the wrong thing.
  • Care for the user, client, and business problem behind the technical request.
  • Comfort moving between code, logs, documentation, meetings, and production issues.
  • Practical judgment on when to build properly, when to simplify, and when to flag risk.
  • A habit of leaving code, documentation, workflows, and processes better than you found them.
  • Ability to guide other developers while still delivering your own work.
  • Strong research habits using documentation, source code, logs, tests, search, and AI tools to understand unfamiliar problems and verify solutions.

title: Sr. Product Manager, Selection, GfD, International Seller Services
description:
Amazon's Worldwide Global Selling team builds the products and programs that help sellers grow their businesses across Amazon's global marketplace network. Global from Day 1 (GfD) is among the most consequential bets in this space — a program designed to remove the friction, capital commitment, and compliance complexity that have historically made cross-border expansion out of reach for most sellers. Sellers list once. Amazon handles fulfillment, compliance, pricing, and returns across every market.

The Selection PM owns the growth engine that makes this work. We identify which products have cross-border demand potential, recruit them into the program, activate them to buyable status, and drive the selection quality that converts glances into sales. The decisions made here — on eligibility criteria, scoring signals, activation quality, and seller tooling — determine what GfD looks like at scale and how fast it gets there.

This is a high-ownership role with direct impact on one of Global Selling's most visible growth programs. The right candidate builds well under ambiguity, takes ownership of problems that don't yet have a clear solution, and is energized by a roadmap that is theirs to define.

Key job responsibilities
- Selection Recruitment: Define and drive the funnel that identifies eligible ASINs across the CN-origin FBA catalog, scores them for cross-border demand potential, and recruits sellers to enroll. Own the eligibility criteria, scoring signals, and targeting methodology — and the tooling that makes enrollment actionable at scale.

- Buyable ASIN Activation: Own the pipeline that turns enrolled ASINs into live, buyable, discoverable selection across GfD markets. Identify and systematically eliminate the blockers — compliance gaps, listing deficiencies, spec mismatches — that prevent ASINs from reaching buyable status.

- Selection Quality: Own the selection productivity funnel end to end — from enrolled ASIN to first sale. Define what good looks like, build the "Perfect ASIN" activation playbook, and drive the metrics that prove selection is converting, not just listed.

- Demand Intelligence & Scoring: Partner with science and data teams to build and refine the signals that predict cross-border demand potential. Translate model outputs into actionable seller-facing recommendations and enrollment prioritization.

- Seller-Facing Tooling: Collaborate with NGS and SX PMs to build the Seller Central surfaces that help sellers understand which products to expand globally, what's blocking their selection, and what to do next — making the right action obvious without requiring manual analysis.

A day in the life
our morning starts with the selection funnel — buyable rate, activation blockers, compliance stalls. You triage, escalate what needs it, and move on. Mid-morning you're with the science team pressure-testing a new demand scoring signal. After lunch, you're reviewing a seller-facing surface with the SX PM — pushing on information hierarchy, making sure the action lands before the explanation. Late afternoon is heads-down on the Perfect ASIN playbook: defining the activation standard the team will execute against at scale. No two days look the same. Most involve data, decisions, and moving something from blocked to shipped.

title: Product Manager - Custom Cable Assemblies - Remote Eastern / Central Time Zone
description:
Overview

GCG is seeking a Product Manager to lead the commercial and operational performance of our OEM cable assembly business within our Custom Engineered Solutions (CES) division!

Reporting to our Vice President of Assembly, you'll transform business data into insights that drive better decisions and stronger financial performance. You'll partner with Sales, Operations, Supply Chain, and Finance to improve profitability, forecasting, pricing, inventory management, and business intelligence across four manufacturing locations, supporting more than $60 million in OEM business.

What Success Looks Like

During your first year, you'll become the business expert for our custom cable assembly product line by:

  • Delivering timely, accurate business analysis that supports leadership decisions.
  • Improving visibility into margins, pricing, inventory, forecasting, and backlog.
  • Developing forecasting models and dashboards that improve operational performance.
  • Identifying opportunities that increase profitability and reduce business risk.
  • Becoming the trusted product expert for assigned OEM product lines and customer requirements
  • Building a clear product roadmap and identifying opportunities for growth, cost reduction, and portfolio improvement
  • Being recognized as a trusted cross functional business partner

This is a remote position requiring the employee to work from the Eastern or Central Time Zone. The role may require approximately quarterly travel, primarily to GCG facilities.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the strategy, positioning, and lifecycle of assigned OEM cable and harness assembly product lines, identifying portfolio gaps and growth opportunities
  • Understand customer applications, requirements, volumes, sourcing strategies, and competitive alternatives, translating them into product priorities
  • Support Sales and customer discussions with product strategy, positioning, and technical/commercial expertise
  • Lead product management activities for new product introductions and lifecycle decisions, partnering cross-functionally on manufacturability, capacity, quality, timing, tooling, materials, and cost
  • Collect, clean, and analyze product line performance, including sales, margins, pricing, forecasts, backlog, and inventory, to identify risks and growth opportunities
  • Develop actionable recommendations that improve profitability, pricing strategy, inventory performance, and customer service
  • Monitor commodity markets, including copper, and support pricing adjustments and metals escalation programs
  • Review customer pricing and ensure price lists reflect approved commercial agreements, cost inputs, and margin objectives
  • Develop dashboards and analytical tools using ERP systems (Oracle & S2K), Excel, and business intelligence platforms to improve business visibility
  • Partner closely with Sales, Supply Chain, Operations, Finance, Customer Service, and Strategic Account Managers to drive informed business decisions
  • Present business performance, trends, and recommendations to senior leadership

What You’ll Bring

Required Qualifications

  • Three or more years of experience in product management, commercial analytics, demand planning, supply chain, pricing, or a similar analytical role within manufacturing or industrial distribution
  • Strong analytical skills with experience evaluating sales, margins, inventory, forecasting, pricing, and operational performance
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
  • Experience working with ERP and business intelligence systems
  • Excellent communication and project management skills with the ability to translate complex business data into actionable recommendations
  • Ability to work remotely within the Eastern or Central time zone and travel approximately quarterly
  • Ability to travel approximately quarterly, primarily to GCG facilities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, or related field
  • Experience with custom cable assemblies, wire and cable products, or other engineered electrical products
  • Experience with commodity pricing, copper escalation programs, and multiple ERP systems
  • Experience developing dashboards and reporting tools

What We Offer

  • Competitive annual salary ranging from $115,000 to $130,000 and annual bonus based on company and individual performance

  • Comprehensive health coverage with multiple plan options (CDHP and PPO)

  • Company-paid life and disability insurance, 401(k) with company match, and supplemental insurance options

  • Generous time off including PTO, paid holidays, parental leave, and compassionate care leave

  • Wellness and support programs including EAP, wellness incentives, and telehealth

  • Additional benefits such as dental/vision plans, FSAs/HSAs with company contributions, pet insurance, legal services, and identity theft protection

  • A people-first culture that recognizes employees as our most important asset!

About GCG Custom Engineered Solutions

GCG’s Custom Engineered Solutions division supports original equipment manufacturers and other customers with customized wire, cable, connectivity, and assembly solutions designed around their technical, operational, and supply-chain requirements.

About GCG

At GCG, our mission is to power, connect, and automate our world. With the responsive DNA of a startup and the size of a global leader, we offer top brands and extensive value-added services that make us an invaluable partner to our customers in multiple industry verticals across the globe.

We are committed to meeting the needs of our customers while focusing attention on our responsibility to the environment, our associates, and the communities we serve.

Our Use of AI in Recruiting

At GCG, we use AI technology to assist with our interviews by automating note-taking, allowing our hiring teams to focus fully on the conversation. This technology supports efficiency and accuracy in capturing candidate insights during interviews but is not used to evaluate resumes. All resume reviews and candidate assessments are conducted directly by our corporate recruiting team and hiring managers to ensure a thoughtful, human-centered approach.

The Director – Roads and Car Parks serves as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) responsible for the strategic planning, assurance, governance, performance monitoring, operational readiness, asset management, and lifecycle optimization of roads, tunnels, and car park infrastructure. The role provides technical leadership and oversight across the full asset lifecycle, ensuring infrastructure assets are safe, reliable, sustainable, compliant, and aligned with organizational objectives and industry best practices.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and implement the long-term strategy for roads, tunnels, and car park assets.
  • Establish asset management frameworks, standards, policies, and procedures aligned with international best practices.
  • Support executive leadership in defining infrastructure investment priorities and capital planning strategies.

  • Lead asset lifecycle management activities including planning, design review, operation, maintenance, renewal, and replacement strategies.
  • Develop and maintain asset management plans, asset condition assessments, and long-term investment programs.

Operations and Maintenance

  • Monitor operational performance of road, tunnel, and parking assets.
  • Ensure maintenance strategies are effectively implemented to maximize asset performance and reliability.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to increase efficiency and service levels.
  • Support operational readiness and transition from project delivery to operations.

Risk Management and Compliance

  • Identify infrastructure risks and develop mitigation strategies.
  • Ensure compliance with local regulations, international standards, and health and safety requirements.
  • Oversee emergency response, resilience planning, and business continuity considerations for critical infrastructure.
  • Monitor environmental and sustainability performance requirements.

Stakeholder Management

  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, including project teams, operators, consultants, contractors, regulators, and government authorities.
  • Represent the organization in technical committees and industry forums.
  • Provide executive-level reporting and technical advice to senior leadership.

Performance Monitoring

  • Develop and monitor KPIs related to asset performance, condition, availability, reliability, and lifecycle costs.
  • Establish reporting dashboards and performance review processes.
  • Ensure data-driven decision-making through asset intelligence and performance analytics.

Key Accountabilities

  • Technical governance and assurance.

  • Asset management compliance and maturity.

title: Microsoft devops engineer (azure, tfvc)

Assess the current Azure Dev Ops and TFVC environment, including repositories, permissions and pipelines.

Plan and execute TFVC to Git migrations, including testing, rollout and post migration support.

Define Git branching, repository standards and release governance.

Build and modernise Azure Pipelines using YAML and reusable templates.

Improve automation, testing and deployment processes for. NET applications.

Mentor developers on Git, Azure Repos and Azure Pipelines best practices.

Produce migration documentation, runbooks and handover material.

Support security and quality improvements including secret management, code quality and security scanning.

Required Experience and Skills

7+ years in Dev Ops, software delivery or Microsoft ALM engineering.

Strong Azure Dev Ops Server and/or Azure Dev Ops Services experience.

Strong knowledge of TFVC and proven experience migrating TFVC repositories to Git.

Hands‑on experience with Azure Repos, Git workflows and branching strategies.

Strong Azure Pipelines experience, including YAML pipelines.

Advanced Power Shell scripting skills.

Practical experience supporting. NET / C# application builds and deployments.

Experience managing migration cutovers, validation and stakeholder communication.

Strong documentation and client facing consulting skills.

Advantageous

Azure Dev Ops Advanced Security, Sonar Qube, Snyk or similar tools.

Automated testing frameworks such as MSTest, x Unit or Postman/Newman.

Entra ID, Active Directory or hybrid identity environments.

Experience in financial services or other regulated industries.

Terraform, Bicep, Docker, Kubernetes, AKS or broader Azure platform exposure.

Click Up, Sentry or related tooling integrations.

Qualifications

Matric.

Relevant degree or equivalent practical experience.

Microsoft certification such as AZ-400, AZ-104 or equivalent.

Ability to support scheduled migration and cutover activities.

Available for a full time 6 month client engagement in Cape Town.

South African work authorisation.

Ideal Candidate

You are a hands‑on Azure Dev Ops specialist with strong TFVC to Git migration experience. You can successfully deliver complex migrations, establish best practices, mentor development teams and improve CI/CD maturity while remaining focused on delivering practical business outcomes.
