title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced DevOps Engineer to support the DataSphere platform, a comprehensive data lakehouse solution hosted on the AWS Government Commercial Cloud (GCC) environment.

The successful candidate will be responsible for building and maintaining robust CI/CD pipelines, implementing Infrastructure-as-Code, supporting platform operations, and ensuring compliance with stringent government security, governance, and data protection requirements.

Key Responsibilities

CI/CD & DevOps

  • Develop, maintain, and optimise CI/CD pipelines using the SHIP-HATS tools ecosystem.
  • Configure and manage GitLab for source control and automated deployment workflows.
  • Implement code quality gates using SonarQube.
  • Manage security and vulnerability scanning using Fortify on Demand (FOD).
  • Manage dependency scanning and governance using Nexus IQ.
  • Coordinate with CloudSCAPE for security compliance scanning and remediation.
  • Implement Infrastructure-as-Code using Terraform and other approved tools.
  • Support containerisation and orchestration technologies across the platform.

Security & Compliance

  • Implement and maintain Automated Baseline Log Review (ABLR) systems.
  • Manage Central Accounts Management (CAM) integration for secure user access control.
  • Coordinate and remediate Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) findings.
  • Ensure compliance with Personal Data Protection Impact Assessment (PDPIA) requirements.
  • Implement and maintain Vulnerability Management System (VMS) processes.
  • Support government security clearance, data classification, and sensitive data handling requirements.
  • Implement encryption and secure key management practices.

Platform Operations

  • Monitor platform performance, availability, and reliability and implement optimisation measures.
  • Manage secrets and encryption key rotation to ensure data protection.
  • Configure email notifications for data processing status, failures, and error alerts.
  • Implement and maintain data retention policies.
  • Support SaaS whitelisting processes and required approvals.
  • Coordinate System Security Acceptance Testing (SSAT) activities.
  • Support troubleshooting, operational maintenance, and platform enhancements.

Collaboration & Support

  • Work closely with Data Engineers, Data Analysts, security teams, and technical stakeholders.
  • Provide DevOps support across multiple datamarts.
  • Provide technical guidance for Raw-to-Tech and Tech-to-Business data pipelines.
  • Collaborate with government divisions and stakeholders to ensure successful delivery.
  • Support training environment setup for user onboarding and technical skill development.
  • Maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and knowledge-sharing materials.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Technical Skills

  • Minimum 3 years of hands-on DevOps Engineering experience.
  • Strong experience with AWS.
  • Proficiency in Terraform and Infrastructure-as-Code practices.
  • Strong experience developing and managing GitLab CI/CD pipelines.
  • Hands-on knowledge of SonarQube, Fortify on Demand (FOD), and Nexus IQ.
  • Experience with SHIP-HATS or similar government-approved DevOps toolchains is highly desirable.
  • Experience with containerisation and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Strong scripting skills in Python, Bash, or PowerShell.
  • Understanding of CI/CD security, automated testing, deployment, and release management.

Security & Compliance

  • Experience working in government environments, particularly GCC environments.
  • Knowledge of government security frameworks, compliance requirements, and security clearance processes.
  • Understanding of Sensitive High data classification and handling procedures.
  • Strong knowledge of encryption mechanisms, secrets management, and key rotation.
  • Experience with vulnerability assessment, remediation, and security scanning.
  • Familiarity with security monitoring, incident response, and security operations.
  • Understanding of VAPT, PDPIA, SSAT, ABLR, and VMS processes is highly desirable.

Preferred Certification

  • AWS Certified DevOps Engineer or equivalent AWS certification.

Experience & Methodology

  • Minimum 3 years of DevOps engineering experience.
  • Prior experience supporting government or highly regulated environments.
  • Experience working in Agile development and delivery environments.
  • Experience supporting cloud-based data platforms or data lakehouse environments is an advantage.

Personal Attributes

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to security best practices.
  • Strong documentation and knowledge-sharing capabilities.
  • Proactive approach to monitoring, troubleshooting, and platform maintenance.
  • Ability to work effectively with technical teams, security teams, and government stakeholders.
  • Strong ownership and ability to operate in a highly governed environment.

title: Retail Fulfillment Associate, Cherry Creek - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As a Fulfillment Colleague, you will play a key role in creating a seamless and personalized shopping experience for our omni-channel customers. This role combines sales floor engagement with back-of-house fulfillment responsibilities - selecting merchandise, packing and shipping online orders with care, and assisting with in-store and curbside pickup.

You’ll greet customers with genuine hospitality, resolve issues with professionalism, and ensure each interaction is smooth and positive. Your attention to detail, teamwork, and commitment to operational excellence will help drive sales, strengthen customer loyalty, and support overall store success.

This role goes far beyond just being a behind-the-scenes support colleague. Here, the customer is at the heart of everything we do - every day, all day. If you're passionate about selling, reaching goals, working as a team, and creating amazing experiences through genuine hospitality, this could be the perfect fit for you!

How Our Fulfillment and Receiving Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Our colleagues begin each day energized and ready to make an impact. They wear their name badge with pride and greet teammates with a warm hello. Before getting started, they review their goals, learn about new products and promotions, and prepare the store for success. Whether receiving merchandise, tagging items, or organizing the stockroom, they bring energy and focus to every task to set the day up for smooth operations and strong results.
  • On the floor, they focus on the customer - from greeting customers warmly to actively listening and resolving issues, colleagues build trust through personal, helpful interactions - on the floor, during curbside pickups, or through timely and accurate order fulfillment.
  • Throughout the day, they maintain a shoppable space by recovering the floor and fitting rooms, updating signs and pricing, restocking merchandise, and supporting any needed merchandise moves.
  • They always Finish Strong - sharing our Loyalty program benefits, making sure customers have all they need, and ending with a sincere thank-you, often walking the package around and using the customer’s name. Behind the scenes, they wrap up their day by organizing the stockroom, completing orders, and setting the team up for the next day’s success.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Be comfortable communicating and collaborating with customers and colleagues
  • Meeting daily sales goal challenges
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Enjoy meeting people, learning about them, and sharing information
  • Resourceful and eager to start a new venture and can adapt to changing priorities; you can work on your own but are great with team dynamics

  • Drive Defender for Cloud coverage, vulnerability management (containers, hosts, code), and automated remediation.

Networking & Data Protection

  • Hub‑and‑spoke or vWAN, Private Link/Endpoints, Private DNS, Firewall/NAT Gateway egress control; encryption at rest & in transit, KMS integrations.

Resilience & DR

  • Backups (RSV/Velero), multi‑region patterns, chaos exercises, capacity planning; codify DR runbooks and perform tests.

FinOps & Compliance

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Espresso Systems builds foundational infrastructure to power tomorrow’s internet, where digital assets are able to move across chains as easily as info flows across the web. It’s the lead developer of the Espresso Network, the first base layer built from the ground up to provide rollups with the functionality they’ve always needed but never had: fast, secure finality for users’ transactions and seamless composability with other rollups.
Rollups today rely on infrastructure that wasn’t built with them in mind, resulting in their isolation and the fragmentation of users, developers and liquidity within the Ethereum ecosystem. This prevents rollups from achieving the seamless composability that’s essential to web3's vision. Espresso solves this by providing rollups with secure, real-time visibility into what’s happening on all integrated chains, including their own, empowering the apps to execute crosschain interactions immediately without waiting for slow settlement or trusting centralized sequencers.
The Espresso Network is currently live on mainnet in its initial release. In addition to fast confirmations and data availability, rollups seeking further decentralization can also opt to use the Espresso Network as a decentralized sequencer. As the first purpose-built base layer for rollups, Espresso supports a fast-growing ecosystem of interconnected chains regardless of tech stack, VM, or settlement layer—from established chains like Celo and ApeChain to emerging app-specific chains attracting their first users.
At Espresso Systems, we work with leading teams developing rollups and innovating around interoperability, including Offchain Labs, Polygon, Caldera, AltLayer, Cartesi, Across, Hyperlane, and beyond—all united in our mission to build a unified, composable ecosystem where rollups are free to achieve their full potential regardless of where they choose to settle.
The Espresso team comprises a diverse and passionate group of contributors from around the world. We are developers, designers, and researchers who have contributed in academia, open-source communities, policymaking, and beyond. We have raised roughly $60 million from leading investors in technology and crypto, including a16z, Greylock Partners, Electric Capital, Sequoia Capital, and Polychain Capital.
As a DevOps Engineer, you will assist the development team in building infrastructure to support production of the sequencer software, as well as build tooling for the deployment of test networks.

Responsibilities

  • Monitoring and management of cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Assisting with CI/CD pipelines and general code management practices
  • Develop and maintenance of tooling for deployment of Espresso Systems services

Requirements

  • Experience working with containers in hosted environments
  • Experience with Terraform or other similar declarative cloud operations technologies
  • Comfort working in the Linux command line

Preferred

  • Experience with Ansible, AWS container orchestration, Docker, Github Actions, Nix, Rust, and Terraform

  • Work alongside the brightest minds in the crypto space
  • Competitive salary + equity package

Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain - and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating - that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

title: Asset Protection Detective, Willowbrook Mall - NJ - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an Asset Protection Detective, you will help protect company assets, reduce shortage, and support a safe, customer-focused shopping environment. Using surveillance, investigative tools, and strong partnerships with store teams and law enforcement, you will identify and respond to theft, recover merchandise, and help protect our customers, colleagues, and business.

Why This Role Matters

Asset Protection Detectives play an important role in reducing loss while maintaining a safe and welcoming store environment. Through training, observation, investigation, and de-escalation, this role helps protect company assets, support colleagues, and ensure customers can shop with confidence.

How Our Asset Protection Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Our colleagues begin each day energized and ready to make an impact. They greet teammates with a warm hello. Before they get started, they review updates and department information so they're fully informed and ready to engage with confidence.

  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.

  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

What To Expect

  • Use surveillance techniques, investigative tools, and reporting systems to help identify theft, dishonest activity, and shortage trends.

  • Partner with Asset Protection leaders, store teams, and law enforcement to support investigations and protect company assets.

  • Apply de-escalation tools and sound judgment to help maintain a safe environment for customers and colleagues.

  • Prepare clear documentation, statements, and evidence to support investigations, audits, and legal proceedings.

  • Support team readiness by training colleagues on protocols that help protect company assets.

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Help protect customers, colleagues, and company assets by identifying, investigating, and responding to theft and dishonest activity.

  • Use surveillance techniques to support the apprehension of shoplifters and dishonest employees, while following company policies and legal requirements.

  • Recover stolen merchandise and provide statements, evidence, and documentation to support investigations.

  • Prepare timely and accurate reports related to theft incidents, investigations, audits, and assigned activities.

  • Build strong partnerships with store colleagues, Asset Protection leaders, and law enforcement to support investigations and shortage reduction.

  • Maintain compliance with company policies and legal standards related to apprehensions, searches, and evidence preservation.

  • Testify in court for criminal and civil cases, as needed.

  • Respond to alarm calls, support special assignments, and facilitate first aid for customers and colleagues when needed.

  • Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships with colleagues, customers, and communities.

Skills That Matter

Must Have

  • Ability to observe, identify, and respond to suspicious activity in a retail environment.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to partner effectively with customers, colleagues, leaders, and law enforcement.

  • Ability to use sound judgment, de-escalation tools, and company procedures to support a safe environment.

  • Ability to handle proprietary, sensitive, and confidential information with discretion and integrity.

  • For jobs in New York, a current New York State Security Guard License is required.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in retail, customer service, asset protection, security, investigations, or law enforcement.

  • Ability to prepare accurate reports, statements, and documentation related to incidents and investigations.

  • Experience using surveillance systems, reporting tools, or investigative technology.

  • Ability to train or coach colleagues on asset protection protocols, shortage reduction, or safety practices.

Physical Activities You Will Perform

  • This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities.

  • Position requires prolonged periods of standing/walking around store or department.

  • May occasionally involve reaching above eye level, stooping, kneeling, or crouching.

  • Must be able to apprehend shoplifters.

  • Ability to sustain long periods of time enclosed in surveillance areas.

  • Frequently lift/move up to 30lbs.

  • Requires close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

This job description is not all-inclusive and may not apply to colleagues covered by a collective bargaining agreement. Macy's Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.

title: DevOps Solution Architect
description:

We are seeking a highly skilled DevOps Solution Architect to lead the design, automation, deployment, and operational excellence of modern enterprise platforms and software solutions. This role bridges software architecture, cloud infrastructure, DevOps engineering, and AI-enabled and human in the loop operational practices to ensure scalable, secure, and resilient delivery pipelines and production environments.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise and operational experience with mission critical, high availability applications. The candidate must embrace an AI-first mindset — leveraging AI-assisted development, automation, monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimization practices throughout the software delivery lifecycle.

  • Strong software development and scripting experience with the ability to design, develop, and support automation tools, integrations, APIs, and operational platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to rapidly prototype, validate, and iterate on technical solutions while balancing speed, innovation, engineering discipline, and operational quality.
  • Experience leveraging AI tools and AI-assisted practices for software delivery, infrastructure management, monitoring, troubleshooting, automation, and engineering productivity with an AI-first approach to problem solving.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills with the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments and drive clarity through experimentation and continuous improvement.

$135,000 - $160,000 CAD

description:

Clinics & Group Instruction

    • Serving and returning
    • Dinking
    • Volleys
    • Groundstrokes
    • Third-shot drops
    • Court positioning
    • Shot selection
    • Doubles strategy
  • Adjust instruction based on player ability and experience.
  • Organize drills, games, and competitive activities.
  • Keep clinics moving efficiently and maximize player participation.
Private Lessons

  • Provide individual and small-group pickleball instruction.
  • Evaluate each player's strengths and areas for improvement.
  • Develop drills based on the player's goals and skill level.
  • Provide clear, constructive feedback.
  • Help players track their improvement over multiple lessons.
Camps & Special Programs

  • Assist with or lead pickleball camps and specialty programs.
  • Help develop programs for youth, adults, beginners, and experienced players.
  • Participate in special events, tournaments, leagues, and corporate pickleball programs when scheduled.
Open Play Support

  • Assist with designated pickleball open-play sessions.
  • Help organize players and court rotations when needed.
  • Encourage proper pickleball etiquette and sportsmanship.
  • Help new players understand rules, scoring, and basic gameplay.
  • Create a welcoming environment where guests of different skill levels feel comfortable participating.
Safety & Facility Standards

The instructor is responsible for helping maintain a safe playing environment.

Responsibilities include:

  • Inspecting courts and equipment before programming begins.
  • Making sure players understand court boundaries and facility rules.
  • Maintaining appropriate spacing during drills and activities.
  • Reporting damaged equipment or facility concerns to leadership.
  • Ensuring pickleball equipment is properly collected and returned after each program.
  • Keeping courts and instructional areas organized.
  • Following all Allstar safety and guest-experience standards.
Guest Experience

Every instructor represents Allstar while interacting with players and families.

The Pickleball Instructor should:

  • Welcome players as they arrive.
  • Introduce themselves and explain the structure of the session.
  • Clearly communicate rules and expectations.
  • Encourage players throughout the session.
  • Be patient with beginners.
  • Maintain professionalism during competitive situations.
  • Help create an experience that encourages players to return for additional clinics, lessons, and events.
Program Development

The Pickleball Instructor may work with Allstar leadership to:

  • Recommend new clinics and programs.
  • Develop lesson plans and instructional progressions.
  • Identify opportunities for leagues, tournaments, camps, and special events.
  • Recommend appropriate skill-level classifications.
  • Provide feedback on scheduling and court utilization.
  • Help grow participation within the local pickleball community.
Qualifications

Preferred qualifications include:

  • Strong knowledge of pickleball rules, techniques, and strategy.
  • Previous pickleball playing experience.
  • Coaching, teaching, or sports-instruction experience preferred.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with children, adults, and families.
  • Strong leadership and organizational skills.
  • Positive and professional attitude.
  • Dependable and punctual.
  • Comfortable leading groups of different sizes and skill levels.
Formal pickleball instructor certification is preferred but not required, depending on experience.

Schedule

This is a flexible, program-based position.

Potential programming may include:

  • Morning clinics
  • Evening clinics
  • Private lessons
  • Weekend camps
  • Open play
  • Corporate events
  • Tournaments and special events
Hours may vary depending on registrations, reservations, and program demand.

Compensation

Compensation may vary depending on the type of program being conducted, experience, certifications, attendance, and level of responsibility.

Opportunities may include compensation for:

  • Group clinics
  • Private lessons
  • Camps
  • Open-play supervision
  • Special events
  • Corporate pickleball events
Employment Requirements

  • Must be dependable and maintain professional conduct while representing Allstar.
  • Must be able to work safely around children, families, and adult participants.
  • Employment is contingent upon successfully passing a background check.
What Success Looks Like

A successful Allstar Pickleball Instructor will:

  • Provide organized and engaging instruction.
  • Help beginners become confident players.
  • Help experienced players continue improving.
  • Maintain a safe and professional court environment.
  • Develop relationships with players.
  • Generate repeat clinic and lesson participation.
  • Help establish Allstar as a destination for pickleball instruction and play in the community.
Position: Pickleball Instructor

title: Speciallæge i børne- og ungdomspsykiatri til Hejmdal Privathospitals afdeling på Frederiksberg
description:
Hos Hejmdal Privathospital på Frederiksberg søger vi en speciallæge i børne- og ungdomspsykiatri, der vil være med til at skabe trygge og effektive forløb for børn, unge og deres familier.

Kan du se dig selv i et stærkt fagligt fællesskab med speciallæger, psykologer, sygeplejersker og andre fagprofessionelle, der arbejder dedikeret med børn og unge med psykiske lidelser? Så er du måske vores nye kollega.

Fagligt stærk speciallæge med hjertet på det rette sted

Vi søger en speciallæge i børne- og ungdomspsykiatri, som er fagligt stærk, ambitiøs og god til at samarbejde. Du trives både i mødet med patienter og familier og i det tværfaglige samarbejde med kolleger.

Du har fokus på effektive udrednings- og behandlingsforløb og ønsker et arbejdsliv med høj grad af patientkontakt og mindre administration. Samtidig motiveres du af at bidrage til høj faglig kvalitet og udviklingen af vores tilbud.

Stillingen er relevant både for dig med solid erfaring som speciallæge i børne- og ungdomspsykiatri og for dig, der snart bliver speciallæge og dine arbejdsopgaver blandt andet være at**:**

  • deltage i udredning og behandling af børn og unge
  • deltage i tværfaglige konferencer og faglig sparring
  • samarbejde tæt med patienter, familier og tværfaglige kolleger
  • bidrage til undervisnings- eller udviklingsopgaver, hvis det har din interesse.

Du bliver en del af en større lægegruppe på tværs af vores afdelinger, hvor der er gode muligheder for sparring med kolleger og oplæring efter behov.

Stillingen er primært tilknyttet vores ambulatorium, hvor du indgår i udrednings- og behandlingsforløb for børn og unge. Hvis du har interesse for det, vil der også være mulighed for at arbejde i vores dagafsnit. Her modtager vi børn og unge med mere kompleks psykopatologi, hvor blandt andet miljø- og skoleobservationer indgår i forløbet. Det giver gode muligheder for et tæt samarbejde med både familier og tværfaglige kolleger.

Dit arbejdsliv

Vi tror på, at høj faglighed og et godt arbejdsliv skal kunne gå hånd i hånd. Derfor skaber vi rammer, der både understøtter vores patientbehandling og tager højde for, at vores medarbejdere kan befinde sig forskellige steder i deres arbejdsliv og privatliv.

Hejmdal ønsker at være en arbejdsplads, som tilgodeser mennesker i forskellige livsfaser, med forskelligt erfaringsniveau og med forskellige behov for ansættelsespakker. For os er det vigtigste ikke, at alle arbejdsliv ser ens ud. Det vigtigste er, at vi sammen kan skabe nogle rammer, hvor du kan bringe din faglighed bedst muligt i spil og samtidig se dig selv som en del af Hejmdal i lang tid.

Du får mulighed for at præge både dine arbejdsopgaver og den fortsatte udvikling af vores tilbud, og vi håber, at du har lyst til at bidrage aktivt til udviklingen af Hejmdal. Din egen faglige og personlige udvikling er samtidig vigtig for os, og derfor udarbejder vi en individuel karriereplan med fokus på fortsat udvikling, kompetenceopbygning og efteruddannelse.

Hjertet af Hejmdal

Hejmdal Privathospital er Danmarks største psykiatriske privathospital med afdelinger i Aalborg, Odense, Aarhus og på Frederiksberg.

Vores tværfaglige og kompetente teams af dedikerede speciallæger, læger, psykologer, sygeplejersker og andre fagfolk udgør sammen en stærk faglig enhed med stort fokus på tværfagligt samarbejde, hvor vi altid stræber efter at hjælpe flest muligt, bedst muligt.

På Hejmdal Privathospital er vi ordentlige og ambitiøse; vi tager ansvar og bruger vores handlerum. Arbejdsglæde er fundamentet for vores arbejdsdag, og vores fokus er at møde hver enkelt patient og deres familie med både ekspertise, omsorg og medmenneskelighed.

Vi hjælper patienter fra regionen, forsikringsselskaber og kommuner samt privatbetalende patienter.

Vi kan have travlt, men vi tager os tid til fællesskab, humor, trygge rammer, godt kollegafælleskab, udvikling og uddannelse. Vi dyrker en kultur, der værdsætter og giver plads til innovative ideer samt medindflydelse.

Hvis du sidder inde med spørgsmål, inden du søger jobbet, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Klinikchef Michelle Obbekjær på mio@hejmdal.dk eller Lægefaglig Direktør Bettina Fage-Larsen på bfl@hejmdal.dk

title: Data Center Chief Engineer
description:
Join our dynamic Data Center Engineering Operations Team and become a critical architect of the infrastructure that powers global cloud computing. You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of Amazon Web Services' physical infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that support millions of customers worldwide.
The Data Center Chief Engineer (CE) is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves both planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response to emergent issues. The CE serves as an expert technical resource reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager, interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third-party vendors. They are expected to be a singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center and to support Amazon within its owned and operated data centers. Data center equipment that supports mission-critical servers must maintain better than 99.999% uptime.
Chief Engineer will be responsible for managing small-to-medium large impact projects from conception to completion. These projects can involve large amounts of independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in both local and global settings. The CE will be tasked with creating and delivering milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities. The goals of such projects are for the CE to drive innovation and resiliency while reducing operational costs in the facilities.
The Chief Engineer directs, trains and supports EOT’s in their role of providing hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. Implementation and execution of site/equipment-specific training exercises is also expected. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand-by diesel generators, switchgear, UPS’s, PDU’s, AHU’s, chillers, cooling towers, chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, VFD’s, and building automation systems.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
Effective May 15, 2017, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States)


Key job responsibilities
• Oversee the day-to-day operations and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in a data center.
• Operate independently with limited direct management
• Act as an escalation point for all facilities-related issues within the data center, escalating to the Data Center Facility Manager as needed
• Perform root cause analysis of equipment failures
• Troubleshoot and report of facility and data sever-level events within internal SLA
• Create and deploy new standard practices for Engineering Operations Technicians, Chief Engineers, and vendor support teams
• Provide training and guidance to Engineering Operations Technicians
• Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to by vendor and Amazon staff
• Ensure all security procedures are adhered to by vendor and Amazon staff
• Utilize internal CMMS to manage building workflows
• Communicate complex technical information to a non-technical audience
• Using Microsoft Office suite (Outlook, Excel, PPT, Word) and other computer programs such as PDF, QUIP, and other dashboards and scheduling tooling.
• Instruct others on scheduling, ticketing, and providing mentorship in developing solutions.

Physical Requirements:
• Walk job sites in uneven terrain
• Work at heights and from ladders
• Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 40 pounds or more
• Coordinate body movements when using tools or equipment
• Reach and stretch to position equipment and fixtures while maintaining balance
• Bend or twist the body into unusual positions while working
• Perform physical tasks all day without becoming overly tired
• Use hands to manipulate small wires and objects
• Push or pull heavy objects into position
• Work in a noisy environment
• Work at depths, such as under raised floors

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.
Essential Requirements:
• Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
• Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
• Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility
Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

title: At Your Service Center Associate, South Beach - Part Time
description:

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. This role goes far beyond just being a cashier. Here, the customer is at the heart of everything we do - every day, all day. If you're passionate about selling, reaching goals, working as a team, and creating amazing experiences through genuine hospitality, this could be the perfect fit for you! You’ll also help keep the shopping space clean, organized, and inviting so every customer feels welcome the moment they walk in.

As an At Your Service Colleagues (AYS), you come in energized and ready to make an impact - wearing your name badge with pride, greeting teammates with warmth, and helping ensure the At Your Service areas is clean, organized, and ready for customers. You help set the pace by reviewing sales goals, learning about new arrivals and top-selling items, and staying up to date on trends and promotions - so you’re prepared to support the team and engage customers confidently.

Assist customers in all aspects of total store fulfillment, including By Online and Pick Up in Store, be proficient in all systems needed to complete transactions, and ensure the collection area is organized so the customer pick-up experience is friction-free
  • You help maintain a shoppable space by recovering merchandise and keeping the pickup and return areas clean while ensuring timely completion and curbside delivery of Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS) orders.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are

  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English

title: Director of Development
description:
Gulfstream Goodwill Industries is a powerful force for transformation in our community. Through housing and shelter options, a career academy, and skill-based and workforce development programs, Gulfstream Goodwill helps individuals facing disabilities, economic hardship, homelessness, and other significant barriers build meaningful, self-sufficient lives. Every day, the organization changes the trajectory of lives equipping people with the skills, confidence, and opportunity to thrive as contributing members of our community. Joining the Gulfstream Goodwill team means joining a mission of dignity, second chances, and lasting impact.


The Director of Development will plan, develop, and execute a comprehensive fundraising program for Gulfstream Goodwill Industries aligned with the organization's strategic priorities. With a current fundraising portfolio of $1.2 million and a five-year goal of growing philanthropic revenue to $3 million, this position will place primary emphasis on major gift development while building and implementing a multi-faceted development plan in partnership with organizational leadership and staff. The Director will establish and strengthen relationship management systems for existing and prospective major donors, deepen stewardship practices at all giving levels, and actively identify and cultivate new major donor prospects within a rapidly growing and increasingly philanthropically engaged community.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

Develop and implement a comprehensive fundraising plan aligned with the strategic plan and organizational priorities:

Develop a multi-year fundraising plan grounded in Gulfstream Goodwill's strategic priorities, with clear annual milestones.

In partnership with the President/CEO and leadership team, set and achieve annual fundraising revenue and activity goals that advance the organization toward a $3 million fundraising goal within five years.

Collaborate and coordinate with organizational leaders and essential staff to implement the fundraising plan.

Oversee a donor database and consistently track current and prospective funder information, engagement history, and key touchpoints.

Produce regular fundraising reports for the President/CEO and Board of Directors.


Lead major gift development as the primary focus of the fundraising program:

Personally manage a portfolio of major donor prospects and active donors.

Design and execute individualized strategies for identification, cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship of each donor in the portfolio.

Serve as the primary staff partner supporting the President/CEO's donor engagement and portfolio management.

Leverage the organization's growing community to identify philanthropically capable individuals new to the area and expand the major donor pipeline.

Foster relationships with board members, community leaders, business partners, and other organizational contacts to open doors and make meaningful introductions to prospective major donors.

Strategize, prepare for, and participate in gift solicitations at the major gift, leadership gift, and planned giving levels.


Build and implement robust donor relationship management processes:

Establish clear protocols for donor outreach, moves management, and timely follow-up to ensure every relationship is actively cultivated.

Develop and maintain a systematic approach to managing both existing major donors and prospective major donors.

Ensure no relationship falls through the cracks by building accountability structures into the development operation.


Champion a culture of donor stewardship at all giving levels:

Design and execute meaningful stewardship strategies that acknowledge, recognize, and engage donors at every level of giving.

Deepen donors' connection to the mission of Gulfstream Goodwill through personalized, mission-rich communications and experiences.

Ensure donors at all levels feel valued and connected to the organization's impact.


Build event strategies that lead to new donor development:

Collaborate with event staff to identify and prioritize major donor prospects attending organizational events.

Develop strategies to engage event participants as prospective donors and deepen relationships with existing donors through event experiences.

Ensure meaningful, timely follow-up with event attendees to convert engagement into lasting philanthropic relationships.

Coordinate with the board to maximize their role in cultivating donor relationships through and beyond special events.


Activate and support board members as philanthropic ambassadors:

Help cultivate a vibrant culture of philanthropy among Goodwill board members and organizational leadership.

Provide training, tools, and strategies to help board members open doors to their networks and make personal asks on behalf of the organization.

Work closely with board members to identify prospects within their spheres of influence and develop strategies for engagement.


Develop a planned giving program to create opportunities for legacy giving:

Create and maintain a legacy giving society.

Develop a marketing plan to promote planned giving opportunities to donors, board members, and prospects.

Integrate planned giving conversations in major gift development.

Facilitate personalized stewardship for planned giving donors.


Collaborate with staff to execute a comprehensive, multi-channel annual giving program:

Partner with organizational staff to implement annual giving campaigns utilizing direct mail, online giving, and other donor communications.

Support foundation and corporate grant strategies in collaboration with relevant staff and leadership.

Develop and coordinate planned giving efforts as part of a comprehensive development strategy.


Develop a compelling Case for Support:

Create a Case for Support that clearly articulates the mission, impact, and vision of Gulfstream Goodwill in a manner that resonates with donors and prospects across the philanthropic spectrum.

Create donor-facing materials that bring the transformational work of the organization to life.

Socialize the Case for Support with board and staff members.

Ensure the Case for Supports regularly refreshed and aligned with organizational priorities and strategic goals.


OTHER DUTIES MAY INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:

  1. Demonstrate by words and actions a commitment to the Goodwill mission to build pathways to independence for people with barriers through housing, education, training and employment.
  2. Perform or assist with any duties or operations, as required to maintain workflow and to meet schedules and quality requirements.
  3. Maintain safe work area and comply with safety procedures and equipment operating rules, keeping work area in a clean and orderly condition.
  4. Participate in any variety of meetings and task force groups to integrate activities, communicate issues, obtain approvals, resolve problems, and maintain specified level of knowledge pertaining to new developments, requirements, and policies.
  5. Other duties as assigned.

title: Asset Protection Detective, San Francisco Union Square - FLEX
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an Asset Protection Detective, you will help protect company assets, reduce shortage, and support a safe, customer-focused shopping environment. Using surveillance, investigative tools, and strong partnerships with store teams and law enforcement, you will identify and respond to theft, recover merchandise, and help protect our customers, colleagues, and business.

Why This Role Matters

Asset Protection Detectives play an important role in reducing loss while maintaining a safe and welcoming store environment. Through training, observation, investigation, and de-escalation, this role helps protect company assets, support colleagues, and ensure customers can shop with confidence.

How Our Asset Protection Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Our colleagues begin each day energized and ready to make an impact. They greet teammates with a warm hello. Before they get started, they review updates and department information so they're fully informed and ready to engage with confidence.

  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.

  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

What To Expect

  • Use surveillance techniques, investigative tools, and reporting systems to help identify theft, dishonest activity, and shortage trends.

  • Partner with Asset Protection leaders, store teams, and law enforcement to support investigations and protect company assets.

  • Apply de-escalation tools and sound judgment to help maintain a safe environment for customers and colleagues.

  • Prepare clear documentation, statements, and evidence to support investigations, audits, and legal proceedings.

  • Support team readiness by training colleagues on protocols that help protect company assets.

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Help protect customers, colleagues, and company assets by identifying, investigating, and responding to theft and dishonest activity.

  • Use surveillance techniques to support the apprehension of shoplifters and dishonest employees, while following company policies and legal requirements.

  • Recover stolen merchandise and provide statements, evidence, and documentation to support investigations.

  • Prepare timely and accurate reports related to theft incidents, investigations, audits, and assigned activities.

  • Build strong partnerships with store colleagues, Asset Protection leaders, and law enforcement to support investigations and shortage reduction.

  • Maintain compliance with company policies and legal standards related to apprehensions, searches, and evidence preservation.

  • Testify in court for criminal and civil cases, as needed.

  • Respond to alarm calls, support special assignments, and facilitate first aid for customers and colleagues when needed.

  • Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships with colleagues, customers, and communities.

Skills That Matter

Must Have

  • Ability to observe, identify, and respond to suspicious activity in a retail environment.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to partner effectively with customers, colleagues, leaders, and law enforcement.

  • Ability to use sound judgment, de-escalation tools, and company procedures to support a safe environment.

  • Ability to handle proprietary, sensitive, and confidential information with discretion and integrity.

  • For jobs in New York, a current New York State Security Guard License is required.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in retail, customer service, asset protection, security, investigations, or law enforcement.

  • Ability to prepare accurate reports, statements, and documentation related to incidents and investigations.

  • Experience using surveillance systems, reporting tools, or investigative technology.

  • Ability to train or coach colleagues on asset protection protocols, shortage reduction, or safety practices.

Physical Activities You Will Perform

  • This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities.

  • Position requires prolonged periods of standing/walking around store or department.

  • May occasionally involve reaching above eye level, stooping, kneeling, or crouching.

  • Must be able to apprehend shoplifters.

  • Ability to sustain long periods of time enclosed in surveillance areas.

  • Frequently lift/move up to 30lbs.

  • Requires close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

title: Technical Product Manager
description:
ControlUp is a leader in Digital Employee Experience (DEX), evolving IT operations with agentic AI to deliver Autonomous Endpoint Management (AEM) and a digital workspace that runs itself.

Our platform transforms millions of real-time signals into intelligent action, bridging the gap between deep visibility and automated remediation. We turn "IT headaches" and employee frustration into self-healing operations, allowing organizations to move beyond reactive troubleshooting toward a future where technology works seamlessly in the background.

We’re here to ensure the workday runs without disruptions. No tool sprawl, no wasted time, and no friction. Just technology that works for people, not against them, so they can stay focused on what they do best.

One platform. One powerful shift in how work flows.


The Role
ControlUp for VDI is where our reputation was built - and it remains a core pillar of ControlUp ONE. It streams 1,500+ metrics at three-second intervals across sessions, hosts, storage, networks, gateways, and client devices, with deep native integrations for Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops, Citrix Cloud/DaaS, Omnissa Horizon, Microsoft Azure Virtual Desktop, and Parallels RAS.

We're looking for a Technical Product Manager to own the next chapter of that product: keeping our real-time depth unmatched while bringing agentic AI, automation, and proactive remediation into the virtual desktop world.
This role is for someone who has lived in EUC - who knows why a logon takes 90 seconds, what a broker actually does, and why "it's slow" is the hardest ticket in IT. You'll work with customers who are among the most technical in our base and who will tell you exactly what's wrong. Your job is to turn that into a product they love, not just tolerate.

What You’ll Own:

  • Own the ControlUp for VDI roadmapend to end - discovery, definition, delivery, and adoption - as an integrated part of the ControlUp ONE platform
  • Go deep with customers and the community. Run discovery with VDI and EUC admins, join escalations, and translate raw operational pain into prioritized product decisions
  • Define how AI shows up in VDI.
  • Partner with the Pulse AI team to bring anomaly detection, root-cause analysis, and automated remediation to virtual desktop workloads
  • Own the ecosystem.Track platform and API changes across Citrix, Omnissa, Microsoft AVD, Parallels, and the hypervisor layer (Broadcom/VMware, Nutanix, Microsoft, XenServer), and make sure we're ready before our customers are
  • Lead competitive and market analysisin DEX, VDI monitoring, and endpoint management - and turn it into differentiation, not feature parity
  • Write clear, testable requirementsand detailed specs, and stay close to Dev and QA through the entire cycle
  • Own product quality and reliability as a first-class outcome, including upgrade experience, backward compatibility, and how we handle customer-reported defects
  • Drive go-to-marketwith Marketing, Sales, Sales Engineering, and Support - enablement, positioning, launch, and adoption tracking
  • Make decisions with evidence.Use telemetry, usage data, and customer feedback to test hypotheses and iterate

What You’ll Bring:

  • Proven product management experience at a product company in IT infrastructure, IT operations, or endpoint management
  • Hands-on familiarity with VDI/DaaS and EUC— Citrix, Omnissa Horizon, Azure Virtual Desktop, or equivalent — and an understanding of what IT teams actually do all day
  • Strong technical background: comfortable discussing APIs, agents, telemetry, and system architecture with engineers as a peer
  • Track record of developing and executing go-to-market strategy
  • Proven ability to partner effectively with Dev, QA, Sales, and Sales Engineering
  • Confident decision-making and the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders without authority
  • Strong data literacy and a habit of making data-driven decisions
  • Genuine passion for product design and user experience
  • Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills in English
  • Ability to work effectively in a geographically distributed team
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
Nice to Have:
  • Experience with DEX, observability, or monitoring products
  • Familiarity with AI/ML-driven product capabilities, agentic workflows, or automation platforms
  • Background as an IT/EUC practitioner or consultant before moving into product
  • Experience with an active technical community or open script/automation ecosystem

Why You’ll Love It Here:

We know every job description says "fast-paced" and "collaborative." Here’s what that actually looks like for us:

  • Global, Not Isolated: You’ll work with a diverse team spanning the US, EMEA, and Israel. We’re known for our vibrant social culture, and once a year, the entire global company comes together for a major offsite to reconnect in person.

  • Meaningful Impact: Make a real impact from day one, working with cutting-edge technology in a fast-paced, global environment.

  • Collaborative & Growth-Driven: Join a collaborative, empowering culture where learning and professional growth are encouraged.

  • True Flexibility: We offer a hybrid model. We care about the output of your expertise, not the hours you spend in a specific chair.

Ready to join? Apply now and help us shape the future of IT and employee experience.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Job Description: Data Engineer

As a Data Engineer at D-SIMLAB Technologies, you will play a key role in deriving insights from large datasets to optimize semiconductor manufacturing processes. This role focuses on data extraction, analysis, and actionable insights, while collaborating with cross-functional teams to develop and deploy D-SIMLAB's software products as well as provide professional consultation services to our clients. The ideal candidate is someone who excels in data-driven analysis and is eager to work on high-impact projects in the semiconductor industry.

Key Responsibilities :

  • Data Extraction and Analysis :
    Collect, clean, and analyze large datasets from semiconductor manufacturing environments to ensure data consistency, completeness, and correctness.
    Use statistical methods and data mining techniques to identify patterns, trends, and anomalies that impact production performance.
  • Performance Evaluation :
    Analyze the gap between planned and actual production outcomes. Identify root causes for performance deviations and recommend data-driven strategies for process improvement. Develop reports and visualizations to present findings to clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Data-Driven Insights :
    Provide actionable insights based on data analysis to optimize semiconductor manufacturing processes. Work closely with clients to understand their specific needs and translate data findings into operational and strategic improvements.
  • ETL and Data Modeling :
    Build and maintain ETL processes to integrate data from various sources into D-SIMLAB's data models. Collaborate with simulation modeling teams to ensure accurate and reliable data is fed into models.
  • Consultation Services :
    Act as a trusted advisor to clients by offering data-driven recommendations for enhancing their production efficiency. Present analyses and proposals to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring clarity and actionable takeaways.
  • Data Visualization and Reporting :
    Create dashboards and reports using advanced data visualization tools to communicate key insights and trends effectively. Continuously improve reporting mechanisms to provide real-time insights and support ongoing optimization efforts.
  • Collaboration with Teams :
    Work with Software Engineers, Data Scientists, and other cross-functional teams to ensure that data insights align with product goals and customer needs. Contribute to product enhancement initiatives, focusing on the improvement of data-related components and analytics.

Candidate Requirements :

  • Education :
    Bachelor's/Master's degree in Data Science, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience :
    Strong analytical skills with a minimum of 3 years of experience in data analysis, preferably in an industrial environment. Semiconductor experience is a plus.
  • Technical Skills :
    Proficiency in SQL and Microsoft Excel.
    Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) is highly desirable.
    Experience with ETL processes and database management.
  • Analytical Abilities :
    Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to handle large datasets and deliver actionable insights to improve operational performance.
  • Soft Skills :
    Ability to work collaboratively in a multicultural, multidisciplinary team.
    Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex data insights to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Willingness to Travel :
    Willing to travel for international projects and collaborate closely with clients and internal teams.

Salary Range: $80,000 - $110,000K

Location: Burnaby, BC, Canada - Hybrid

This is a new position.

Role Overview

The DevOps Engineer sits within the Asset business unit and owns how Asset products are built, released, and run. The role is not part of the central Platform Engineering team; it works with that team continuously — adopting the shared platform's golden path for infrastructure as code, CI/CD, cloud identity, and observability — but is accountable to Asset BU delivery. The focus is business-unit-specific DevOps: release and deployment management, environment ownership, pipeline migration, and operational support for Asset applications.

Organizational Relationship

  • Reports to: Maryam Arshi, Director, AI Strategy and Development (Asset BU)
  • Part of: Asset BU engineering organisation
  • Works closely with: Asset BU product management, development, and support teams; central Platform Engineering; Information Security
  • Direct reports: None

Key Responsibilities

  • Provision and maintain Asset BU environments (development, test, staging, production) as code, keeping them consistent and reproducible.
  • Manage the Asset BU’s infrastructure-as-code stacks and configuration using the platform’s shared components, and bring hand-created resources under management.
  • Lead the Asset BU’s migration of repositories and pipelines from Azure DevOps to GitHub Actions, adopting the platform’s reusable workflows.

  • Comfortable operating across an organisational boundary: adopting standards set by a central team, applying them locally, and pushing back constructively where they do not fit

title: AI Engineer - Algorithm Team
description:
Our Algorithms group is a highly multidisciplinary group at the core of our data processing and detection capabilities, integrating physics, signal processing, classical algorithms, and AI models to meet our unique requirements. As we scale, we are increasingly leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) and agentic AI systems to accelerate our research, automate complex workflows, and unlock new capabilities across the company.

Job description

As an AI Engineer at Exodigo, you will join a fast-moving, highly technical team that works at the intersection of computer vision, deep learning, and modern AI. You will be the driving force behind our LLM and agentic AI efforts - exploring, evaluating, and deploying the latest research and tooling in this rapidly evolving space, and shaping how we apply it across the organization to turn cutting-edge ideas into production-ready tools and agents.

You will design and build LLM-powered applications, agentic workflows, and internal tools that empower our algorithms, mapping, and engineering teams to move faster and operate at greater scale. Collaboration is central to the role, you will work closely with researchers, engineers, and domain experts to identify high-impact opportunities, prototype quickly, and integrate reliable AI systems into real-world products.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and iterate on LLM-powered applications, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, agents, and fine-tuned models tailored to Exodigo's unique data and workflows.
  • Develop agentic workflows that automate complex, multi-step tasks across research, data analysis, and engineering pipelines.
  • Build internal tools and assistants that empower algorithm researchers, mapping experts, and engineers to work faster and more effectively.
  • Evaluate and integrate the latest foundation models, frameworks, and techniques (e.g., prompt engineering, fine-tuning, tool use, multi-agent orchestration), keeping pace with rapid advances in the field.
  • Design robust evaluation methodologies to measure quality, reliability, and safety of LLM-based systems.
  • Collaborate closely with the Algorithms, Mapping, and Software teams to identify high-impact opportunities and transition prototypes into reliable, production-grade systems.


Job description

  • Experience in building and shipping meaningful, production-grade agentic systems - not just demos or prototypes. We’re looking for people who can walk us through what they built, the real problem it solved, and the value it created.
  • Deep, in-depth understanding of LLMs - including how they work under the hood (transformer architecture, tokenization, attention, sampling), their failure modes, and the practical tradeoffs between models, prompting strategies, fine-tuning, and retrieval.
  • Strong hands-on experience with modern agentic frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent) and with designing multi-step, tool-using workflows.
  • Strong command of RAG, prompt engineering, evaluation methodologies, and techniques for improving reliability and reducing hallucinations in LLM-based systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and experience with common AI/ML libraries and APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face, PyTorch).
  • solid software engineering practices, including writing clean, maintainable code and building robust, scalable systems.
  • 5+ years of experience developing machine learning, AI, or software systems.
  • B.Sc. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or similar field.

Preferred Qualifications-

  • M.Sc. or Ph.D. in a relevant field.
  • Experience working with multimodal models that combine text with images, audio, or structured data.
  • Familiarity with cloud environment development (AWS).

title: Senior Full Stack .NET Developer
description:

Techso is looking for a Senior Full Stack .NET Developer to help design and develop digital solutions used by our clients across Canada.

In this role, you'll have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects, contribute to architectural decisions, mentor less experienced developers, and help improve our development practices.

title: Asset Protection Detective, Tacoma - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an Asset Protection Detective, you will help protect company assets, reduce shortage, and support a safe, customer-focused shopping environment. Using surveillance, investigative tools, and strong partnerships with store teams and law enforcement, you will identify and respond to theft, recover merchandise, and help protect our customers, colleagues, and business.

Why This Role Matters

Asset Protection Detectives play an important role in reducing loss while maintaining a safe and welcoming store environment. Through training, observation, investigation, and de-escalation, this role helps protect company assets, support colleagues, and ensure customers can shop with confidence.

How Our Asset Protection Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Our colleagues begin each day energized and ready to make an impact. They greet teammates with a warm hello. Before they get started, they review updates and department information so they're fully informed and ready to engage with confidence.

  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.

  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

What To Expect

  • Use surveillance techniques, investigative tools, and reporting systems to help identify theft, dishonest activity, and shortage trends.

  • Partner with Asset Protection leaders, store teams, and law enforcement to support investigations and protect company assets.

  • Apply de-escalation tools and sound judgment to help maintain a safe environment for customers and colleagues.

  • Prepare clear documentation, statements, and evidence to support investigations, audits, and legal proceedings.

  • Support team readiness by training colleagues on protocols that help protect company assets.

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Help protect customers, colleagues, and company assets by identifying, investigating, and responding to theft and dishonest activity.

  • Use surveillance techniques to support the apprehension of shoplifters and dishonest employees, while following company policies and legal requirements.

  • Recover stolen merchandise and provide statements, evidence, and documentation to support investigations.

  • Prepare timely and accurate reports related to theft incidents, investigations, audits, and assigned activities.

  • Build strong partnerships with store colleagues, Asset Protection leaders, and law enforcement to support investigations and shortage reduction.

  • Maintain compliance with company policies and legal standards related to apprehensions, searches, and evidence preservation.

  • Testify in court for criminal and civil cases, as needed.

  • Respond to alarm calls, support special assignments, and facilitate first aid for customers and colleagues when needed.

  • Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships with colleagues, customers, and communities.

Skills That Matter

Must Have

  • Ability to observe, identify, and respond to suspicious activity in a retail environment.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to partner effectively with customers, colleagues, leaders, and law enforcement.

  • Ability to use sound judgment, de-escalation tools, and company procedures to support a safe environment.

  • Ability to handle proprietary, sensitive, and confidential information with discretion and integrity.

  • For jobs in New York, a current New York State Security Guard License is required.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in retail, customer service, asset protection, security, investigations, or law enforcement.

  • Ability to prepare accurate reports, statements, and documentation related to incidents and investigations.

  • Experience using surveillance systems, reporting tools, or investigative technology.

  • Ability to train or coach colleagues on asset protection protocols, shortage reduction, or safety practices.

Physical Activities You Will Perform

  • This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities.

  • Position requires prolonged periods of standing/walking around store or department.

  • May occasionally involve reaching above eye level, stooping, kneeling, or crouching.

  • Must be able to apprehend shoplifters.

  • Ability to sustain long periods of time enclosed in surveillance areas.

  • Frequently lift/move up to 30lbs.

  • Requires close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!
