We are looking for a highly organized and proactive Interview Process & Recruitment Coordinator to manage and coordinate the end-to-end recruitment and interview process between Jeel, staffing vendors, project teams, hiring managers, and customers.

The role will be responsible for ensuring timely resource fulfillment, smooth interview coordination, accurate recruitment tracking, vendor management, and onboarding readiness. The ideal candidate should have strong coordination, communication, stakeholder management, and recruitment operations skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate resource requests from Delivery Leads, Project Managers, Project Owners, and Customers, ensuring timely fulfillment of staffing requirements.
  • Manage the end-to-end interview process, including interview scheduling, candidate communication, vendor coordination, interview panel coordination, and feedback collection.
  • Act as the primary point of contact between staffing vendors, hiring managers, project teams, and Customers throughout the recruitment lifecycle.
  • Maintain and monitor candidate pipelines, interview schedules, hiring trackers, recruitment dashboards, and status reports.
  • Follow up with all stakeholders to ensure timely completion of interviews, feedback, approvals, and hiring decisions.
  • Coordinate candidate onboarding and mobilization activities, ensuring Day-1 readiness and smooth deployment to projects.
  • Monitor staffing vendor performance against agreed SLAs, including candidate submission timelines, candidate quality, interview coordination, and fulfillment targets.
  • Identify and escalate recruitment bottlenecks, delays, and risks, while coordinating with relevant stakeholders to resolve issues.
  • Maintain accurate recruitment documentation, approvals, interview records, candidate information, and staffing databases in accordance with organizational policies.
  • Prepare regular recruitment status reports and hiring metrics for management, highlighting progress, risks, bottlenecks, and recommendations.
  • Support workforce planning and project staffing activities by maintaining visibility of open requirements and recruitment progress.
  • Build strong working relationships with vendors, hiring managers, project teams, and other stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities to improve recruitment processes, reduce turnaround times, and enhance the candidate and stakeholder experience.
  • Ensure recruitment operations are efficient, well-documented, and aligned with project staffing requirements.

Requirements

Requirements

  • Saudi Nationality is mandatory.
  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, or a related field.
  • 2–5 years of experience in recruitment coordination, staffing coordination, talent acquisition operations, HR operations, or a similar role.

  • Strong stakeholder coordination and communication skills.

Preferred Skills

  • Recruitment reporting and dashboards

title: At Your Service Center Associate, Eastridge - Part Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an At Your Service Center Colleague, you are at the heart of delivering a seamless and personalized shopping experience. You’ll support all At Your Service activities, including Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS), merchandise returns, order pickups, and other assigned tasks - all while upholding Macy’s service standards.

This role requires strong multitasking abilities, problem-solving, attention to detail, and a customer-first mindset. You’ll thrive in a fast-paced environment where flexibility is key, including working a variety of shifts such as nights, weekends, and holidays.

This role goes far beyond just being a cashier. Here, the customer is at the heart of everything we do - every day, all day. If you're passionate about selling, reaching goals, working as a team, and creating amazing experiences through genuine hospitality, this could be the perfect fit for you! You’ll also help keep the shopping space clean, organized, and inviting so every customer feels welcome the moment they walk in.

How Our At Your Service Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Every day starts with a positive example. As an At Your Service Colleagues (AYS), you come in energized and ready to make an impact - wearing your name badge with pride, greeting teammates with warmth, and helping ensure the At Your Service areas is clean, organized, and ready for customers. You help set the pace by reviewing sales goals, learning about new arrivals and top-selling items, and staying up to date on trends and promotions - so you’re prepared to support the team and engage customers confidently.
  • In the At Your Service area, you lead through action - welcoming customers with genuine hospitality, making eye contact, and starting friendly, personal conversations that build lasting relationships. Assist customers in all aspects of total store fulfillment, including By Online and Pick Up in Store, be proficient in all systems needed to complete transactions, and ensure the collection area is organized so the customer pick-up experience is friction-free
  • You help maintain a shoppable space by recovering merchandise and keeping the pickup and return areas clean while ensuring timely completion and curbside delivery of Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS) orders.
  • They always Finish Strong - sharing our Loyalty program benefits, making sure customers have all they need, and ending with a sincere thank-you, often walking the package around and using the customer’s name.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment.
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

The Catalyse Group is building a different kind of recruitment business. Breaking Your Natural Limit

We are looking for professionals with a solid foundation in recruitment who are hungry for the next level. You have proven you can bill, but you want to build.

Some of these patterns are personal; others are imposed by the very culture you work in. The gossip-fuelled, politically charged environment of a large agency does not just distract you — it actively reinforces the worst of these patterns. It feeds your insecurity, rewards your compulsion to please the wrong people, and keeps you busy with noise instead of strategy.

Through our proprietary Eternal Question coaching framework, we invest in your executionary power. We help you dismantle the fear that causes hesitation, the need to accommodate low-yield clients and internal politics, the illusion of busyness, and the unfocused energy that fails to convert to revenue. We strip away the dysfunction and build commercial precision in its place.

Education

Professional Certifications (Preferred)

  • Chartered Engineer (CEng), PE, or equivalent.
  • Certified Waste Management Professional.
  • PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification.
  • NEBOSH, IOSH, or equivalent HSE qualifications.

Experience

  • 20+ years of experience in waste management, environmental services, utilities, municipal services, or infrastructure operations.
  • Minimum 8 years in a senior leadership role.
  • Experience managing large-scale waste collection systems, treatment facilities, recycling operations, or environmental infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated experience in asset management, operational excellence, and regulatory compliance.
  • Experience leading stage-gate assurance, operational readiness, and governance reviews.

title: Asset Protection Detective, Colonie Center - Part Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an Asset Protection Detective, you will help protect company assets, reduce shortage, and support a safe, customer-focused shopping environment. Using surveillance, investigative tools, and strong partnerships with store teams and law enforcement, you will identify and respond to theft, recover merchandise, and help protect our customers, colleagues, and business.

Why This Role Matters

Asset Protection Detectives play an important role in reducing loss while maintaining a safe and welcoming store environment. Through training, observation, investigation, and de-escalation, this role helps protect company assets, support colleagues, and ensure customers can shop with confidence.

How Our Asset Protection Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Our colleagues begin each day energized and ready to make an impact. They greet teammates with a warm hello. Before they get started, they review updates and department information so they're fully informed and ready to engage with confidence.

  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.

  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

What To Expect

  • Use surveillance techniques, investigative tools, and reporting systems to help identify theft, dishonest activity, and shortage trends.

  • Partner with Asset Protection leaders, store teams, and law enforcement to support investigations and protect company assets.

  • Apply de-escalation tools and sound judgment to help maintain a safe environment for customers and colleagues.

  • Prepare clear documentation, statements, and evidence to support investigations, audits, and legal proceedings.

  • Support team readiness by training colleagues on protocols that help protect company assets.

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Help protect customers, colleagues, and company assets by identifying, investigating, and responding to theft and dishonest activity.

  • Use surveillance techniques to support the apprehension of shoplifters and dishonest employees, while following company policies and legal requirements.

  • Recover stolen merchandise and provide statements, evidence, and documentation to support investigations.

  • Prepare timely and accurate reports related to theft incidents, investigations, audits, and assigned activities.

  • Build strong partnerships with store colleagues, Asset Protection leaders, and law enforcement to support investigations and shortage reduction.

  • Maintain compliance with company policies and legal standards related to apprehensions, searches, and evidence preservation.

  • Testify in court for criminal and civil cases, as needed.

  • Respond to alarm calls, support special assignments, and facilitate first aid for customers and colleagues when needed.

  • Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships with colleagues, customers, and communities.

Skills That Matter

Must Have

  • Ability to observe, identify, and respond to suspicious activity in a retail environment.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to partner effectively with customers, colleagues, leaders, and law enforcement.

  • Ability to use sound judgment, de-escalation tools, and company procedures to support a safe environment.

  • Ability to handle proprietary, sensitive, and confidential information with discretion and integrity.

  • For jobs in New York, a current New York State Security Guard License is required.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in retail, customer service, asset protection, security, investigations, or law enforcement.

  • Ability to prepare accurate reports, statements, and documentation related to incidents and investigations.

  • Experience using surveillance systems, reporting tools, or investigative technology.

  • Ability to train or coach colleagues on asset protection protocols, shortage reduction, or safety practices.

Physical Activities You Will Perform

  • This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities.

  • Position requires prolonged periods of standing/walking around store or department.

  • May occasionally involve reaching above eye level, stooping, kneeling, or crouching.

  • Must be able to apprehend shoplifters.

  • Ability to sustain long periods of time enclosed in surveillance areas.

  • Frequently lift/move up to 30lbs.

  • Requires close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

description:
Description

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Senior Data Centre Design Manager to join its Data Centre Design Engineering team in Dublin, Ireland.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Senior Data Centre Design Manager to join its Data Centre Design Engineering team in Dublin, Ireland. Our team is responsible for achieving a world class uptime for our customers and drive to develop a fleet of buildings that emphasize security, safety, efficiency, and cost effectiveness, while finding new ways to meet AWS’s growing demand. As a Senior DC Design Manager at AWS, you will lead designs for AWS Data Centres in our Europe, Middle East & Africa (EMEA) geography and impact other projects around the world. As a Senior DC Design Manager, you will be part of a highly creative and efficient design team comprised of Architects, Engineers, and Designers tasked with solving problems and challenging the status quo. AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities

  • Communicate conceptual designs and create/maintain project documentation before, during, and after construction;
  • Creating and tracking metrics related to cost, quality and duration of design as well as collecting data from construction and commissioning teams as designs are implemented. Establishing capital project design budgets and contributing to complex business cases for existing region and new region deployment. Collaborating with AWS finance teams to secure funding for projects;
  • Working in partnership with AWS Engineering leads to schedule engineering resources and influence design changes based on internal customer needs;
  • Partnering with internal customers to establish project scope, schedule and deliverables. Create, review, and release design RFPs. Manage our external design consultants through the design and construction process. Coordinate with internal and external Mechanical, Electrical, Controls, and Cabling design engineers;
  • Think outside of the box to find innovative solutions prior to and during the construction process to reduce costs and schedule without negative impacts on quality or reliability. Travel for site assessments, internal design meetings, construction review, and interfacing with design consultants. Anticipated travel not to exceed 25%;
  • engage and manage the work of permitting and design consultants
  • Complete after-action reviews and identify opportunities for process improvement.

A day in the life

As a Senior Design Manager you will be part of a global engineering leadership team, comprised of highly effective Architects, Structural, Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, and Control Engineers delivering capacity projects across the Europe, Middle East & Africa geography.

This role is an opportunity to collaborate with many facets of the AWS organization, external engineering resources and regulatory agencies.

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

title: DevOps - Automation Analyst
description:
About F12:

F12 was built by uniting IT consulting firms across Canada with a shared vision: to reduce risk and complexity by crafting technology platforms that empower leaders to focus and thrive. We elevate IT conversations from ingredients to outcomes, delivering fully designed solutions with no bad options. If you’re looking for the fast lane into an IT career or want to supercharge your professional development, you’ve come to the right place. At F12, you’ll collaborate with a diverse team and gain exposure to technology services across countless businesses—building a resume rich with experience and accomplishments. Our mission is to elevate our employees by building and retaining an elite team of IT professionals equipped to deliver unmatched service to Canadian business leaders. We value humble service, continuous improvement, and hard work—and we’re looking for like-minded individuals to join us.

Who We Are:

F12 was built by uniting IT consulting firms from across Canada around a common vision – to combat risk and complexity by continuously crafting business technology platforms that empower business leaders to focus and thrive. We aim to elevate IT conversations (from ingredients to outcomes) and deliver fully designed solutions where there are no bad options.

General Description:

Look no further if you seek the fast lane into an IT career or wish to supercharge your professional development. You will collaborate with a diverse team and gain exposure to technology services in scores of businesses; your resume will become rich with experience and accomplishments. F12 is on a mission to elevate our employees. We are doing this by building and retaining an elite team of IT professionals equipped to deliver unmatched service to Canadian business leaders and their teams. We value humble service, self-improvement, hard work , and we are looking for like-minded-minded individuals to join us on our journey.

The Purpose:

As the Automation Analyst, you will be responsible for designing and implementing intelligent automation solutions that enhance operational efficiency and reduce manual effort across F12.net. This role is central to the development of agentic bots using Microsoft Copilot and large language models (LLMs), embedding automation into everyday tools and workflows. Success in this position requires a strong foundation in automation technologies, a collaborative approach to cross-functional problem-solving, and a proactive mindset to identify opportunities, optimize performance, and align solutions with F12.net’s strategic goals and compliance standards.

Responsibilities:

  • Maintain Design and Build Agentic Bots: Develop intelligent, autonomous agents using Microsoft Copilot and LLMs to automate repetitive tasks, decision-making workflows, and cross-platform integrations.
  • Process Mapping and Opportunity Identification: Collaborate with business units to analyze workflows, identify automation opportunities, and translate them into actionable bot use cases.
  • Prompt Engineering and Model Tuning: Craft effective prompts and fine-tune LLM behavior to ensure bots respond accurately and contextually across diverse business scenarios.
  • Copilot Integration: Leverage Microsoft Copilot capabilities across M365 and Power Platform to embed automation into everyday tools like Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, and Dynamics.
  • Bot Lifecycle Management: Own the end-to-end lifecycle of automation bots—from ideation and development to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
  • Security and Compliance Alignment: Ensure all automation solutions adhere to F12.net’s security, privacy, and compliance standards, especially when handling sensitive data.
  • Documentation and Enablement: Create clear documentation and training materials to support bot adoption, usage, and troubleshooting across teams.
  • Performance Monitoring and Optimization: Track bot performance metrics, user feedback, and operational impact to refine and scale automation solutions.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with DevOps, IT, and business stakeholders to align automation initiatives with strategic goals and operational needs.
  • Innovation and R&D: Stay ahead of emerging trends in generative AI, agentic systems, and automation tooling to continuously evolve F12.net’s automation capabilities.

Requirements/Qualifications

  • Proven experience with Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform, or similar automation tools.
  • Familiarity with LLMs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, etc.) and prompt engineering.
  • Strong understanding of business process mapping and workflow optimization.
  • Experience with scripting languages (e.g., PowerShell, Python) is a plus.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

What You Can Expect from Us:

We take pride in our forward-thinking, dynamic culture that champions diversity and inclusivity and fosters a respectful working environment. We also want to make sure that however you get IT done in all parts of your life, we’ve got your back. Here are some of the components of our total rewards plan:

Health Spending or RRSP Matching

Reimbursements for educational advancement and certifications

Leadership development opportunities and growth coaching

Dental care

Disability insurance

RRSP match

High Class Office Amenities

  • Work-Life & Growth: Three weeks vacation plus extra Flex Days, leadership development opportunities, growth coaching, and reimbursements for educational advancement and certifications.
  • Health & Financial Well-Being: Health Spending Account or RRSP matching, extended health care, dental and vision coverage, disability and life insurance, and an employee assistance program.
  • Additional Perks: Tuition reimbursement, paid time off, on-site parking, high-class office amenities, and company events.

Our Equal Opportunity Commitment:

  • F12.net practices as an equal opportunity employer in all services locations. We are committed to building and maintaining a workforce diverse in experience, skills, and knowledge. The company maintains a strict policy to ensure equal employment opportunities and do not discriminate based on any grounds and elements protected by law.

title: Supervisor til Nordisk Film Biografer Waves
description:
Som Supervisor får du ansvaret for vores kiosk- og salgsområde. Din vigtigste opgave er at sikre, at salget, gæsteoplevelsen og teamet fungerer optimalt i hverdagen.

Du er en synlig leder på gulvet, som motiverer – særligt unge medarbejdere – og sikrer, at vi møder gæsterne med energi, overblik og professionel service.

Det er en rolle med højt tempo, mange mennesker og masser af samarbejde.

Din rolle og dit salgsansvar
Du er den, der får salget til at fungere i praksis. Gennem din energi og synlige tilstedeværelse er du med til at skabe en hverdag, hvor:

- Gæsteglæde og mersalg går hånd i hånd
- Unge medarbejdere føler sig trygge, motiverede og klædt på til opgaven
- Salgsområderne altid fremstår indbydende og klar til gæster

Dine opgaver er blandt andet at:
- Drive og optimere salget gennem aktiv tilstedeværelse på gulvet
- Indkøb
- Motivere og udvikle teamet, særligt unge medarbejdere
- Træne kolleger i salg, service og professionel gæstedialog
- Sikre struktur, orden og klare forventninger i hverdagen
- Have fokus på det visuelle salg, så kiosken altid fremstår indbydende
- Sikre eksekvering og opfølgning på salgsaktiviteter og kampagner
- Følge salget tæt og justere bemanding og indsatser efter behov
- Arbejde struktureret med feedback, motivation og løbende opfølgning
- Være en tydelig rollemodel, leder og kulturbærer

Vores team og kultur
Du bliver en del af en ambitiøs og underholdende branche med højt tempo og synlige resultater.
Du arbejder sammen med et ungt team, hvor du er med til at skabe struktur, motivation og retning i hverdagen. Sammen skaber I gode oplevelser for vores gæster – hver dag.

Din profil
Vi forventer, at du er en ledertype, som kan lide at skabe resultater sammen med andre. Du fungerer som rollemodel og sætter dig i respekt ved selv at gå foran som et godt eksempel for hele medarbejdergruppen. Du kan lide at have med unge mennesker at gøre og være med til at forme dem for fremtiden.

Du er en loyal, stabil og troværdig person. Du har ordenssans og udviser stor ansvarlighed i hverdagen, hvor du tager ansvar og initiativ og forstår at omsætte planer til handling. Derudover forventer vi, at du kan kommunikere med et smil, kan lide at være blandt mange mennesker, har masser af situationsfornemmelse samt overblik i pressede situationer.

Du har erfaring med salg og service, og allerede nogen ledererfaring, men denne stilling kan også være din første lederstilling, som skal bringe dig videre i din karriere. Relevant erfaring kunne eksempelvis være fra en detailkæde, rejsebranchen, underholdning, hotel- og restaurationsbranchen, gerne et sted med fokus på salg og service.

Fleksibilitet i forhold til arbejdstid
Størstedelen af biografens omsætning skabes i aften- og weekendtimerne, hvad der naturligvis påvirker din arbejdstid. Dine vagter vil derfor være fordelt på både dag- og aftentimer, såvel hverdag som weekend, og du skal derfor være indstillet på skiftende arbejdstider.

Du skal endvidere være indstillet på at hjælpe til med besættelse af syge- samt ferievagter og i forbindelse med særarrangementer og spidsbelastningsperioder.

Vi tilbyder
En udfordrende stilling i en dynamisk og spændende virksomhed, hvor rummelig, ambitiøs og passion er nogle af nøgleordene. Arbejdsmiljøet er uformelt, branchen underholdende, og du får indflydelse på biografens udvikling.

Løn jf. overenskomst.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte: Tammy Rand, Biografchef, tammy.rand@nfbio.dk.

Arbejdsadresse:
Over Bølgen 20
Greve, 2670
Denmark

Ansøgningsfristen er 31/08/2026, og vi afholder samtaler løbende. Du bedes venligst benytte "Apply Now" knappen her på siden for at komme i betragtning til jobbet. Vi modtager ikke ansøgninger på e-mail.

Om Nordisk Film Biografer

Nordisk Film Biografer A/S er den største biografkæde i Danmark og den største spiller i biografindustrien med et total billetsalg på ca. 6 mio. billetter pr. år. Vi har mere end 900 servicemindede medarbejdere, som betjener vores gæster i hele Danmark. Vi har et omfattende online booking- og medlemskabprogram, og vi indgår i Nordisk Film Cinemas, som driver 40+ biografer i Danmark, Norge og Sverige. Hvis du vil vide mere: www.nordiskfilm.com

Nordisk Film er den førende producent og distributør af indhold i de nordiske lande, og vores digitale forretninger omfatter Dansk Reklame Film. Vi investerer endvidere i virksomheder inden for elektronisk spiludvikling og markedsfører PlayStation i de nordiske og baltiske lande. Vi er en del af Egmont Egmont er en fond, hvilket betyder, at vores overskud geninvesteres i virksomhederne, og hvert år går mere end 13 mio. EUR til velgørende formål, der forbedrer børns liv og støtter filmtalenter.

title: Retail Cosmetics Brand Expert - Origins, Dadeland - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As a Beauty Brand Expert at Macy’s, you are the go-to authority for your assigned brand, responsible for driving sales, elevating the customer experience, and leading with passion, expertise, and style. You serve as both a product educator and beauty enthusiast - creating personalized routines, demonstrating new trends, and helping customers look and feel their best.

In this role, you’ll inspire teamwork, coach fellow Beauty Advisors, and lead by example through exceptional service and product knowledge. You’ll foster customer loyalty, build relationships through clienteling, and execute brand strategies, events, and training in collaboration with store leadership and vendor partners. With a deep understanding of your brand and strong business acumen, you’ll analyze sales data, identify opportunities, and deliver results in a fast-paced, goal-driven environment.

How Our Beauty Brand Expert Leaders Spend Their Day…

  • Every day starts with a positive example. As a Beauty Brand Expert Leader, you come in energized and ready to inspire your team - wearing your name badge with pride, greeting colleagues with genuine warmth, and ensuring your counter is polished, organized, and fully prepared to welcome customers. You set the tone by reviewing daily sales goals, staying informed on new launches, top-performing products, and current beauty trends - so you're equipped to lead with confidence, support your team, and deliver exceptional service to every customer.
  • On the floor, you lead through action - welcoming customers with genuine hospitality, making eye contact, and starting friendly, personal conversations that build lasting relationships.
  • You help maintain a shoppable space by ensuring testers are clean and well-stocked, signage and pricing are current, and displays reflect brand standards. You lead by example, jumping in to support merchandising updates and keeping the space visually appealing and welcoming throughout the day.
  • You help the team Finish Strong - by reminding them to share Loyalty benefits, making sure customers leave with everything they need, and ending each interaction with a sincere thank-you, often using the customer’s name and adding a personal touch.
  • You know that service starts with each other. You model collaboration, honesty, and care - supporting your peers so the whole team can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are and What You Will Do

  • Deliver exceptional customer service through personalized consultations and expert product knowledge
  • Build lasting relationships with clients and drive client development through outreach and follow-up
  • Review and analyze business performance of daily, weekly, monthly, seasonal, and annual sales results and implement strategies to grow business and improve results
  • Plan and execute in-store and vendor-led events to drive traffic and engagement
  • Maintain brand standards through proper merchandising, hygiene, and stock replenishment
  • Collaborate with vendors, personal stylists, and store leadership to optimize outcomes
  • Resolve customer concerns in a professional and customer-first manner
  • Stay informed on new launches, best-sellers, and beauty trends to support team education
  • Manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment with strong attention to detail
  • Demonstrate sound judgment, and a passion for the beauty industry
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • 3–5 years of relevant retail, beauty, or leadership experience preferred
  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs., stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

This job description is not all-inclusive and may not apply to colleagues covered by a collective bargaining agreement. Macy's Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to an inclusive work environment.

title: Buyer Estimator
description:
SUMMARY

The Buyer Estimator position is responsible for supporting the Estimating team by coordinating supplier pricing, lead times, and sourcing information required to build accurate and competitive quotes. This role focuses on obtaining raw material and outside processing quotes, validating supplier capabilities, and entering cost data into the Epicor system to support RFQs for existing and new business. The Buyer Estimator plays a key role in ensuring quote accuracy, responsiveness, and alignment with market conditions.


JOB DUTIES

  • Purchases materials or coordinates activities involved with procuring quote-level pricing for raw materials, parts, supplies, and outside services in support of customer RFQs
  • Supports the Estimating team by sourcing supplier quotes required to build cost models for new and repeat business
  • Receives and reviews requisitions, RFQs, or estimating requests for goods and services
  • Interviews and confers with suppliers to obtain pricing, availability, lead times, minimum order quantities, and quote validity
  • Works with approved suppliers and supports maintenance of the Approved Supplier List (ASL)
  • Assures that suppliers engaged during the quoting process can meet quality and specification requirements

title: IT & Business Systems Analyst
description:
Salary: $75k–$85k + super, depending on experience

Who are we:

You may have heard of us—Ashley & Martin (that’s right, the hair people). For more than 60 years, we have helped people across Australia, New Zealand and Singapore feel more confident through personalised hair-loss treatment and exceptional service.

Behind our well-known brand is a diverse team working across a growing network of clinics and support functions. Technology connects our people, protects our information and helps us deliver a seamless experience for our customers. As we continue to improve our systems and explore smarter ways of working through automation and AI, this role will play an important part in shaping how we operate.


About the role

Ashley & Martin is looking for a capable and technically curious IT & Business Systems Analyst to take ownership of day-to-day technology support and help improve how our business operates.

This is not a graduate or entry-level role. You will need the experience and confidence to independently resolve common technology issues, administer our Microsoft 365 environment and coordinate effectively with external technology providers.

It is also broader than a traditional support role. You will work with teams across the business to understand problems, improve processes and progressively develop solutions using business systems, automation and AI. You will be our primary internal point of contact for technology requirements, supported by our managed IT services provider and specialist vendors for complex infrastructure, security and technical matters.

What we’re really looking for

We do not expect you to know every technology in our environment. We are looking for someone with solid IT foundations who is ready to broaden their capability and take greater ownership.

You will:

  • Have enough practical experience to work independently across common Level 1 and Level 2 support requirements.
  • Take ownership of issues and follow them through to resolution.
  • Be naturally curious and comfortable investigating unfamiliar technology.
  • Communicate confidently with both technical and non-technical people.
  • Enjoy helping people and improving their experience with technology.
  • See repetitive or manual work and look for a simpler, smarter solution.
  • Be interested in business systems, automation, data and AI.
  • Understand the importance of privacy, cybersecurity and appropriate access controls.
  • Balance good technology practices with practical commercial outcomes.
  • Want to understand the business—not only its technology.


What you’ll be responsible for

IT support and operations

  • Provide responsive Level 1 and Level 2 support across devices, applications, connectivity, authentication and printers, working with our managed IT services provider and specialist vendors where required.
  • Undertake initial troubleshooting and resolve common hardware, software, access and application issues, escalating complex matters to the appropriate provider and coordinating them through to resolution.
  • Manage technology onboarding and offboarding, including devices, accounts, licences, permissions and access.
  • Provision and maintain end-user devices through Microsoft Intune.
  • Maintain accurate IT asset, software and licensing records.
  • Escalate complex issues to the appropriate provider and coordinate them through to resolution.
  • Identify recurring issues and help address their underlying causes.

Microsoft 365 and business systems

  • Administer Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint and Intune.
  • Manage user accounts, groups, permissions, licences and access controls.
  • Support SharePoint as our primary document storage and collaboration environment.
  • Assist with the administration and improvement of internal business applications.
  • Maintain clear system documentation, procedures and support resources.


Process improvement, automation and AI

  • Work with employees and managers to understand workflows and identify inefficient or manual processes.
  • Translate business problems into practical technology improvements.
  • Build or support straightforward integrations and automated workflows using tools such as Power Automate, APIs, webhooks and low-code platforms.
  • Help test and implement responsible uses of AI, with appropriate privacy, security and access controls.
  • Measure whether technology changes are delivering meaningful business benefits.

You do not need to arrive as an automation or AI specialist. We are looking for someone with the aptitude and interest to progressively build capability in these areas.


Cybersecurity and technology environment

Working with our managed IT services provider and specialist vendors, you will:

  • Support security controls across identity, email, endpoints and business applications.
  • Assist with MFA, access reviews, endpoint compliance and employee security awareness.
  • Investigate and escalate phishing attempts, suspicious activity and security alerts.
  • Provide initial troubleshooting for VoIP, Wi-Fi, internet and infrastructure issues.
  • Help maintain security, infrastructure and technology documentation.
  • Assist with business continuity and technology resilience activities.

Specialist providers will retain responsibility for complex infrastructure, cybersecurity and technical matters. Your role is to understand our environment, complete appropriate initial investigation and ensure issues are properly resolved.


What you’ll bring

  • At least two years’ relevant experience in IT support, service desk, systems administration or a similar role.
  • Demonstrated experience providing Level 1 support and resolving common Level 2 issues.
  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft 365.
  • Practical exposure to Entra ID, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint or Intune.
  • Sound knowledge of Windows environments, networking fundamentals, user accounts, permissions and authentication.
  • An understanding of core cybersecurity practices, including endpoint protection, MFA, email security, access management and phishing.
  • Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving and communication skills.
  • The confidence to work with external providers while retaining ownership of the outcome.
  • A genuine interest in business systems, automation, integrations, data and AI.


Useful, but not essential

Experience with any of the following would be advantageous:

  • Proofpoint, CrowdStrike or Duo MFA
  • Microsoft Intune or SharePoint administration
  • Meraki, Avaya, Nutanix or CodeTwo
  • Power Automate or Power Apps
  • PowerShell or Python
  • APIs and webhooks
  • Zapier, Make, n8n or similar automation platforms
  • AI tools, APIs or AI-assisted workflows

Formal qualifications in information technology, computer science, cybersecurity or a related discipline are welcome but not essential.


Where this role can take you

You will initially focus on supporting employees and maintaining our existing technology environment.

As you build knowledge and demonstrate capability, you will progressively take on greater responsibility across:

  • Business systems
  • Automation and integrations
  • Artificial intelligence
  • Cybersecurity
  • Data and reporting
  • Process improvement
  • Technology projects

For the right person, this is an opportunity to move beyond traditional IT support and build a broader career in business systems, automation, cybersecurity or technology leadership.


Apply

If you have established IT support experience and are ready for a broader role with genuine development potential, we would like to hear from you.

Apply through SEEK with your resume and a short cover letter explaining what interests you about the role.

title: AI Enablement Lead
description:
Description

We seek a business-savvy AI Enablement Lead to drive internal AI adoption across Init.

Are you passionate about helping people work smarter with AI? Do you understand how to translate business challenges into practical AI solutions - without getting lost in technical complexity? We're looking for someone who can engage with colleagues across marketing, sales, IT, and engineering, understand their needs, and guide them toward AI-powered improvements.

This isn't a deeply technical role. It's about people, communication, and driving change. You'll be the face of AI enablement at Init - building relationships, running training sessions, and ensuring AI initiatives deliver real business value.

You'll work closely with our Senior AI Solutions Engineer and AI Developer to bring ideas to life, but your focus is on the "why" and "what," not the "how."

Key Responsibilities

·Business Engagement: Build relationships with teams across Init (Denmark, Norway, Sweden, Germany) to identify AI opportunities and understand their pain points.

·Road mapping: Develop and maintain a simple, prioritized AI enablement roadmap based on business impact.

·POC Leadership: Lead small-scale POCs from idea to validation—defining scope, success criteria, and business case.

·Training & Enablement: Design and deliver engaging online training sessions and workshops to upskill colleagues on AI tools and best practices. Make AI accessible and exciting—not boring!

·Adoption & Change Management: Drive internal adoption by communicating value, addressing resistance, and celebrating wins.

·Governance (Light Touch): Establish simple, pragmatic guidelines for responsible AI use—no enterprise bureaucracy, just sensible guardrails.

·Collaboration: Work closely with the technical team to ensure solutions meet business needs and are delivered efficiently.

·Stakeholder Communication: Regularly update leadership on progress, learnings, and impact.

Qualifications

·5+ years of experience in business analysis, product ownership, consulting, or digital transformation roles.

·Proven experience working with Nordic or Western European clients/stakeholders—you understand the culture and communication style.

·Demonstrated ability to run engaging training sessions, workshops, or presentations (please share examples!).

·Strong understanding of AI/LLM capabilities at a conceptual level—you can explain what's possible without needing to build it yourself.

·Excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal). Additional Nordic languages are a plus.

·Experience driving adoption of new tools or processes—you know how to influence without authority.

·Comfortable working remotely with distributed teams across multiple countries.

·Self-starter who thrives in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

This Role is NOT For You If...

·You want to spend most of your time coding or building technical solutions.

·You prefer detailed specifications over discovery conversations.

·You find training or presenting draining rather than energizing.

Nice to Have

·Experience in OT/IT, industrial automation, or consulting environments.

·Background in change management methodologies.

·Familiarity with AI tools like ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar.

·Experience visiting or working in Scandinavia.

Why Join Us?

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunity to work with experienced professionals and modern technologies.
  • Collaborative and inclusive work environment.
  • Career growth and professional development.

How to Apply?

"If you love using AI to improve the present and create the future, we want you to bring your skills and creativity to our team. We are Init together!"

Are you ready to make an impact and contribute to our success? Apply from this page now! Deadline: EOB Friday, 13 March 2026.

Who we are

Init is a group of software and automation companies offering sustainable, innovative, and long-term solutions to various Nordic and worldwide industries. Init was established in January 2022 by 17 companies joining forces. Today, it has over 900 highly qualified employees in Denmark, Sweden, Norway, North Macedonia, UK and Spain.

At Init, we focus on people, and as a people-first company, we see it as our most important task to help and support talented people by offering some of the most exciting challenges in the industry. We emphasise providing you with a fun, safe and inclusive working environment so you may feel a burning desire to come to work every day. In short, we do everything possible to make Init a positive part of your life. Our motto is "We are Init together." This applies when we collaborate with colleagues to make Init an attractive workplace and with customers to shape the future within automation and IT.

Read more about Init at www.initgroup.com

title: Full Stack Developer
description:

Hygiena’s proprietary diagnostic technologies enable customers to; prevent illness and save lives, comply with regulations, protect products and brands, run businesses more effectively. Solutions are sold in a wide range of industries globally, but the core focus is food safety. With rapid growth comes opportunity. We are looking for a Full Stack Developer to join our team onsite in Mississauga, Ontario office! This is a full-time, exempt position.

In this role, you will design, build, and operate features across SureTrend®, Hygiena’s multi-tenant food safety and quality management SaaS platform. The platform supports web application users as well as laboratory and production-floor instruments (including PCR analysis devices) that securely transmit mission-critical test data. You will work across modern front-end frameworks, .NET and Python back-end services, and relational data layers—carrying features from architectural design through testing, deployment, and cloud operations.

Responsibilities:

  • Full-Stack Application Development (30%): Design, build, and maintain scalable features across the SureTrend stack using ASP.NET Core on the back end, paired with Angular (TypeScript) and Nuxt / Vue.js on the front end.
  • Data Layer & Performance Tuning (20%): Architect and optimize the relational database layer, including schema and index design, query and execution-plan tuning, data migrations, and high-throughput data processing workflows for web and instrument-generated data.
  • Telemetry, Observability & Production Support (15%): Instrument cloud services with Azure Application Insights, monitor and diagnose production issues using KQL (or comparable telemetry stacks), and take ownership of service reliability.
  • Technical Design & CI/CD Quality (15%): Author technical designs, participate in rigorous code reviews, build comprehensive automated test suites, and strengthen CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps.
  • Containerized Microservices (10%): Build and maintain Python microservices deployed on Kubernetes (Docker), ensuring secure service-to-service integration and high availability.
  • Agile Collaboration (10%): Partner with Product, UX, and QA teams to refine technical specifications and deliver iterative value in an Agile framework.
  • Compliance & Safety (As required): Maintain compliance with all organizational policies, data security mandates, and safety programs.

Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Back-End Proficiency: Strong hands-on experience building robust, high-performance web services and APIs using ASP.NET Core / .NET.
  • Front-End Proficiency: Proven experience developing responsive single-page web applications using Angular (TypeScript) and/or Nuxt / Vue.js.
  • Database & Data Layer: Solid foundation in relational databases (SQL design, schema migrations, execution plan analysis, and performance indexing).
  • Engineering Best Practices: Dedication to writing clean, maintainable code with unit/integration tests, participating in code reviews, and collaborating via Azure DevOps (or Git-based CI/CD).

Strongly Preferred:

  • Multi-Tenant SaaS: Experience architecting multi-tenant SaaS platforms with strict data isolation, high scalability, and robust security.
  • Concurrency & Messaging: Experience with high-throughput systems, message queuing, batching, idempotency, backpressure handling, or database contention mitigation.
  • Cloud & Observability: Practical experience with Microsoft Azure, Azure Application Insights, and KQL (or tools like OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Grafana).
  • Containers & Microservices: Hands-on experience developing Python services running in Docker containers on Kubernetes.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Familiarity with Bicep, ARM templates, or Terraform.
  • Instrument & IoT Integration: Experience handling data from connected laboratory/physical devices, including considerations for intermittent connectivity, retry policies, payload buffering, and data serialization

Skills/Abilities:

  • Comfortable with interacting and working with all levels of customers, both internal and external; good interpersonal skills, team motivation and outgoing personality
  • Excellent adaptability in a fast-paced environment with the flexibility and willingness to take on new tasks and projects
  • Ability to speak and write clearly and accurately
  • Attention to detail and accuracy
  • Multi-tasking capabilities
  • Must have in-depth analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Must be able to use discretion and independent judgement.

Why you’ll want to join our team:

  • Teamwork as a Core Value: Strong cross-functional collaboration and supportive team culture.
  • Be a Part of Something Big: Play a critical role in preventing global health crises like foodborne illnesses and healthcare-associated infections.
  • Giving Back: Active community outreach supporting local youth and children’s organizations.

  • Et positivt arbejdsmiljø
  • Feedback fra chefer og kollegaer
  • Fleksible arbejdstider og en stærk teamkultur

Du får typisk mellem 20 – 40 kollegaer i butikken, og vi oplever ofte, at kollegaskabet udvikler sig til venskaber.

Attend community based meetings as scheduled/appropriate.

Evaluate performance and provide counseling and coaching to employees. Initiate personnel actions, such as promotions, transfers, terminations, or disciplinary measures. Maintain harmonious employee/employer relations. Determine current and future staffing levels.

Monitor reports on various program statistics including profit/loss statements, payroll and benefit costs, invoicing and revenue flow. Compare with budget projections. Investigate and report on variances.

  16. Provide assistance with other general department activities and/or as assigned.

  • Experience developing CAD automation tools, plugins or engineering software integrations.

  • Experience working with large-scale 3D models, assemblies or complex engineering datasets.
  • Strong programming experience in C++ alongside Python.

  • Experience building and deploying applications using Docker and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Experience implementing logging, monitoring, observability, and production debugging practices.
  • Experience partnering with mechanical engineers, researchers, or AI/ML teams to build engineering applications.
  • Passion for building software at the intersection of CAD, Mechanical Engineering, Backend Systems, and Engineering AI.

Our tech stack

title: Fullstack Engineer (TypeScript), AI Engineering: Duo Client SDK
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Fullstack Engineer on the Duo Client SDK team at GitLab, you'll build the shared foundation for every GitLab Duo client. Today, the logic that powers Duo in editors lives inside the GitLab Language Server. We're extracting it into a true software development kit (SDK): a set of well-versioned TypeScript packages that editor extensions, our web-based Duo Chat on GitLab.com, and eventually external applications can use.

You’ll work in TypeScript across frontend and backend systems. You’ll design the SDK’s Node.js core and public application programming interface (API), and work in the clients that use it. The work rewards care about interfaces, versioning, and backward compatibility as much as features because other engineers will depend on what you build.

You’ll have senior and staff engineers alongside you to help with design. You’ll own the implementation of scoped packages and ship improvements with minimal guidance while collaborating with the team on larger architectural changes.

Some examples of our projects

  • The Duo Client SDK, extracting versioned, publishable packages from the GitLab Language Server
  • The GitLab Language Server, rebuilt on top of the SDK as our polyglot surface
  • Duo Chat on the web, as one of the SDK’s first consumers

What you’ll do

  • Develop secure, well-tested, and performant TypeScript features that solve technical problems of moderate scope and complexity.
  • Ship small features and improvements with minimal guidance, writing tests with every merge request and contributing to code reviews and design discussions.
  • Extract and publish TypeScript packages from the GitLab Language Server, migrating consumers incrementally so no parallel implementation is left to drift.
  • Design durable public APIs with clear interfaces, semantic versioning, changelogs, and deprecation paths for external consumers.
  • Build isomorphic core packages that isolate platform-specific behavior in adapters at the edges.
  • Build and improve SDK client surfaces, including Vue 3 components in Duo Chat on the web, in collaboration with product, design, and engineering teams.
  • Strengthen credential handling across hosts, including bearer tokens, session cookies, and CSRF protection.
  • Optimize bundle size, startup cost, and dependency weight for browser consumers, and support a Tier 2 on-call rotation for urgent engineering issues.

What you’ll bring

  • Strong proficiency with TypeScript across frontend and backend systems, including experience building and maintaining Node.js services.
  • Experience with modern build and packaging tools, including monorepos, multi-module builds, ECMAScript modules (ESM), and dependency management.
  • Experience with Vue 3 and the Composition API, or comparable component-based frontend experience and a willingness to learn Vue.
  • Experience designing APIs that other people use, with the ability to explain what you’d do differently.
  • Understanding of the differences between running code in Node.js and in the browser, and how to write code that works in both.
  • A security-minded development approach, including careful credential handling and performance optimization.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and concisely in writing about technical problems, propose iterative solutions, and work effectively in an agile environment.
  • Self-motivation, strong organizational skills, and the judgment to ask for help when needed while thriving in a fully remote organization aligned with GitLab’s values.

About the team

The Duo Client SDK team sits in GitLab’s AI Clients stage and works closely with teams building GitLab Duo experiences. We collaborate across client surfaces to make thoughtful technical decisions as the platform evolves. We work fully remotely and asynchronously across regions, in the open, following GitLab’s values of transparency and open communication.

This range is intended to reflect the role’s base salary rate in locations throughout the US. title: Senior VVS-ingeniør
description:
Vil du sætte retningen for fremtidens tekniske installationer – og være med til at træffe de rigtige valg allerede i de tidlige faser?

Har du erfaringen til at tage fagligt lederskab og drive projekter med høj kompleksitet? Motiveres du af at rådgive kunder, udvikle intelligente installationsløsninger og skabe værdi gennem hele byggeprocessen? Så er det dig, vi søger.

Hos os får du en central rolle som seniorprofil, hvor du er med til at definere løsningerne fra start og sikre, at de bliver gennemført i høj kvalitet hele vejen til aflevering. Du bliver en nøgleperson i projekterne – både fagligt, strategisk og i samarbejdet med kunder, bygherrer og samarbejdspartnere.

Om rollen

Du bliver en del af et stærkt fagmiljø i Herlev og indgår i en organisation med ca. 520 medarbejdere i Danmark. Her arbejder vi tværfagligt med komplekse bygge- og anlægsprojekter, hvor tekniske installationer er afgørende for bygningernes funktion, bæredygtighed, energieffektivitet og fremtidige drift.

Som senior VVS-ingeniør får du en rolle, der går på tværs af projektets faser – fra de første strategiske overvejelser og behovsanalyser til projektering, udførelse og aflevering. Du er med til at sikre, at de rigtige beslutninger træffes tidligt i processen, hvor de har størst betydning for projektets kvalitet, økonomi og samlede værdi.

Du bliver en del af et fagligt stærkt team på ca. 25 VVS- og ventilationsspecialister i Herlev. Samtidig får du mulighed for at påvirke udviklingen af fagområdet, bidrage til kundeudvikling og være med til at styrke vores position på markedet.

Dine opgaver og ansvar

  • Tage en central rolle i idé-, dispositions- og projektforslagsfaser
  • Fagansvar for VVS- og ventilationsinstallationer i projekter
  • Rådgive bygherrer, brugere og samarbejdspartnere om tekniske løsninger, energioptimering, indeklima og bæredygtighed
  • Bidrage aktivt til udvikling af projekter og kunderelationer i de tidlige faser
  • Projektering og kvalitetssikring af VVS- og ventilationsinstallationer i komplekse byggerier
  • Udarbejde tekniske beskrivelser, funktionsbeskrivelser og projektmateriale
  • Sikre sammenhæng mellem teknik, økonomi, drift og udførelse
  • Varetage fagtilsyn og bidrage til commissioning, aflevering og idriftsættelse
  • Koordinere med øvrige fagdiscipliner og sikre robuste, tværfaglige løsninger
  • Sparre med og udvikle yngre kollegaer samt bidrage til den faglige udvikling i afdelingen

Som seniorprofil forventes du at kunne skabe overblik, drive komplekse problemstillinger fremad og være en naturlig sparringspartner for både kunder, projektledere og kollegaer.

Hvem er du

  • Uddannet ingeniør eller tilsvarende relevant uddannelse
  • Minimum 5 års erfaring med projektering af VVS- og ventilationsinstallationer
  • Erfaring med tværfaglige projekter inden for nybyggeri og renovering
  • Erfaring med byggepladsopfølgning, fagtilsyn og kvalitetssikring
  • Erfaring med fagansvar eller ambition om at tage næste skridt i karrieren

Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du:

  • Trives med ansvar og faglig ledelse
  • Har stærk helhedsforståelse og kan se løsninger på tværs af fag
  • Er nysgerrig og holder dig opdateret på udviklingen inden for installationer, energi og bæredygtighed
  • Er en tydelig og konstruktiv sparringspartner – både internt og eksternt
  • Har forretningsforståelse og lyst til kundedialog

  • Brænder for at skabe bygninger med lavt energiforbrug, høj funktionalitet og et sundt indeklima

Derfor er det interessant

Tuesday - exercise class at 11:00am

title: Consultancy in Neurology combined with a Clinical Professorship (chair) in Neurology
description:
A clinical position as consultant of Neurology at the Department of Neurology at Zealand University Hospital, Roskilde is open for appointment from as soon as possible.

The position is combined with a 10-year position as clinical professor (chair) of Neurology at the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen.

With this new position the Department of Neurology, Zealand University Hospital wishes to strengthen and consolidate the clinical research and teaching in collaboration with the University of Copenhagen with a focus on neurovascular diagnostics, mechanics and treatment.

It is a requirement that the applicant is accepted for appointment of both the professorship and the consultancy.

As a clinical professor at Zealand University Hospital you become part of a fellowship of professors and other researchers who work to bring research to the forefront for novel treatments to benefit the patients we serve.

The advertisement for the professorship is available from the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen )

ABOUT THE DEPARTMENT

The Department of Neurology at Zealand University Hospital holds a profile as the acute and specialised department in the region in the field. The department provides neurological services to the entire Region Zealand. Our in-patient clinic includes two wards with a total of 56 beds of which 26 beds constitute our acute neurovascular ward. Our outpatient clinic includes the general outpatient clinic as well as an infusion centre, a Neurophysiological Center, among others.

Annually we have (2025):

  • 7.400 acute admissions
  • 400 planned admissions
  • 24.000 out-patient visits

We are a multidisciplinary department. Our current staff includes 30 consultants, and 29 junior doctors.

The clinical activity of the department includes all neurological subspecialities.

Clinical functions and focus areas of the department

The subspeciality of stroke is a major clinical focus area of our department. We have a dedicated neurovascular ward providing acute stroke diagnostics and treatment the entire population of Region Zealand. This includes IVT (thrombolysis), sonography, an out-patient-clinic for TIA and minor stroke patients as well as regular in-patient treatment in the acute phase of stroke. We have 13 consultants/senior registrars affiliated with the neurovascular ward, and a multidisciplinary approach with a number of other health professionals related to stroke. We carry out simulation training of acute stroke admissions on a monthly basis as a means to ensure quality for our IVT patients.

We wish to employ a consultant with deep knowledge of the field, and the motivation and energy for strengthening and developing our neurovascular field, both in relation to the patients and the organisation.

The number of stroke patients remains high, and a high quality approach is vital for both the individual patients as well as society. There will be a need for strong collaboration within the department, with the pre-hospital centre, and with other departments.

The clinical tasks will have a focus on the in-patient ward but may also involve stroke patients in our outpatient clinic. The daily activities will include direct patient contact as well as supervision of and collaboration with nurses, junior doctors, and other health professionals.

Research and teaching

With the new position as consultant in neurology and clinical professor (chair) of neurology, the Department of Neurology wishes to strengthen leadership in clinical research and teaching.

We expect clinical research of an international level and quality within the field of stroke, and we expect a significant contribution to the further development of our clinical research unit in general.

The clinical research unit of our department currently includes four other senior researchers supporting a number of junior researchers, several of these as PhD students.

Our department is heavily involved in training and teaching medical students. We take pride in providing good courses for our upcoming colleagues, and taking part in this will be an important task.

Qualifications

Applicants must be board-certified specialist in Neurology.

Conditions

In order to be considered, the applicant must send an application to both the Faculty (the professorship) and to the hospital (the consultancy) cf. the simultaneously advertised position of the professorship. Appointment is conditioned by the fact that the applicant obtains both positions. This also applies to the applicants who are already employed as consultants at Zealand University Hospital.

Salary and conditions of employment as consultant are as agreed between the Danish Regions and the Danish Association of Medical Specialists and between the Region Zealand and University of Copenhagen.

As clinical professor at least 50 % of the working time will be allocated to academic tasks (e.g. research, teaching, evaluation tasks and communication with the public) in agreement with the Head of Department of Department of Clinical Medicine at the University of Copenhagen. The remaining time will be allocated for clinical work in agreement with the head of Department of Neurology. The clinical professor will receive secretarial or technical support equivalent to 50 % of a full time secretary position from the department of Neurology. Additional support and details on the working conditions must be negotiated with the head of the Department of Neurology, Zealand University Hospital, Roskilde.

Application procedure

The application must include the following:

  • Curriculum Vitae and a complete list of publications
  • Copy of the authorization certificate for specialist in Neurology
  • A description of how the applicant is qualified as
  • Clinical expert
  • Communicator
  • Collaborator
  • Manager/administrator/organizer
  • Health advocate
  • Scholar/researcher/teacher
  • Professional

For more information please refer to

The closing date for applications is 26.08.2026.
