title: Principal Agentic Architect - 11385
description:
Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.

Why join Coupa?

🔹 Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend.
🔹 Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence.
🔹 Global Impact: Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other.
Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.

Impact of the Forward Deployed Engineer at Coupa:

The Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) is the technical engine of Coupa’s AI Transformation. Sits at the intersection of Generative AI Engineering, Complex Workflow Orchestration, and Enterprise Systems Integration. Responsible for breaking down complex spend friction into logical state-machine workflows, utilizing Coupa Compose to orchestrate data, SLAs, AI agents, and business rules across heterogeneous environments.. You translate high-level "intents" defined by the Business Consultant into functional, interconnected AI solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. As a "forward deployed" resource, you act as the critical technical link between customer requirements and Coupa Product Management.

What You'll Do:

    • 1. AI Engineering & Agentic Orchestration

    • Agent Studio Mastery: Own the build, configuration, and rapid prototyping within Coupa Agent Studio; utilize "Agent Creativity" to expand platform capabilities beyond standard out-of-the-box features.

    • Prompt & Model Engineering: Specialized in AI Prompt Configuration and Model Tuning; possess the critical ability to identify when an agent is "hallucinating" and apply technical guardrails to ensure "Golden Standard" accuracy.

    • Multi-LLM & Tool Fluency: Fluent in multiple AI solutions and frameworks beyond Coupa (e.g., Claude, OpenAI, MCP, LangChain) to architect the most effective "Best-of-Breed" agentic workflows.

    • Architect Extensibility (Embedded UI Assistant & MCP): Design and deploy Coupa's open extensibility frameworks. Enable the Embedded UI Assistant (via Open Assistant Framework) to integrate external AI into the Coupa UI, and leverage the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to allow external enterprise orchestrators to securely execute Coupa actions.

    • Agent-to-Agent Communication: Design the logic and hand-off protocols that allow multiple agents to collaborate autonomously on complex, multi-step workflows.

    • Process State Machine Design: Decompose highly complex, multi-step procurement and finance challenges into deterministic, resilient workflow logic. Account for multi-tiered routing, operational SLAs, real-time data transformations, and asynchronous exception-handling threads.

    • UX Alignment & Adoption Engineering: Own the user journey within Tonkean (Smart Intake & Orchestration). Ensure that data extracted by agents maps seamlessly to intuitive, personalized frontend fields, eliminating change management overhead and driving process adoption.

      • 2. Integration & Technical Leadership

    • Full-Suite API Mastery: Leverage deep technical API knowledge to ensure secure, low-latency data exchange between AI agents and 3rd-party enterprise ecosystems (ERP, CLM, CRM).

    • Security & Risk Alignment: Partner directly with customer IT teams to resolve security questions, risk assessments, and technical feasibility blockers, ensuring all builds meet enterprise-grade standards.

    • Consumption Strategy: Understand and manage the impact of agentic use cases on Coupa credit usage and resource consumption.

      • 3. The Field-to-Product Bridge

    • Bi-Directional Feedback Loop: Act as the primary technical liaison to Product Management; identify roadmap gaps, articulate customer technical issues, and prioritize new features based on actual engagement data.

    • "As-Designed" Integrity: Close the loop between the original architectural vision and the final technical delivery to ensure the solution remains aligned with "As Designed" specifications.

    • Technical Sales Support: Own and curate a library of "Agent Blueprints" to rapidly deploy high-impact PoCs in pre-sales, serving as the final authority on technical feasibility.

    • Delivery Scaling & Asset Democratization: Move beyond localized blueprints for sales pitches. Package customized SIO workflows and Agent Studio configurations into standardized, reusable implementation patterns and framework components that optimize delivery velocity across the global Professional Services ecosystem.

      • 4. Performance Tuning & Quality Assurance

    • Guardrail & Simulation Design: Design the authorization boundaries and simulation runs that define where an agent can act autonomously versus where "Human-in-the-Loop" intervention is required.

    • Functional Correctness: Develop automated evaluation harnesses to move past "semantic correctness" and ensure rigorous "functional correctness" in production environments.

    • Monitoring & Health: Own the technical lifecycle of the build, including unit testing, monitoring agent health, and remediating workflow breakages.

    • Continuous Improvement: Understands human-in-the-loop best practices and where and how to build that into tech solutions.

What You Will Bring to Coupa:

  • Must-Have Technical Expertise

  • Integration Background: Proven experience in a technical integration role (Middleware, API Engineering, or Systems Architecture) with a deep knowledge of REST/GraphQL and JSON.

  • Programming Proficiency: Fluency in Python and/or JavaScript (Node.js).

  • System Connectivity: Experience building the "connective tissue" between non-deterministic AI outputs and deterministic enterprise systems.

  • Coupa S2P Domain Awareness: Understanding of Source-to-Pay business requirements; ability to map agentic workflows to core procurement, invoicing, and payables logic.

  • Agentic Frameworks: Hands-on experience with MCP or similar open-standard agentic architectures (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen).

    • Desired “Super Powers”

  • The "Builder" Mindset: Ability to move rapidly from a blank page to a functional, "pluggable" AI component.

  • Strategic Problem Solving: Skill in debugging complex systems where errors may stem from data quality, prompt ambiguity, or API latency.

  • Strategic Rapport: Ability to establish technical trust with C-suite stakeholders, serving as the "Expert in the Room" for AI transformation.

  • Digital Transformation Foundation: Proven experience in enterprise strategic consulting and large-scale digital transformation initiatives.

  • Technical Agility - Works well in an agile implementation environment and can quickly redesign an agent's logic

  • Transparent Translator - Can explain why the tech is behaving that way without being too technical, and also instill confidence in the customer

  • Coupa API/Compose Depth - Can diagnose if it's the agent’s fault, is it the product, is it the data, is it the configuration. Also will help with expectation-setting upfront to give the customer knowledge proactively.

  • The "Logical Systems" Architect: The ability to map complex, highly political, and fragmented legacy client processes into streamlined, automated workflow dependencies without losing architectural coherence

At Coupa, we are 100% committed to creating and nurturing an environment that supports your physical, mental, and community well-being . We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help you and your family thrive:

  • Global Wellness Days: Enjoy two designated, company-wide paid wellness days off each year (typically the first Friday in March and the last Friday in September) so the entire global team can unplug, step away, and recharge together .

title: Senior Software Engineer I
description:
Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.

We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.

About the Role

Careem's Quick and Shops team owns the customer-facing backend experience for two of our fastest-growing verticals. We power everything a customer sees and interacts with inside the consumer app — from browsing to checkout — through a server-driven UI architecture that keeps our mobile and backend teams tightly aligned.

As a Senior Software Engineer I, you will take full ownership of backend domains, build reliable and scalable services, and collaborate closely with mobile engineers to deliver a seamless customer experience for millions of Careem users.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services powering the Quick and Shops customer experience.
  • Write high-quality Golang code, delivering complete features and resolving bugs independently.
  • Build and maintain REST APIs, service-to-service integrations, and gateway and configuration-driven systems.
  • Own and evolve backend data models and catalog systems supporting our product verticals.
  • Manage event-driven systems using Kafka and Avro schema evolution.
  • Support AWS cloud infrastructure including S3, CloudFront, DNS, and certificate management.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and debug production issues across highly distributed and decoupled systems.
  • Mentor junior colleagues and drive cross-functional technical discussions across teams.
  • Champion AI-assisted development tools as part of your daily engineering workflow.

What You’ll Need

  • Proven backend engineering experience at a mid-band level or above — this is not an entry-level role.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Golang; candidates with deep experience in another modern language (Java, Kotlin, C#, C++) will be considered if they can demonstrate a clear ability to ramp up.
  • Product-facing backend experience — you have built systems that directly serve end customers, not purely infrastructure or platform-isolated work.
  • Experience with REST APIs, service-to-service integrations, and distributed systems.
  • Familiarity with data modeling, Kafka, and Avro schema evolution.
  • On-call ownership and a track record of debugging complex issues across distributed systems independently.
  • Strong communication skills, a collaborative mindset, and the ability to work autonomously without close supervision.
  • Experience mentoring junior engineers and coordinating across cross-functional teams.

Nice to Have

  • Understanding of server-driven UI paradigms.
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Working knowledge of relational and non-relational databases.
  • Familiarity with software engineering best practices: code reviews, source control, testing standards.

What we’ll provide you

We offer colleagues the opportunity to drive impact in the region while they learn and grow. As a full time Careem colleague, you will be able to:

  • Work and learn from great minds by joining a community of inspiring colleagues.
  • Put your passion to work in a purposeful organisation dedicated to creating impact in a region with a lot of untapped potential.
  • Explore new opportunities to learn and grow every day.
  • Work 4 days a week in office & 1 day from home, and remotely from any country in the world for 30 days a year with unlimited vacation days per year. (If you are in an individual contributor role in tech, you will have 2 office days a week and 3 to work from home).
  • Access to healthcare benefits and fitness reimbursements for health activities including gym, health club, and training classes.

As outlined in Careem’s Equal Employment Opportunity policy, we do not discriminate based on any protected group status under any applicable law.

The collection of demographic information is for internal purposes only i.e. equal employment opportunity monitoring as well as diversity initiatives.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer (Mid-level)

Location: Remote (Quebec/Canada)

About Irth Solutions

Irth Solutions is a leading provider of cloud-based SaaS software for damage prevention, asset integrity, stakeholder engagement and land management, helping energy, utility, telecom, and infrastructure companies protect their critical network infrastructure. With nearly three decades of industry experience, Irth serves customers across North America and continues to expand its platform with new data-driven and AI-powered capabilities.

About the Role

We are looking for a Data Engineer to design, build, and maintain data ingestion and processing pipelines in Databricks, transforming high-volume external data sources into clean, structured, reliable inputs for downstream analysis and intelligence. This role will primarily support our Stakeholder Engagement offering, working closely with our Data Scientist and application teams.

Key responsibilities

1. Data Pipeline Development (Primary Responsibility)

  • Design, build, and maintain ingestion pipelines from high-volume external APIs, capable of running continuously and reliably at scale.
  • Implement ingestion and transformation workflows using Databricks (Spark/PySpark, SQL, Delta Live Tables), applying medallion architecture patterns (Bronze → Silver → Gold) to move from raw ingested content to clean, structured, analysis-ready data.
  • Build the infrastructure for deduplication and relevance filtering of incoming content, implementing filtering logic and quality criteria defined in collaboration with the Data Scientist.
  • Implement schema evolution handling and data validation rules as data sources and formats change over time.

2. Platform & Storage Implementation

  • Configure and manage Delta Lake storage structures, tables, partitions, and optimization routines (OPTIMIZE, Z-ORDER, VACUUM).
  • Design and evolve data schemas that balance query performance, cost, and maintainability as data volume grows.
  • Maintain clear metadata and documentation of table structures to support easy consumption by the Data Science and application teams.

3. Reliability, Monitoring & Operational Support

  • Ensure pipeline reliability and observability: error handling, retries, monitoring, and alerting for a continuously running system.
  • Adapt pipelines to evolving external API contracts, rate limits, authentication changes, and new data sources.
  • Troubleshoot pipeline failures, perform recovery, and tune performance as needed.

4. Orchestration & Automation

  • Build, schedule, and monitor workflows using Databricks Workflows, Delta Live Tables, or similar orchestration tools.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines for code deployment, versioning, and environment management.

5. Collaboration & Documentation

  • Work closely with the Data Scientist to expose clean, well-structured data feeding LLM/NLP pipelines and downstream models.
  • Participate in technical decisions around data architecture and propose structuring solutions as the team's needs evolve.
  • Document pipelines, data dictionaries, job schedules, and transformation logic.
  • Support the onboarding of new data sources and pipelines as the product expands to additional solution areas.

Ingénieur(e) de données (Intermédiaire)

Lieu : Télétravail (Québec/Canada)

À propos d'Irth Solutions

Irth Solutions est un fournisseur de premier plan de logiciels SaaS infonuagiques pour la prévention des dommages, l'intégrité des actifs, la mobilisation des parties prenantes et la gestion foncière, aidant les entreprises des secteurs de l'énergie, des services publics, des télécommunications et des infrastructures à protéger leurs réseaux d'infrastructure critiques. Avec près de trois décennies d'expérience dans l'industrie, Irth dessert des clients à travers l'Amérique du Nord et continue d'élargir sa plateforme avec de nouvelles capacités axées sur les données et l'intelligence artificielle.

À propos du poste

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) ingénieur(e) de données pour concevoir, construire et maintenir des pipelines d'ingestion et de traitement de données dans Databricks, transformant des sources de données externes à haut volume en données propres, structurées et fiables pour l'analyse et l'intelligence en aval. Ce poste appuiera principalement notre offre de mobilisation des parties prenantes (Stakeholder Engagement), en collaboration étroite avec notre data scientist et les équipes de développement applicatif.

Responsabilités principales

1. Développement de pipelines de données (responsabilité principale)

  • Concevoir, construire et maintenir des pipelines d'ingestion à partir d'API externes à haut volume, capables de fonctionner de façon continue et fiable à grande échelle.
  • Implémenter des flux d'ingestion et de transformation avec Databricks (Spark/PySpark, SQL, Delta Live Tables), en appliquant les patrons d'architecture medallion (Bronze → Silver → Gold) pour transformer le contenu brut ingéré en données propres, structurées et prêtes pour l'analyse.
  • Construire l'infrastructure de déduplication et de filtrage de pertinence du contenu entrant, en implémentant la logique de filtrage et les critères de qualité définis en collaboration avec le data scientist.
  • Implémenter la gestion de l'évolution des schémas et des règles de validation des données, à mesure que les sources et formats de données évoluent.

2. Implémentation de la plateforme et du stockage

  • Configurer et gérer les structures de stockage Delta Lake, les tables, le partitionnement et les routines d'optimisation (OPTIMIZE, Z-ORDER, VACUUM).
  • Concevoir et faire évoluer des schémas de données qui équilibrent performance des requêtes, coûts et facilité de maintenance à mesure que le volume de données croît.
  • Maintenir une documentation claire des métadonnées et des structures de tables afin de faciliter leur utilisation par les équipes de data science et de développement applicatif.

3. Fiabilité, surveillance et soutien opérationnel

  • Assurer la fiabilité et l'observabilité des pipelines : gestion des erreurs, mécanismes de reprise (retries), surveillance et alertes pour un système fonctionnant en continu.
  • Adapter les pipelines aux changements des contrats d'API externes, des limites de taux (rate limits), des méthodes d'authentification et à l'ajout de nouvelles sources de données.
  • Diagnostiquer les défaillances des pipelines, effectuer les reprises nécessaires et optimiser la performance au besoin.

4. Orchestration et automatisation

  • Construire, planifier et surveiller des flux de travail avec Databricks Workflows, Delta Live Tables ou des outils d'orchestration équivalents.
  • Contribuer aux pipelines CI/CD pour le déploiement du code, la gestion des versions et des environnements.

5. Collaboration et documentation

  • Collaborer étroitement avec le data scientist pour fournir des données propres et bien structurées alimentant les pipelines LLM/NLP et les modèles en aval.
  • Participer aux décisions techniques liées à l'architecture des données et proposer des solutions structurantes à mesure que les besoins de l'équipe évoluent.
  • Documenter les pipelines, les dictionnaires de données, les calendriers d'exécution et la logique de transformation.
  • Appuyer l'intégration de nouvelles sources et pipelines de données à mesure que le produit s'étend à d'autres domaines de solutions.

Exigences

Forte préférence pour les candidat(e)s résidant au Québec, la maîtrise du français (parlé et écrit) constituant un atout important en plus de l'anglais.

Requirements

Strong preference for candidates residing in Quebec, with fluency in French (spoken and written) as a strong asset in addition to English

Required qualifications

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in data engineering, with solid experience building and operating production-grade data pipelines.
  • Familiarity with data modeling, data quality, and schema evolution.
  • Solid understanding of data pipeline reliability practices: monitoring, alerting, and handling failures gracefully in a continuously running system.
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks (or an equivalent Spark-based environment): schema design, Delta Lake, performance tuning, and pipeline orchestration.
  • Experience with at least one major cloud (Azure preferred; AWS/GCP also beneficial).
  • Experience integrating with external APIs at scale: authentication, pagination, rate limiting, retries, error handling.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL
  • Comfortable working with unstructured/semi-structured text data at scale.

Nice to have Qualifications

  • LLM prompting experience and/or basic understanding of AI/NLP concepts
  • Exposure to medallion architecture or lakehouse best practices.
  • Experience with orchestration frameworks (ADF, Workflows, Airflow, DBX, etc.).
  • Experience with CI/CD tools and version control (Git, GitHub Actions or equivalent).
  • Basic understanding of security practices: RBAC, encryption, credential management.
  • Databricks certification (Data Engineer Associate or equivalent).

AI Use in Hiring

As part of our hiring process, this role may use artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist with reviewing and screening applications. These tools support, but do not replace, human judgment in making hiring decisions.

Compensation

The salary range for this role is CAD $75000

This range reflects the base salary only and does not include any additional compensation components. Any offer of employment is dependent on several factors, including, but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, skills, qualifications, and location.

Qualifications requises

  • 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en ingénierie de données, avec une solide expérience dans la construction et l'exploitation de pipelines de données en production.
  • Connaissance de la modélisation de données, de la qualité des données et de l'évolution des schémas.
  • Bonne compréhension des pratiques de fiabilité des pipelines de données : surveillance, alertes et gestion des défaillances dans un système fonctionnant en continu.
  • Expérience pratique avec Databricks (ou un environnement équivalent basé sur Spark) : conception de schémas, Delta Lake, optimisation de la performance et orchestration de pipelines.
  • Expérience avec au moins un fournisseur cloud majeur (Azure de préférence; AWS/GCP également un atout).
  • Expérience dans l'intégration d'API externes à grande échelle : authentification, pagination, limites de taux, mécanismes de reprise, gestion des erreurs.
  • Forte maîtrise de Python et SQL.
  • À l'aise avec le traitement de données textuelles non structurées ou semi-structurées à grande échelle.

Atouts

  • Expérience en prompt engineering avec des LLM et/ou connaissances de base en IA/NLP.
  • Connaissance de l'architecture medallion ou des meilleures pratiques lakehouse.
  • Expérience avec des frameworks d'orchestration (ADF, Workflows, Airflow, DBX, etc.).
  • Expérience avec des outils CI/CD et de contrôle de version (Git, GitHub Actions ou équivalent).
  • Connaissances de base des pratiques de sécurité : RBAC, chiffrement, gestion des identifiants.
  • Certification Databricks (Data Engineer Associate ou équivalent).

Utilisation de l'IA dans le processus de recrutement

Dans le cadre de notre processus de recrutement, ce poste peut faire appel à l'intelligence artificielle ou à des outils automatisés pour appuyer l'examen et la présélection des candidatures. Ces outils appuient le jugement humain dans la prise de décisions d'embauche, mais ne le remplacent pas.

Rémunération

L'échelle salariale pour ce poste se situe entre CAD $75000

Cette échelle reflète uniquement le salaire de base et n'inclut aucune autre composante de rémunération. Toute offre d'emploi dépend de plusieurs facteurs, incluant, sans s'y limiter, l'expérience, les compétences, les qualifications et le lieu de résidence du ou de la candidat(e).

title: Dansk Sygeplejeråd søger Chefkonsulent til politisk interessevaretagelse
description:
Vil du være med til at flytte sundhedspolitikken og sikre sygeplejerskerne indflydelse dér, hvor beslutningerne træffes? Har du solid erfaring med politisk interessevaretagelse, og kan du navigere sikkert på Christiansborg, i ministerier og i komplekse politiske processer? Så læs med her.

Dansk Sygeplejeråd søger en erfaren chefkonsulent, der kan drive politiske dagsordener, opbygge stærke relationer og omsætte sygeplejerskernes interesser til politiske resultater. Du bliver en del af et stærkt team af politiske og professionsfaglige konsulenter og kommer også til at arbejde tæt sammen med bl.a. afdelingens presseteam.

Sundhedsvæsenet står midt i store forandringer, og de politiske beslutninger, der træffes i disse år, får stor betydning for sygeplejerskernes arbejdsliv, sygeplejefagets udvikling og kvaliteten i sundhedsvæsenet.

Som chefkonsulent arbejder du med centrale sundhedspolitiske dagsordener og sikrer, at sygeplejerskernes viden, erfaringer og interesser bliver hørt dér, hvor beslutningerne træffes.

Du bliver en del af et fagligt stærkt team for Politik og Profession i afdelingen Kommunikation, Politik og Profession. Vi er i alt 11 i teamet og 36 i afdelingen. Vi arbejder tæt sammen på tværs af politisk interessevaretagelse, analyse, presse, kommunikation og professionsudvikling for at skabe størst muligt gennemslag for Dansk Sygeplejeråds prioriterede dagsordener. Vi har mange snitflader på tværs i sekretariatet og med vores lokale kredse.

Du drives af at skabe resultater for landets sygeplejersker gennem målrettet og systematisk interessevaretagelse. Du kan skifte mellem at gribe en aktuel politisk mulighed, forberede den politiske ledelse til et møde med en minister eller andre beslutningstagere og drive et længere strategisk forløb. Og så er du en person, der trives med opgaver, som har høj kompleksitet, udnytter de mange samarbejdsflader og navigerer hjemmevant i en politisk virkelighed, der hurtigt kan ændre sig.

Opgaver
Dine opgaver bliver:

  • Drive udvalgte mærkesager fra politisk strategi til konkrete resultater – herunder udvikle politikpapirer, analysere interessenter og gennemføre målrettet interessevaretagelse over for Christiansborg, ministerier og andre centrale aktører.
  • Identificere nye politiske muligheder, risici og alliancer og omsætte dem til anbefalinger og konkrete initiativer.
  • Rådgive den politiske ledelse og direktionen om politiske muligheder, risici og strategiske valg samt bl.a. udarbejde strategioplæg, politiske briefinger, taler og mødeforberedelse.
  • Være strategisk sparringspartner for ledelsen, direktionen og kolleger på tværs i organisationen.
  • Videreudvikle Dansk Sygeplejeråds politiske interessevaretagelse og opbygge stærke relationer til beslutningstagere, organisationer og andre centrale samarbejdspartnere.
  • Skabe størst muligt politisk gennemslag ved at koble interessevaretagelse med analyse, presse og kommunikation, professionsudvikling og medlemsorganisering.

Kompetencer
Du har:

  • Solid erfaring med politisk interessevaretagelse og public affairs og kan dokumentere, at du har været med til at sætte og flytte politiske dagsordener.
  • Stor politisk tæft, som bl.a. baserer sig på en analytisk kapacitet og tilgang.
  • Erfaring fra Christiansborg, en interesseorganisation, et public affairs-bureau eller en central politisk ledet organisation.
  • Veludviklede samarbejdsevner og sociale kompetencer, du gerne sætter i spil både internt og eksternt.
  • Lyst til at arbejde i en medlemsorganisation, hvor politik skal tage afsæt i sygeplejerskernes virkelighed og skabe resultater for medlemmerne.
  • En skarp pen til at formidle politiske forslag og indsatser.
  • En relevant samfundsvidenskabelig baggrund eller anden videregående uddannelse, der har givet dig stærke analytiske og politiske kompetencer.

Vi tilbyder
Vi tilbyder løn- og ansættelsesforhold i henhold til kvalifikationer og intern overenskomst i Dansk Sygeplejeråd.

Ansøgningsfrist
Send din ansøgning og CV via linket nedenfor, så vi har den senest 13. september 2026 kl. 12. Ansættelsessamtaler finder sted 18. september 2026 og 24. september.

Kontakt
Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte teamchef for Politik og Profession Mathilde Thornberg Djervad på 2035 1329.

Dansk Sygeplejeråd
Dansk Sygeplejeråd er en partipolitisk uafhængig organisation, der varetager godt 73.000 sygeplejerskers interesser. Vores vision er ”Sygeplejerske – for livet.” Vi arbejder for at sygeplejersker aflønnes i forhold til professionens høje værdi for samfundet, for en professionel sygepleje af faglig høj kvalitet og deltager aktivt i den sundhedspolitiske debat. Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm. Grow Your Skills, Grow Your Potential

As a Lead Platform Engineer, you will design, build, and maintain end-to-end CI/CD pipelines and developer delivery workflows across the full SDLC, with deep hands-on expertise in Gitlab/GitHub/GitHub Actions (branch protection, PR workflows, required checks, runners, reusable/composite workflows, release automation, and governance). You will establish Enterprise level reusable pipeline templates and workflow standards, integrate infrastructure-as-code and declarative YAML configurations, and support secure, reliable deployments across environments (dev/test/staging/prod and **ephemeral previews**), including containerization and orchestration with Docker and Kubernetes. A core responsibility is to embed security, quality, and compliance into delivery through secrets management, least-privilege access, audit logging, supply-chain protections (SBOMs, artifact signing, provenance), and security scanning/policy-as-code—while partnering smoothly with security teams. You will also connect delivery events to operational and planning tools (Slack notifications/approvals/incident alerts and Jira traceability), document platform standards and runbooks, troubleshoot and debug pipeline/deployment failures, and translate platform engineering work into measurable business and delivery impact by collaborating closely with application engineers, SREs, QA, product, and release management.?

    • Starting salary will be based on skills, background, and experience

All medical plans provide 100% coverage for in-network preventative care, AND you and your family have access to vision, dental, telemedicine, 24/7 mental health professionals, and much more!

Plan for those big moments in life with benefits like fertility/IVF/adoption assistance, college coaching, national discount programs, interactive monthly financial workshops, free financial coaching, and more. You can also start a savings account or consider financing through our State Farm Federal Credit Union!

With the opportunity to initially earn up to 20 days annually plus parental leave, paid holidays, celebration day, life leave (40 hours/year), bereavement leave, and community service/education support days, there will be plenty of time for you!

title: Independent Contractor (Spanish/English) Transcription/Translation
description:
What you will do:

As an independent contractor, you will be working from home as a freelance transcriptionist and translator, making an accurate text document of the contents of audio, video, typed or handwritten material.

We transcribe oral history interviews (with WWII veterans, women in academia, farmers, midwives…), focus groups, financial forecasts or quarterly reports, tech webinars, commencement addresses, interviews about NGO work, educational reform or health care access, or anything else you could think of, and even occasionally TV shows. We don't do medical transcription.

Who we’re looking for:

  • U.S. Citizens or U.S. Resident Alien as described on IRS form W-9.
  • Bilingual transcriptionists/translators of Spanish and English.
  • Fast and accurate typists (minimum of 80 wpm), who can deliver files on deadline without question.
  • People with a wide range of interests or educational experiences. As the subject matter varies broadly, it’s easier to understand the flow of conversation when you have some context for what is being discussed.

Requirements

  • Strong language, style, and punctuation skills, and the capability and willingness to follow our transcription style manual as well as project-specific instructions.
  • Ability to verify names and terms via brief internet research. Much of the work we do is for archives, so these transcripts will become part of a historical record and need to be of high quality to reflect that permanence.

What you will need

  • A reliable internet connection is a must. ATC sends project files via Dropbox links, so no special FTP setup is necessary.
  • For confidentiality reasons, we require that you use an email address that no one else has access to.
  • Transcripts should be returned to ATC as .doc files. You are not strictly required to use Microsoft Word; you can also use Open Office or some other program that has the capability to save as a .doc file as long as the formatting requirements are met and the functionality of the end product is indistinguishable from a document completed in Word.
  • ATC highly recommends the use of transcription software (such as ExpressScribe) controlled via hotkeys or a foot pedal, and the use of good-quality headphones to cut down on ambient noise while you are transcribing.

How do I get hired as a freelance transcriptionist?

No calls, please. File your online application here and include:

  • Current resume (PDF)
  • Cover letter (PDF)
  • A screenshot of the results from a three-minute typing test on www.typingtest.com (our minimum requirement is 80 wpm with 98% accuracy)

title: DevOps Lead View opportunity Montréal, Canada (hybrid)
description:
WHC is looking for a hands-on, technically deep DevOps Lead to own the performance, reliability, and operational health of our server fleet. Reporting to the Director of Technology, you’ll keep our servers fast and available, bring order and consistency to how we run the fleet, and make sure automation, security, and backups are solid so problems stop repeating.

This is a doer-first role: an operator who leads by doing and sets the standard by example, not a manager directing from a distance. You’ll set standards for a small team of DevOps and system administration engineers, but the day-to-day is technical ownership, not headcount management. It is not an on-call role; our system administrators are the 24/7 first responders, and you’re the next level up.

What You’ll Do

  • Keep our servers fast and available: plan for growth, and find and resolve performance problems across CPU, disk, databases, and web servers before they become incidents.
  • Bring the fleet to a known, consistent state: reduce the one-off snowflakes, close the gaps, and make “how a WHC server should look” something the whole team can point to and trust.
  • Treat Git as the single source of truth for server configuration; automate routine work so changes are safe and repeatable, and add checks that flag when a server has drifted from its expected state.
  • Keep our servers hardened and get real answers on how well our current tooling is actually protecting us, and support our PCI DSS and SOC 2 work.
  • Ensure backups are reliable and that we can rebuild a full server within our target recovery time, including a repeatable, documented server-migration capability. Test the restore; don’t trust the document.
  • Build and maintain a strong library of operational runbooks, keeping our procedures current and trusted so the team always has good documentation to work from.
  • Be the main day-to-day operational contact for our infrastructure vendors: support, escalations, and operational issues.
  • Look for simpler, safer, more efficient ways to run our systems, including the careful, practical use of AI in operations work.
  • Coach the engineers around you, set clear expectations, and partner well with Development and System Administration. Lead by owning outcomes, not by counting hours.

What You Bring

  • Deep, hands-on Linux skills across a fleet of servers, not only cloud or container environments. You’re comfortable operating many machines at once and making them consistent.
  • Solid scripting and automation (Bash, plus Python or Perl), and real experience managing server configuration in Git and automating changes safely.
  • Production MySQL/MariaDB: replication, tuning, backup, and restore.
  • Experience with backups and disaster recovery, including meeting a defined recovery time.
  • A monitoring and performance mindset: you find the bottleneck rather than waiting for the ticket.
  • Security-by-default instincts for hardening and running servers.

title: Grid Health- Founding GTM Associate
description:
About Grid Health

Grid Health is a venture-backed health-technology company on a mission to make it safe for healthcare to adopt AI. We build a clinical-AI governance platform that helps hospitals and health systems inventory, monitor, and govern every AI tool and model they deploy — giving governance committees the visibility and evidence they need to sign off with confidence. Our buyers are hospital CISOs, CIOs, CMIOs, and AI governance committees. US HQ in Boston; R&D hub in Tel Aviv.

You'll run Grid Health's commercial engine day to day — pipeline, outbound, account research, and follow-through — working closely with company leadership. Grid Health gives health systems visibility and control over the AI they run in production: what they have, how it's performing, and whether they can defend it to a governance committee. Your job is turning conversations and relationships into a disciplined, growing pipeline of health-system deals.

What you'll own

  • The commercial pipeline, end to end. Stage, next step, owner, and timeline on every active opportunity, plus a clean weekly pipeline review.
  • Executive sales support. Research and a briefing before every health-system meeting, then fast follow-up, materials, and next steps after it, so nothing stalls.
  • Target accounts and account intelligence. Build and refine the account list, map the buying committee (CIO, CMIO, CAIO, CDO, CISO, compliance, procurement) for priority health systems, and find the warm path in.
  • GTM operations. CRM hygiene, pipeline stages, sales collateral, and proposal coordination — enough structure that our commercial motion scales without anything falling through.
  • New opportunities, sourced through outbound, our investor and advisor network, existing relationships, and our health-system governance community.
  • Market intelligence. Capture objections, buying triggers, and the language customers use, and feed it back to product and messaging.

Requirements

What we're looking for

  • 2-5 years in healthcare technology, enterprise SaaS, business development, sales, strategy, or consulting. Direct experience selling into health systems is a plus; it's not required.
  • Hand-on expiriance as SDR- MUST
  • A self-starter who is highly organized and comfortable managing dozens of accounts and follow-ups without dropping a detail.
  • Commercially curious — you want to know why a deal moves, what creates urgency, and why one stalls.
  • Clear writing and communication. You can brief an executive before a meeting and summarize a complicated one after it.
  • Good judgment. Enterprise health-system relationships reward persistence, not carelessness, and you know the difference.
  • Comfortable building process where none exists yet, and improving it as you go.

Nice to have

  • Experience with US health systems or healthcare SaaS.
  • Familiarity with enterprise sales cycles and multi-stakeholder buying committees.
  • Hands-on CRM experience (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar).
  • Experience working directly with founders or senior executives.
  • Strong research skills and outbound prospecting experience.

How we hire

Four steps: a short screen, an executive conversation, a paid or credited working session on a real problem from our roadmap, and a final round with the team you'd work with. We don't believe in take-homes that go nowhere — every exercise is a real conversation about real work.

The expected base salary for this role is $70K- 115K. This is a good-faith estimate, but does not include equity or other forms of compensation. Pay will be based on experience level, but those outside of the salary band are welcome to apply.

You will build the libraries, scaffolding, and CLI that give engineers a paved road from empty repo to a production LLM service: pre-configured FastAPI project structure, a default ReAct agent with MCP integration, GrabGPT connectivity, Vault-backed secret management, auth helpers, guardrails, built-in observability, and evaluations wired in out of the box.

You will report to the Engineering Manager and work onsite at the Grab Office.

This role is onsite based in our Petaling Jaya, Malaysia office.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

  • Develop Framework Features End-to-End

Independently build complex library and tooling features, agent and MCP integrations, scaffolding templates, CLI subcommands, config and secret management, auth helpers, guardrails, and evaluation hooks, from conception through release and adoption.

  • Design Clean and Composable Abstractions

Design the abstractions teams build on: clean, composable interfaces over LangChain, LangGraph, FastAPI, and MCP adapters.

  • Build Well-Architected Python Libraries and CLIs

Build well-architected Python libraries and CLIs (and Go where it fits Grab's tooling), with rigorous packaging and dependency hygiene on uv, strict semantic versioning, backwards compatibility guarantees, and consistent API conventions across the SDKs.

  • Implement Quality and Governance Layers

Build and operate the platform's quality and governance layers: OpenTelemetry distributed tracing and Datadog metrics baked into generated services, structured logging, Vault secret injection, OIDC/workload-identity authentication, prompt-level guardrails against common adversarial attacks.

  • Ensure Framework Reliability and Support

Ensure the framework is for the teams that depend on it. Participate in on-call and support rotations, triage breakages in scaffolding, dependency, and deployment paths, conduct root cause analysis, and be part of post-mortems.

What Essential Skills You Will Need

  • 2+ years of professional software development experience with a history of delivering successful solutions. Fresh Graduates are welcome.
  • Proficiency in server-side programming, specifically Python and Golang.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs (Large Language Models), LangChain, and LangGraph for conversational AI development.
  • Practical experience with cloud providers (AWS), containerization (Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Grasp of data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and multi-threading.
  • An advocate for automated testing (unit, integration) and writing concise technical documentation.
  • Experience with a relational database such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Oracle

title: Livstræet søger 2 pædagoger til faste stillinger.
description:
En pige ligger på gulvet og kigger på en ko. Hun siger en lyd. Pædagogen smiler til hende og gentager lyden. Med store, smilende øjne afsøger pigen pædagogens blik, før hun igen siger en lyd. Pædagogen kommenterer med flere lyde og ord, mens hun holder øjenkontakten. De smiler til hinanden.

I Tilst Dagtilbud samler vi på den slags betydningsfulde øjeblikke, der understøtter børnenes trygge tilknytning.

Du har nu en helt unik mulighed for at være med til at skabe disse rammer og fundamentet for børns trivsel, læring, udvikling og dannelse i Livstræet.

Vi er ambitiøse på børnenes vegne og har det enkelte barns trivsel og udvikling i centrum i alt, hvad vi foretager os. Vi søger hele tiden at give barnet de bedste muligheder for, at trives og udvikle sig et læringsmiljø hvor tryg tilknytning er fundamentet.

Nærvær, positive relationer, tryghed, tydelighed og anerkendelse, ved vi får det bedste frem i alle børn og vi arbejder professionelt ud fra et fælles barnesyn og stærke værdier.

Alle børn og forældre skal føle sig velkomne og mødes med varme og omsorg. Børn er noget ganske særligt i vores øjne.

Mangfoldighed ser vi som en styrke og tror på, at stærke fællesskaber og det at høre til, er centralt for børnenes udvikling og trivsel.

Vi er optaget af at udvikle vores faglighed løbende, således vores tilgang til kerneopgaven står på skuldrene af evidens og forskning. Vores pædagogiske afsæt er funderet i neuropsykologisk relationel pædagogik. Vi arbejder i hele Tilst dagtilbuddet med et aktionslæringsforløb, hvor arbejdet med - og implementeringen af - læreplanen er det fælles afsæt.

For at sikre at nye medarbejdere er klædt på til opgaven afholder vi løbende særlige læringsdage for nyansatte.

Vi brænder for at forfine vores pædagogiske miljøer og tilgang igennem refleksive dialoger med kollegaer og forældre.

Personalets mange og alsidige kompetencer bringes i spil på tværs af hele dagtilbuddet, vi arbejder ud fra præmissen –den, der har evnen, har ansvaret.

Vi er bevidste om, at vi stiller høje krav til dig som vores medarbejder, derfor vil vi gerne passe på dig.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Åbne døre til vores pædagogiske leder. Medarbejdere kan altid stille spørgsmål og søge sparring både på tværs af kollegaer men også ved den pædagogiske leder.
  • Mulighed for vejledning og sparring med dagtilbuddets pædagogiske vejleder.
  • En klar holdning til, at ”den der har evnen, har ansvaret”, hvilket i praksis betyder, at du har mulighed for at gøre det du er god til og som giver dig energi.
  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling.
  • ”Faglig fordybelses dag” med dagtilbuddets pædagogiske vejledere, som sikrer at nye medarbejdere får mulighed for at fordybe sig i dagtilbuddets faglige ståsted og værdier.
  • Kontinuerligt arbejde med en åben, nysgerrig og anerkendende omgangstone, som sikrer det gode samarbejde til børnenes bedste.
  • Plads til både den faste, forudsigelige struktur og skæve, spontane input som tager udgangspunkt i børnenes idéer eller de muligheder dagen bringer.
  • En holdning til, at så længe vi som voksne har børnenes perspektiv og vores faglighed forrest, kan næsten alt lade sig gøre.
  • Inspireres af at arbejde med et specialpædagogisk sigte.

Lidt mere om os:

Som pædagog i Livstræet er man en betydningsfuld del af et team, som i fællesskab tager ansvar for at løse opgaverne omkring at støtte alle børn i deres læring, udvikling og trivsel. Vores teams består af en god blanding af nyere medarbejdere og medarbejdere, som har været i husene i flere år. Vi har en overbevisning om, at alle medarbejdere er bedst i stand til at skabe trygge, udviklende rammer for børnene, når de selv er i trivsel i deres arbejde.

Derfor er vores arbejdsmiljø i højsædet, vi arbejder hele tiden på at styrke og bevare den gode trivsel som allerede er eksisterende.

Skal du være vores nye kollega?

  • Kan du mærke arbejdsglæden spire ved at læse hvilken arbejdsplads vi er?
  • Glædes du over at udvikle dig sammen med kollegaer?
  • Finder du motivation i at være medskaber af de bedste læringsmiljøer for barnet?

Hvis du kunne svare ja til det hele, så skal du da være vores nye kollega! Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig med det samme, så du kan fortælle hvad du kan tilbyde os – vi indkalder nemlig til samtaler løbende.

Tiltrædelse: Snarest muligt/ efter aftale.

Ansøgning
Klik på ”Ansøg” nedenfor for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Om Aarhus Kommune
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der vægter faglighed og samarbejde højt og vi tror på, at vores forskelligheder er med til at gøre Aarhus for en god by for alle.

Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!

title: Director for Contracts and Commercial (Q-CO)
description:
Jasara Program Management Company (Jasara PMC) is a leading Joint Venture between Public Investment Fund (PIF), Jacobs, and Saudi Aramco, established to deliver world-class program management services across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Jasara plays a key role in supporting the realization of Saudi Vision 2030, particularly in delivering giga-projects and large-scale infrastructure developments.

We are seeking a Director for Contracts and Commercial (DCP/Gas Farms) to join JASARA PMC. The Director – Contracts and Commercial is responsible for leading the commercial, contractual, procurement, and financial oversight functions for District Cooling Plants (DCP) and Gas Farm assets and services. The role ensures commercial optimization, contract governance, lifecycle value realization, and risk management across the planning, development, transition, operation, and maintenance phases of critical utility infrastructure.

The Director serves as the commercial Subject Matter Expert (SME), providing strategic guidance on contracting strategies, supplier performance, commercial negotiations, cost management, and contract assurance to support safe, reliable, and cost-effective utility operations.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Commercial Leadership

  • Develop and implement commercial and contracting strategies for DCP and Gas Farm infrastructure and services.
  • Support long-term business planning, investment decisions, and value optimization initiatives.
  • Provide commercial leadership for major utility projects, operational contracts, and strategic partnerships.
  • Advise executive management on commercial risks, opportunities, and market trends.
  • Ensure alignment of commercial activities with organizational objectives and budget requirements.

Contract Management and Governance

  • Lead the development, negotiation, award, administration, and close-out of contracts.
  • Establish contract governance frameworks, policies, and procedures.
  • Ensure compliance with organizational procurement and contracting requirements.
  • Manage contract variations, claims, disputes, and settlement negotiations.
  • Oversee contractor performance management and contractual compliance.
  • Ensure robust contract assurance and audit processes are implemented.

Commercial Management

  • Lead commercial evaluation of projects, services, and operational contracts.
  • Develop commercial models and business cases supporting investment decisions.
  • Monitor contract costs, commercial performance, and value realization.
  • Ensure effective cost control and budget management across assigned utility assets.
  • Identify opportunities for cost optimization and operational efficiencies.
  • Support tariff, pricing, and service cost analysis where applicable.

Procurement and Supply Chain Oversight

  • Direct procurement strategies for utility-related projects, services, equipment, and operational contracts.
  • Oversee tendering, bid evaluation, contract award, and supplier selection processes.
  • Ensure procurement activities achieve best value while maintaining quality and compliance.
  • Build strategic relationships with key suppliers and service providers.
  • Promote supplier performance improvement and contract efficiency initiatives.

Risk Management and Claims Management

  • Identify commercial, contractual, financial, and supply chain risks.
  • Develop mitigation plans to minimize commercial exposure.
  • Lead contract risk assessments and commercial due diligence activities.
  • Manage claims, disputes, and conflict resolution processes.
  • Support legal teams on contractual matters and dispute proceedings.
  • Ensure contractual obligations are clearly documented and enforced.

Asset Lifecycle Commercial Support

  • Support commercial activities throughout the asset lifecycle, including:
    • Planning and feasibility
    • Design and construction
    • Testing and commissioning
    • Operational readiness
    • Operations and maintenance
    • Asset renewal and replacement
  • Ensure commercial decisions support whole-life value optimization.
  • Participate in Stage Gate reviews and investment approval processes.

Financial and Performance Management

  • Develop commercial KPIs and performance monitoring frameworks.
  • Monitor financial performance, contractual obligations, and value delivery.
  • Support annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning.
  • Provide executive reports and commercial insights to senior management.
  • Ensure achievement of financial and operational targets.

Stakeholder Management

  • Build effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Engage with contractors, consultants, operators, suppliers, legal advisors, and government entities.
  • Represent the organization in commercial negotiations and strategic discussions.
  • Provide commercial advice to executive committees and project leadership teams.

Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Quantity Surveying, Commercial Management, Engineering, Business Administration, Finance, Law, or related discipline.
  • Master's Degree in Business Administration (MBA), Commercial Management, Finance, Engineering Management, or related field preferred.

Experience

  • 20+ years of experience in contracts, commercial management, procurement, or project controls.
  • Minimum 8 years in a senior management or leadership role.
  • Proven experience in utilities, energy, district cooling, gas infrastructure, industrial facilities, or large infrastructure projects.
  • Experience managing high-value service, construction, operations, and maintenance contracts.
  • Demonstrated success in commercial negotiations, claims management, and supplier relationship management.
  • Experience supporting major capital projects and operational utility assets.

Professional Certifications (Preferred)

  • MRICS (Member of the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors).
  • Certified Commercial Contracts Manager (CCCM).
  • Chartered Institute of Procurement & Supply (CIPS).
  • PMP or PRINCE2.
  • Certified Asset Management qualification (IAM/CAMA).
  • Relevant Commercial or Contract Law certifications.

title: DevOps Engineers (Terraform, Azure & Infrastructure Automation) | Marc Ellis | Abu Dhabi, UAE
description:
Job Title

DevOps Engineer (Terraform, Azure & Infrastructure Automation) | Marc Ellis | Abu Dhabi, UAE

Job Location

Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates

Job Type

12-Month Contract (Extendable)

Additional Information

  • Contract Duration: 12 Months (Extendable)
  • Abu Dhabi Onsite Opportunity
  • Senior-Level DevOps Position
  • Experience Required: 8-12 Years
  • Strong Azure and Terraform Expertise Required

Position Summary

Marc Ellis is seeking an experienced DevOps Engineer to drive infrastructure automation, cloud enablement, and platform reliability initiatives within a large-scale enterprise environment. This role is ideal for professionals with strong expertise in Terraform, Azure, Ansible, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) who are passionate about building secure, scalable, and highly automated platforms.

Detailed Job Description

As a DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, deploying, and managing enterprise infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code methodologies. You will work closely with development, operations, cloud, and security teams to automate provisioning, standardize deployments, and improve platform reliability across cloud and on-premises environments. The role requires deep technical expertise in Azure infrastructure, Terraform, Ansible, automation frameworks, and infrastructure governance. You will contribute to cloud transformation initiatives, implement security and compliance controls, optimize operational processes, and support enterprise-grade deployment pipelines. This is an excellent opportunity to work on modern infrastructure platforms while helping drive automation and operational excellence across critical business systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform and Azure-native technologies.
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and deployment processes.
  • Develop reusable, scalable, and secure infrastructure templates and modules.
  • Implement and manage Azure infrastructure services across enterprise environments.
  • Utilize Ansible for configuration management and infrastructure automation.
  • Collaborate with DevOps, Development, Operations, and Security teams to deliver automated solutions.
  • Implement infrastructure testing, validation, governance, and compliance controls.
  • Manage infrastructure source code repositories using Git and version-control best practices.
  • Monitor infrastructure performance, availability, and operational health.
  • Troubleshoot infrastructure, cloud, and deployment-related issues.
  • Optimize platform scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency.
  • Maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, standards, and operational procedures.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 8-12 years of experience in Infrastructure Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or DevOps roles.
  • Strong hands-on expertise with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code practices.
  • Extensive experience with Microsoft Azure cloud platforms and services.
  • Strong proficiency in Ansible for automation and configuration management.
  • Experience managing both cloud and on-premises infrastructure environments.
  • Solid networking knowledge including Subnets, VLANs, Routing, Firewalls, and DNS.
  • Understanding of cloud security principles, IAM, access controls, and encryption standards.
  • Scripting experience using PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
  • Strong experience with Git and source code management workflows.
  • Experience with infrastructure monitoring and observability tools such as Dynatrace and Prometheus.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience implementing DevOps and automation best practices within enterprise environments.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with Azure DevOps pipelines and CI/CD automation.
  • Knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker, and container orchestration platforms.
  • Experience implementing Zero Trust and cloud security frameworks.
  • Familiarity with multi-cloud environments and hybrid cloud architectures.
  • Azure, HashiCorp Terraform, or DevOps-related professional certifications.

Recruitment Pro Tip

For senior DevOps positions, hiring managers look for candidates who can demonstrate real-world infrastructure automation achievements. Clearly showcase Terraform modules developed, Azure environments deployed, automation initiatives implemented, CI/CD improvements, infrastructure cost optimizations, and measurable reliability gains such as faster deployments, reduced downtime, or improved operational efficiency.

title: Souschef - Rudkøbing
description:
Souschef med ambitioner – er det dig?

I Netto vil vi være kendt for at levere gode kundeoplevelser – og vil du også være med til det, så er denne stilling måske noget for dig?

Som souschef kan du se frem til en masse selvudvikling, karrieremuligheder og ikke mindst fællesskab. Som souschef har du flere ansvarsområder. Til daglig fungerer du både som butikschefens højre hånd og sparringspartner. Og er butikschefen ude af huset, syg eller på ferie, så er det altså dig, der har det overordnede ansvar.

Helt kort så skal du

  • udvikle og træne medarbejdere, og sikre at de er glade og motiverede
  • gå forrest ude i butikken og vise det gode eksempel for dine kolleger
  • løse forskellige administrative opgaver
  • supportere butikschefen i alle typer af opgaver
  • være med til at sikre, at butikken opnår de ønskede driftsresultater
  • være rollemodel for Nettos værdisæt og medarbejderoplevelse, vi kalder det NEX: Netto Employee Experience

Alle de gode grunde
Stillingen er en rigtig god mulighed for at være med i et dagligvareeventyr. Du bliver del af en stærk kultur præget af god energi, engagement og Netto-ånd. Vi har fokus på din personlige udvikling som leder. Du kan også glæde dig til

  • konkurrencedygtig løn, pension og bonusordning
  • sundhedsforsikring
  • masser af gode personaleordninger fx rabatter i Bilka, føtex, Netto, Carl’s Jr. og Starbucks og leje af vores feriehuse og lejligheder i ind- og udland

**Leder- og livserfaring
**I stillingen som souschef er det vigtigt, at du først og fremmest er et ordentligt menneske og har erfaring med at lede mennesker. Og du elsker at sprede trivsel og glæde omkring dig. Mere præcist så forestiller vi dig, at du

  • har ledererfaring
  • er åben over for Nettos holdning til ledelse ved at skabe resultater igennem høj medarbejdertrivsel
  • er nysgerrig og villig til at lære nye ting

**Souschef – blot en begyndelse?
**Du får selvfølgelig en masse god erfaring fra din dagligdag som souschef, men der er også mulighed for at komme på uddannelse og kurser. Måske kan du blive butikscheftrainee, hvor du får helt styr på teorien bag god ledelse. Netto er en del af Danmarks førende retail-koncern, så det kan også være, du på sigt ønsker en stilling hos føtex, Bilka eller på hovedkontoret. Du kan også sigte mod en international karriere.

**Er du vores nye kollega?
**Send din ansøgning til os via linket nedenfor. Vi inviterer løbende til samtale, så søg allerede i dag.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Netto – vi bærer vores logo med stolthed

Du kender måske allerede Netto som Danmarks største dagligvarekæde – men vidste du også, at vores medarbejdere er rigtig glade for at arbejde her?

Du bliver nemlig del af et helt specielt sammenhold med masser af opbakning, og hvor vi alle løfter i flok. For det vi laver er vigtigt, men dem, vi laver det med, er endnu vigtigere.

Vi håber, du er lige så begejstret for dyrevelfærd, reduktion af madspild og en bæredygtig fremtid, som vi er. Vi har bl.a. vores eget økologiske brand: ØGO. Og det er naturligvis til gode Netto-priser.

title: Software Engineer – API and Platform
description:
*******Required to be considered*********

We are using Predictive Index in our hiring practices, please use this link to take the two PI assessments:

Click to take assessments


About East Daley Analytics

East Daley Analytics drives transparency in energy markets. We specialize in identifying, understanding, and monitoring operational risk across the oil and gas value chain, on the principle that no one should be surprised by an energy market event.

Anyone can gather energy data; our work is telling clients the "so what" of it. We track and forecast throughput and capacity across more than 1,200 midstream assets operated by 26 major midstream companies across crude oil, natural gas, NGLs, and the capital markets that finance them. That research reaches investors, operators, and business leaders through Energy Data Studio®, our analytics portal.

The Opportunity

We are always seeking ways to provide a cutting-edge and technologically advanced experience for our clients. This role executes this premise through the construction of an API over our data, and a live interactive front end in our customer portal that consumes it. The API is the center of the work: the contract our own pages depend on, the surface our customers’ tooling will call, and the layer that has to serve dashboard queries at extract speed.

This offering is also going to be queried by AI agents, not only by users in our front-end experience. That means a constrained, introspectable query surface an agent can reason about safely. It is a genuinely interesting design problem, and we are thrilled by the opportunity to make it come to life.

What You’ll Own

The API and the query layer. A versioned API our own pages and our customers’ tooling can depend on: resource endpoints, cursor pagination, sparse field selection, and filtering that does not fall apart as query complexity grows. You will own this contract, its versioning, and ensuring strong uptime.

Supporting the front end. Our customer-facing dashboards are moving from generated static pages to a live, interactive product including charts, maps, filtering, cross-chart interaction. A dedicated front-end engineer will own that work. Your job is to make sure the API gives them everything they need, and to be comfortable enough in the front-end codebase to read it, debug against it, and assist when it matters.

Running it in production. These dashboards are the products served to customers outside our network using the API. You will help stand up and operate what that requires: edge caching and protection, request authentication against our existing identity provider, rate limiting, observability good enough to tell you in which layer a slow request actually spent its time, and deployment that does not require a maintenance window.

Collaborate with the Data Team on SQL foundations. You will work closely with the Data Team as they optimize the database layer feeding the product. This includes stored procedures, the semantic view layer, and the filter architecture that keeps a wide multi-select query fast.

What Success Looks Like

In the first 6 months:

  • The API is something others can build on without asking you how it works: versioned, documented, self-describing, and stable enough that a new dashboard page or an agent-driven query tool can be built against it independently.
  • The migration is in place. Dashboards in the customer portal are live pages served by our own API, at response times equal to or better than the legacy versions they replaced.
  • The aggregation problem is solved structurally. The large tables that cannot be queried live today are served from pre-aggregated stores, refreshed off the request path on a cadence matched to how fresh each one needs to be.
  • The schema shared by the entire pipeline from database to HTML is enforced, changes to it are additive and coordinated, and drift at that seam is not a recurring defect.

title: Memory Senior Circuit Engineer
description:
Circuit Design & Implementation

  • Design and own memory circuit blocks at transistor level — row/column decoders, wordline drivers, pre-charge, sense amplifiers, write drivers, self-timed replica/tracking paths, control logic, level shifters, and IO — to the performance, power, and area targets defined in the specification.

  • Support instance and compiler development: implement and update designs so they remain correct and margin-clean across the configuration range of the compiler.

  • Execute ECOs and design changes for device sizing, connectivity, and margin fixes, and drive them through to clean re-verification.

  • Own a complete memory instance or compiler sub-family end to end, including its architecture choices, margin strategy, and PPA trade-offs.

Simulation & Verification

  • Run pre- and post-layout SPICE simulation across all required PVT corners; verify function, timing, power, and leakage against specification.

  • Perform margin and statistical analysis — Monte-Carlo, bitcell read/write/hold margin, sense-amplifier offset, VMIN and retention analysis — and document the results for design review.

  • Close post-layout issues with the Layout team: parasitic impact, EMIR violations, coupling, and power-integrity findings.

  • Debug design mismatches and drive root-cause analysis together with the Modeling, Layout, and CAD teams.

  • Define the verification and corner strategy for the blocks under ownership, and review the simulation work of other engineers.

Automation & Methodology

  • Develop scripts and automation (Perl/Python/TCL/Shell/SKILL) to accelerate simulation, data collection, and regression tasks, and integrate them within the memory compiler / view-generation environment.

  • Follow and contribute to the design checklists, review gates, and sign-off criteria used by the Memory team.

  • Introduce and implement methodology improvements that enhance design quality and overall team efficiency.

Collaboration & Support

  • Work in close cooperation with Memory Layout, Modeling, DFT, Physical Design, and STA teams to deliver on time and according to required specifications, and escalate technical risks early.

  • Generate the required documentation, support characterisation and silicon correlation, and contribute to the validation and debugging of fabricated silicon.

  • Participate actively in design reviews — present your own work, and give and receive technical feedback constructively.

  • Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior circuit engineers and interns.

Essential Requirements

  • BS/MS in Electronics Engineering, Telecommunications, Microelectronics, Computer Engineering, Physics, or a related field.

  • Minimum 4 years of hands-on custom/analog circuit design experience for IC or IP design

  • Proficient in schematic capture (Cadence Virtuoso or equivalent).

  • Proficient with spice simulators (hspice, spectre or equivalent) and multi-corner PVT simulation.

  • Working knowledge of statistical analysis for circuit design: Monte-Carlo, process variation, margin and yield concepts.

  • Experience with post-layout simulation, parasitic extraction, and basic EMIR analysis.

  • Experience with FinFET or advanced planar technologies.

  • Strong scripting/programming skills (Perl, Python, TCL, Shell) on Unix/Linux.

  • English Language Proficiency: Fluency, written and verbal.

  • Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Desirable Requirements

  • Direct experience on embedded memory (SRAM, DPRAM, ROM, Register File, or TCAM)

  • Master’s degree in Electronics / Microelectronics Engineering.

  • Hands-on experience with memory compilers and view-generation flows.

  • Understanding of memory bitcell behaviour and assist techniques (wordline boost, negative bitline, VDD collapse).

  • Familiarity with CCS/NLDM characterisation, Liberty (.lib) model generation, and SPICE correlation, or with DFT/MBIST for memories.

  • Understanding of memory architectures (SRAM/ROM/Register File), RTL modelling (Verilog, VHDL, Verilog-A), and STA concepts.

  • Knowledge of functional safety (ISO 26262) and quality (ISO 9001) processes.

title: Retail Fulfillment Associate, Mayfair - Part Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As a Fulfillment Colleague, you will play a key role in creating a seamless and personalized shopping experience for our omni-channel customers. This role combines sales floor engagement with back-of-house fulfillment responsibilities - selecting merchandise, packing and shipping online orders with care, and assisting with in-store and curbside pickup.

You’ll greet customers with genuine hospitality, resolve issues with professionalism, and ensure each interaction is smooth and positive. Your attention to detail, teamwork, and commitment to operational excellence will help drive sales, strengthen customer loyalty, and support overall store success.

This role goes far beyond just being a behind-the-scenes support colleague. Here, the customer is at the heart of everything we do - every day, all day. If you're passionate about selling, reaching goals, working as a team, and creating amazing experiences through genuine hospitality, this could be the perfect fit for you!

How Our Fulfillment and Receiving Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Our colleagues begin each day energized and ready to make an impact. They wear their name badge with pride and greet teammates with a warm hello. Before getting started, they review their goals, learn about new products and promotions, and prepare the store for success. Whether receiving merchandise, tagging items, or organizing the stockroom, they bring energy and focus to every task to set the day up for smooth operations and strong results.
  • On the floor, they focus on the customer - from greeting customers warmly to actively listening and resolving issues, colleagues build trust through personal, helpful interactions - on the floor, during curbside pickups, or through timely and accurate order fulfillment.
  • Throughout the day, they maintain a shoppable space by recovering the floor and fitting rooms, updating signs and pricing, restocking merchandise, and supporting any needed merchandise moves.
  • They always Finish Strong - sharing our Loyalty program benefits, making sure customers have all they need, and ending with a sincere thank-you, often walking the package around and using the customer’s name. Behind the scenes, they wrap up their day by organizing the stockroom, completing orders, and setting the team up for the next day’s success.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Be comfortable communicating and collaborating with customers and colleagues
  • Meeting daily sales goal challenges
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Enjoy meeting people, learning about them, and sharing information
  • Resourceful and eager to start a new venture and can adapt to changing priorities; you can work on your own but are great with team dynamics

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands.
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 30lbs., stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level.
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment.
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

This job description is not all-inclusive and may not apply to colleagues covered by a collective bargaining agreement. Macy's Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to an inclusive work environment.
